@ServiceProvider(service=ProjectFactory.class)
public class Plc4xCommsSubProjectFactoryImpl implements ProjectFactory {

    public static final String COMMS_SUBPROJECT_DIRECTORY = "comms"; 
    
    @Override
    public boolean isProject(FileObject fo) {
        boolean isCommsFolder = fo.getName().equalsIgnoreCase(COMMS_SUBPROJECT_DIRECTORY) && fo.isFolder();   
        return isCommsFolder;
    }

    @Override
    public Project loadProject(FileObject fo, ProjectState ps) throws IOException {
        return isProject(fo) ? new Plc4xCommsSubProjectImpl(fo, ps) : null;
    }

        //
    }

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.comms.impl;

import java.awt.Image;
import javax.swing.Action;
import org.netbeans.api.annotations.common.StaticResource;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.LogicalViewProvider;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.CommonProjectActions;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.loaders.DataFolder;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObjectNotFoundException;
import org.openide.nodes.AbstractNode;
import org.openide.nodes.Children;
import org.openide.nodes.FilterNode;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.ImageUtilities;
import org.openide.util.Lookup;
import org.openide.util.lookup.Lookups;
import org.openide.util.lookup.ProxyLookup;

public class Plc4xCommsSubProjectLogicalViewProviderImpl implements  LogicalViewProvider {

    @StaticResource()
    public static final String COMMS_SUBPROJECT_ICON = "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/comms/nodes/FolderBlue.png";
    
    private final Project project;

    public Plc4xCommsSubProjectLogicalViewProviderImpl(Project project) {
        this.project = project;
    }
    
    @Override
    public Node createLogicalView() {
        try {
            //Obtain the project directory's node:
            FileObject projectDirectory = project.getProjectDirectory();
            DataFolder projectFolder = DataFolder.findFolder(projectDirectory);
            Node nodeOfProjectFolder = projectFolder.getNodeDelegate();
            //Decorate the project directory's node:
            return new ProjectNode(nodeOfProjectFolder, project);
        } catch (DataObjectNotFoundException donfe) {
            Exceptions.printStackTrace(donfe);
            //Fallback-the directory couldn't be created -
            //read-only filesystem or something evil happened
            return new AbstractNode(Children.LEAF);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Node findPath(Node node, Object o) {
        return null;
    }
    
    private final class ProjectNode extends FilterNode {

        final Project project;

        public ProjectNode(Node node, Project project)
            throws DataObjectNotFoundException {
            super(node,
                    new FilterNode.Children(node),
                    new ProxyLookup(
                    new Lookup[]{
                        Lookups.singleton(project),
                        node.getLookup()
                    }));
            this.project = project;
        }

        @Override
        public Action[] getActions(boolean arg0) {
            return new Action[]{
                        CommonProjectActions.newFileAction(),
                        CommonProjectActions.copyProjectAction(),
                        CommonProjectActions.deleteProjectAction(),
                        CommonProjectActions.closeProjectAction()
                    };
        }

        @Override
        public Image getIcon(int type) {
            return ImageUtilities.loadImage(COMMS_SUBPROJECT_ICON);
        }

        @Override
        public Image getOpenedIcon(int type) {
            return getIcon(type);
        }

        @Override
        public String getDisplayName() {
            return project.getProjectDirectory().getName();
        }

    }    
    
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.comms.impl;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.api.project.ProjectManager;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.SubprojectProvider;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;

public class Plc4xCommsSubProjectProviderImpl implements SubprojectProvider {
    
    public static final String COMMS_SUBPROJECT_DIRECTORY = "comms";     
    
    private final Project project;  

    public Plc4xCommsSubProjectProviderImpl(Project project) {
        this.project = project;
    }

    @Override
    public Set<? extends Project> getSubprojects() {
        return loadProjects(project.getProjectDirectory());
    }

    @Override
    public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        //
    }

    @Override
    public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        //
    }

    public Set loadProjects(FileObject dir) {
        Set newProjects = new HashSet();
        FileObject reportsFolder = dir.getFileObject(COMMS_SUBPROJECT_DIRECTORY);  
        if (reportsFolder != null) {             
            try { 
                Project subp = ProjectManager.getDefault().
                    findProject(reportsFolder);
                if (subp != null && subp instanceof Plc4xCommsSubProjectImpl) {                    
                    newProjects.add((Plc4xCommsSubProjectImpl) subp);
                }
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
            }

        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableSet(newProjects);
    }     
    
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.comms.nodes;

import java.awt.Image;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.comms.impl.Plc4xCommsSubProjectProviderImpl;
import org.netbeans.api.annotations.common.StaticResource;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactory;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObject;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObjectNotFoundException;
import org.openide.nodes.FilterNode;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.ImageUtilities;

@NodeFactory.Registration(projectType = "org-plc4x-hmi-project", position = 2000)
public class Plc4xCommsSubProjectNodeFactoryImpl implements NodeFactory {

    @StaticResource()
    public static final String COMMS_SUBPROJECT_ICON = "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/comms/nodes/FolderBlue.png";      
    
    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        Plc4xCommsSubProjectProviderImpl rsp = project.getLookup().
            lookup(Plc4xCommsSubProjectProviderImpl.class);
        assert rsp != null;      
        return new ProjectsNodeList(rsp.getSubprojects());
    }
    
    private class ProjectsNodeList implements NodeList<Project> {
        Set<? extends Project> subprojects; 
        
        public ProjectsNodeList(Set<? extends Project> subprojects) {
            this.subprojects = subprojects;
        }        

        @Override
        public List<Project> keys() {
            List<Project> result = new ArrayList<Project>();
            for (Project oneReportSubProject : subprojects) {
                result.add(oneReportSubProject);
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            //
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            //
        }

        @Override
        public Node node(Project k) {
             FilterNode fn = null;          
            try {
                fn = new FilterNode(DataObject.find(k.
                        getProjectDirectory()).getNodeDelegate()){
                    @Override
                    public Image getIcon(int type) {
                        return ImageUtilities.loadImage(COMMS_SUBPROJECT_ICON );
                    }
                    @Override
                    public Image getOpenedIcon(int type) {
                        return ImageUtilities.loadImage(COMMS_SUBPROJECT_ICON );
                    }
                };
            } catch (DataObjectNotFoundException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
            }
            return fn;
        }

        @Override
        public void addNotify() {
            //
        }

        @Override
        public void removeNotify() {
            //
        }
    }       
    
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;

public final class CommunicationsConfig {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CommunicationsConfig.class.getName());
    private final List<DeviceConfigData> dispositivos = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> indicePorUuid = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, CommConfigData> comms = new HashMap<>();

    public CommunicationsConfig() {
    }

    public CommunicationsConfig(List<DeviceConfigData> devices) {
        for (DeviceConfigData device : devices == null ? List.<DeviceConfigData>of() : devices) {
            addDevice(device);
        }
    }

    public List<DeviceConfigData> getDevices() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(dispositivos);
    }

    public void addDevice(DeviceConfigData device) {
        dispositivos.add(device);
        indexar(device);
    }

    public void upsertDevice(DeviceConfigData device) {
        String uuid = device.getUuid();
        if (uuid == null || uuid.isBlank()) {
            String name = device.getDeviceName();
            LOGGER.log(Level.FINE, () -> "El dispositivo '" + name + "' llega sin UUID;"
                    + " se agrega como nuevo y se le asignarÃ¡ al cargar.");
            dispositivos.add(device);
            return;
        }
        Integer posicion = indicePorUuid.get(uuid);
        if (posicion == null) {
            dispositivos.add(device);
            indexar(device);
            return;
        }
        int i = posicion;
        dispositivos.set(i, device);
    }

    public DeviceConfigData findByUuid(String uuid) {
        if (uuid == null || uuid.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        Integer posicion = indicePorUuid.get(uuid);
        return posicion == null ? null : dispositivos.get(posicion);
    }

    public Map<String, CommConfigData> getComms() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(comms);
    }

    public CommConfigData getComms(String deviceUuid) {
        return comms.get(deviceUuid);
    }

    public void upsertComms(String deviceUuid, CommConfigData commConfig) {
        if (commConfig == null) {
            comms.remove(deviceUuid);
        } else {
            comms.put(deviceUuid, commConfig);
        }
    }

    public void removeComms(String deviceUuid) {
        comms.remove(deviceUuid);
    }

    public boolean removeDevice(String uuid) {
        if (uuid == null || uuid.isBlank()) {
            return false;
        }
        Integer posicion = indicePorUuid.remove(uuid);
        if (posicion == null) {
            return false;
        }
        dispositivos.remove(posicion.intValue());
        reindexar();
        comms.remove(uuid);
        return true;
    }

    public void replaceDevice(int index, DeviceConfigData device) {
        DeviceConfigData anterior = dispositivos.set(index, device);
        if (anterior != null) {
            desindexar(anterior);
        }
        indexar(device, index);
    }

    public void clear() {
        dispositivos.clear();
        indicePorUuid.clear();
        comms.clear();
    }

    private void indexar(DeviceConfigData device) {
        indexar(device, dispositivos.size() - 1);
    }

    private void indexar(DeviceConfigData device, int posicion) {
        String uuid = device == null ? null : device.getUuid();
        if (uuid != null && !uuid.isBlank()) {
            indicePorUuid.put(uuid, posicion);
        }
    }

    private void desindexar(DeviceConfigData device) {
        String uuid = device.getUuid();
        if (uuid != null && !uuid.isBlank()) {
            indicePorUuid.remove(uuid);
        }
    }

    private void reindexar() {
        indicePorUuid.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < dispositivos.size(); i++) {
            indexar(dispositivos.get(i), i);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * @param xmlSaved         whether {@code comunicacion.xml} was written
 * @param databaseUpdated  whether {@code boot.db} was rebuilt
 * @param message          explaining why not, empty if everything went well
 */
public record SaveResult(boolean xmlSaved, boolean databaseUpdated, String message) {

    private static final SaveResult success = new SaveResult(true, true, "");

    public SaveResult {
        Objects.requireNonNull(message, "el mensaje no puede ser null");
        if (!isComplete2(xmlSaved, databaseUpdated) && message.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "un guardado que no fue completo necesita un motivo: sin el, el aviso "
                            + "no le diria nada al usuario");
        }
    }

    private static boolean isComplete2(boolean xml, boolean db) {
        return xml && db;
    }

    /** El guardado fue bien: XML y base de datos. */
    public static SaveResult success() {
        return success;
    }

    public static SaveResult partial(String message) {
        return new SaveResult(true, false, Objects.requireNonNull(message,
                "un guardado parcial necesita un motivo: si no, el aviso no dice nada"));
    }

    public static SaveResult notSaved(String message) {
        return new SaveResult(false, false, Objects.requireNonNull(message,
                "un guardado rechazado necesita un motivo: si no, el usuario no sabe que "
                        + "se ha perdido su trabajo"));
    }

    public boolean isComplete() {
        return xmlSaved && databaseUpdated;
    }

    public boolean isPartial() {
        return xmlSaved && !databaseUpdated;
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence;

import java.io.File;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public final class BootDbRepository {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(BootDbRepository.class.getName());

    static final String SQL_CREATE_TABLE_DEVICES
            = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Devices("
            + "DeviceUuId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,"
            + "DriverName TEXT,"
            + "DeviceKey TEXT,"
            + "DeviceUrl TEXT,"
            + "DeviceName TEXT,"
            + "DeviceDescription TEXT,"
            + "DeviceEnable TEXT,"
            + "Md5 TEXT)";

    static final String SQL_CREATE_TABLE_GROUPS
            = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Groups("
            + "GroupUuid TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,"
            + "DeviceUuid TEXT,"
            + "GroupName TEXT,"
            + "GroupDescription TEXT,"
            + "GroupScantime TEXT,"
            + "GroupEnable TEXT,"
            + "Md5 TEXT)";

    static final String SQL_CREATE_TABLE_ITEMS
            = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Items("
            + "ItemUuid TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,"
            + "DeviceUuid TEXT,"
            + "GroupUuid TEXT,"
            + "ItemName TEXT,"
            + "ItemDescription TEXT,"
            + "ItemTag TEXT,"
            + "ItemEnable TEXT,"
            + "Md5 TEXT)";
    /* TODO: todos estos serian los PVType 
        s5time, s7date s7time s7tod s7dat s7counter s7di s7ai s7ao s7valve
        s7vlv s7avlv s7motor boolean byte double float int long short
        string ubyte uint ulong ushort
     */
    static final String SQL_CREATE_TABLE_PVRECORDS
            = "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS PvRecords("
            + "PvUuId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,"
            + "PvName TEXT,"
            + "PvType TEXT,"
            + "PvId TEXT,"
            + "PvOffset TEXT,"
            + "PvDescriptor TEXT,"
            + "PvScanTime TEXT,"
            + "PvScanEnable TEXT,"
            + "PvWriteEnable TEXT,"
            + "PvDisplayLimitLow TEXT,"
            + "PvDisplayLimitHigh TEXT,"
            + "PvDisplayDescription TEXT,"
            + "PvDisplayFormat TEXT,"
            + "PvDisplayUnits TEXT,"
            + "PvControlLimitLow TEXT,"
            + "PvControlLimitHigh TEXT,"
            + "PvControlMinStep TEXT,"
            + "Md5 TEXT)";

    static final String SQL_INSERT_DEVICE
            = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO Devices(DeviceUuId, DriverName, DeviceKey, DeviceUrl, DeviceName, DeviceDescription, DeviceEnable, Md5) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";

    static final String SQL_INSERT_GROUP
            = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO Groups(GroupUuid, DeviceUuid, GroupName, GroupDescription, GroupScantime, GroupEnable, Md5) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";

    static final String SQL_INSERT_ITEM
            = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO Items(ItemUuid, DeviceUuid, GroupUuid, ItemName, ItemDescription, ItemTag, ItemEnable, Md5) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";

    static final String SQL_INSERT_PV
            = "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO PvRecords(PvUuId, PvName, PvType, PvId, PvOffset, PvDescriptor, PvScanTime, PvScanEnable, PvWriteEnable, PvDisplayLimitLow, PvDisplayLimitHigh, PvDisplayDescription, PvDisplayFormat, PvDisplayUnits, PvControlLimitLow, PvControlLimitHigh, PvControlMinStep, Md5) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)";

    public static boolean createDB(String rutaCarpeta) {
        File folder = new File(rutaCarpeta);
        File archivoDB = new File(folder, "boot.db");
        String url = "jdbc:sqlite:" + archivoDB;

        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
            if (conn != null) {
                stmt.execute(SQL_CREATE_TABLE_DEVICES);
                stmt.execute(SQL_CREATE_TABLE_GROUPS);
                stmt.execute(SQL_CREATE_TABLE_ITEMS);
                stmt.execute(SQL_CREATE_TABLE_PVRECORDS);
            }
            return true;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error al crear las tablas", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static boolean insertDeviceConfig(String rutaCarpeta, DeviceConfigData device, CommConfigData comms) {
        File archivoDB = new File(rutaCarpeta, "boot.db");
        String url = "jdbc:sqlite:" + archivoDB;

        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url)) {
            String areaInvalida = firstAreaWithoutGroup(comms);
            if (areaInvalida != null) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                        "No se guardÃ³ el dispositivo '{0}': el Ã¡rea '{1}' no tiene grupo de escaneo.",
                        new Object[]{device != null ? device.getDeviceName() : "",
                            areaInvalida});
                return false;
            }
            String faltaClave = keyProblem(device);
            if (faltaClave != null) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se guardÃ³ el dispositivo: {0}", faltaClave);
                return false;
            }
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                insertDevice(conn, device, comms);
                conn.commit();
            } catch (SQLException ex) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            }
            return true;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error insertando datos en SQLite", e);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Motivo por el que un dispositivo no se puede escribir, o {@code null} si vale.
     *
     * <p>La clave no se sustituye por un valor inventado: si falta, el dispositivo no se
     * guarda. Antes se rellenaba con una clave fija y el runtime la recibÃ­a de verdad.
     */
    static String keyProblem(DeviceConfigData device) {
        if (device == null) {
            return "no hay ficha de dispositivo que guardar.";
        }
        String clave = device.getDeviceKey();
        if (clave == null || clave.isBlank()) {
            return "el dispositivo '" + device.getDeviceName() + "' no tiene clave."
                    + " EdÃ­telo y rellene el campo Key antes de guardar.";
        }
        return null;
    }

    static void insertDevice(Connection conn, DeviceConfigData device, CommConfigData comms)
            throws SQLException {

        String deviceUuid = (device != null && device.getUuid() != null && !device.getUuid().isEmpty())
                ? device.getUuid() : UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        String deviceName = (device != null) ? device.getDeviceName() : (comms != null ? comms.getDeviceName() : "");
        try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(SQL_INSERT_DEVICE)) {
            pstmt.setString(1, deviceUuid);
            pstmt.setString(2, device != null ? device.getProtocol() : null);
            pstmt.setString(3, device != null ? device.getDeviceKey() : null);
            pstmt.setString(4, device != null ? device.getSpecificParameters() : null);
            pstmt.setString(5, deviceName);
            pstmt.setString(6, device != null ? device.getDescription() : null);
            pstmt.setString(7, (device != null && !device.isEnabled()) ? "FALSE" : "TRUE");
            // El dispositivo no tiene md5 en el modelo. Se deja vacio hasta que se decida
            // si la columna se usa; nada la lee hoy.
            pstmt.setString(8, "");
            pstmt.executeUpdate();
        }

        if (comms != null) {
            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(SQL_INSERT_GROUP)) {
                for (CommConfigData.GroupConfig g : orEmpty(comms.getGroups())) {
                    pstmt.setString(1, g.getUuid());
                    pstmt.setString(2, deviceUuid);
                    pstmt.setString(3, g.getName());
                    pstmt.setString(4, g.getDescription());
                    pstmt.setString(5, g.getScantime());
                    pstmt.setString(6, g.isEnable() ? "TRUE" : "FALSE");
                    pstmt.setString(7, g.getMd5());
                    pstmt.executeUpdate();
                }
            }

            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(SQL_INSERT_ITEM)) {
                for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig item : orEmpty(comms.getItems())) {
                    pstmt.setString(1, item.getUuid());
                    pstmt.setString(2, deviceUuid);
                    pstmt.setString(3, item.getGroupUuid());
                    pstmt.setString(4, item.getName());
                    pstmt.setString(5, item.getDescription());
                    pstmt.setString(6, item.getTag());
                    pstmt.setString(7, item.isEnable() ? "TRUE" : "FALSE");
                    pstmt.setString(8, item.getMd5());
                    pstmt.executeUpdate();
                }
            }

            try (PreparedStatement pstmt = conn.prepareStatement(SQL_INSERT_PV)) {
                for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : orEmpty(comms.getPvs())) {
                    pstmt.setString(1, pv.getUuid());
                    pstmt.setString(2, pv.getName());
                    pstmt.setString(3, pv.getType());
                    pstmt.setString(4, pv.getAreaUuid());
                    pstmt.setString(5, pv.getOffset());
                    pstmt.setString(6, pv.getDescriptorText());
                    pstmt.setString(7, pv.getScanTime());
                    pstmt.setString(8, pv.isScanEnable() ? "TRUE" : "FALSE");
                    pstmt.setString(9, pv.isWriteEnable() ? "TRUE" : "FALSE");
                    pstmt.setString(10, pv.getDisplayLimitLow());
                    pstmt.setString(11, pv.getDisplayLimitHigh());
                    pstmt.setString(12, pv.getDisplayDescription());
                    pstmt.setString(13, pv.getDisplayFormat());
                    pstmt.setString(14, pv.getDisplayUnits());
                    pstmt.setString(15, pv.getControlLimitLow());
                    pstmt.setString(16, pv.getControlLimitHigh());
                    pstmt.setString(17, pv.getControlMinStep());
                    pstmt.setString(18, pv.getMd5());
                    pstmt.executeUpdate();
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static String firstAreaWithoutGroup(CommConfigData comms) {
        if (comms == null) {
            return null;
        }
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig item : orEmpty(comms.getItems())) {
            String groupUuid = item.getGroupUuid();
            if (groupUuid == null || groupUuid.isEmpty()) {
                return item.getName();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static RebuildResultado rebuildWithReason(File dbFolder, CommunicationsConfig config) {
        if (dbFolder == null || config == null) {
            return RebuildResultado.fallo("no hay proyecto ni configuracion que guardar");
        }
        if (!dbFolder.isDirectory()) {
            return RebuildResultado.fallo("la carpeta de boot.db no existe");
        }
        try {
            return new BootDbWriter(new File(dbFolder, "boot.db")).write(config);
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Error reconstruyendo boot.db", ex);
            return RebuildResultado.fallo(ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public static boolean rebuild(File dbFolder, CommunicationsConfig config) {
        return rebuildWithReason(dbFolder, config).success();
    }

    private BootDbRepository() {
    }

    static <T> List<T> orEmpty(List<T> list) {
        return list == null ? List.of() : list;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;


final class BootDbWriter {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(BootDbWriter.class.getName());
    static final int SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

    private static final String[] SQL_CREATE_TABLES = {
        BootDbRepository.SQL_CREATE_TABLE_DEVICES,
        BootDbRepository.SQL_CREATE_TABLE_GROUPS,
        BootDbRepository.SQL_CREATE_TABLE_ITEMS,
        BootDbRepository.SQL_CREATE_TABLE_PVRECORDS
    };

    private final File target;

    /** Por que fallo el ultimo write(), para poder decÃ­rselo al operador. */
    private String ultimoMotivo;

    BootDbWriter(File target) {
        this.target = target;
    }

    String motivoDelFallo() {
        return ultimoMotivo;
    }

    RebuildResultado write(CommunicationsConfig config) throws SQLException {
        File temporal = new File(target.getParentFile(), target.getName() + ".tmp");
        deleteTemp(temporal);

        try {
            buildTemporary(temporal, config);
        } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
            // El temporal se va: un fallo aqui no debe dejar nada a medias junto al panel.
            deleteTemp(temporal);
            ultimoMotivo = ex.getMessage();
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo construir " + temporal.getName()
                    + "; se conserva el boot.db anterior", ex);
            return RebuildResultado.fallo(ultimoMotivo);
        }

        try {
            // La conexion esta cerrada a proposito antes de mover: SQLite puede dejar el
            // temporal pillado en Windows si se mueve con el fichero abierto.
            Files.move(temporal.toPath(), target.toPath(),
                    StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ex) {
            // Algunos sistemas de ficheros no dan soporte; el contenido ya esta escrito y
            // verificado, asi que un reemplazo normal sigue siendo mejor que nada.
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                    "El sistema de ficheros no permite mover atÃ³micamente boot.db;"
                            + " se reemplaza directamente", ex);
            try {
                Files.move(temporal.toPath(), target.toPath(),
                        StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            } catch (IOException failure) {
                deleteTemp(temporal);
                ultimoMotivo = "no se pudo reemplazar " + target.getName() + ": " + failure.getMessage();
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo reemplazar " + target.getName(), failure);
                return RebuildResultado.fallo(ultimoMotivo);
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            deleteTemp(temporal);
            ultimoMotivo = "no se pudo reemplazar " + target.getName() + ": " + ex.getMessage();
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo reemplazar " + target.getName(), ex);
            return RebuildResultado.fallo(ultimoMotivo);
        }
        ultimoMotivo = null;
        return RebuildResultado.ok();
    }

    private void buildTemporary(File temporal, CommunicationsConfig config) throws SQLException {
        String url = "jdbc:sqlite:" + temporal;
        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection(url)) {

            try (Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
                stmt.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON");
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);
            try {
                try (Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
                    for (String sql : SQL_CREATE_TABLES) {
                        stmt.execute(sql);
                    }
                }
                for (DeviceConfigData device : config.getDevices()) {
                    CommConfigData comms = config.getComms(device.getUuid());
                    // La misma comprobacion que hace insertDeviceConfig. Sin ella, un area
                    // sin grupo de escaneo se colaba en la base: al separarse el insertado
                    // del dispositivo de la validacion, esta se habia quedado fuera.
                    String areaInvalida = BootDbRepository.firstAreaWithoutGroup(comms);
                    if (areaInvalida != null) {
                        throw new SQLException("el dispositivo '"
                                + (device != null ? device.getDeviceName() : "?")
                                + "' tiene el Ã¡rea '" + areaInvalida
                                + "' sin grupo de escaneo");
                    }
                    String faltaClave = BootDbRepository.keyProblem(device);
                    if (faltaClave != null) {
                        throw new SQLException(faltaClave);
                    }
                    BootDbRepository.insertDevice(conn, device, comms);
                }
                try (Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
                    stmt.execute("PRAGMA user_version=" + SCHEMA_VERSION);
                }
                conn.commit();
            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            }
        }
    }

    private void deleteTemp(File temporal) {
        for (String sufijo : new String[]{"", "-wal", "-shm", "-journal"}) {
            try {
                Files.deleteIfExists(new File(temporal.getParentFile(),
                        temporal.getName() + sufijo).toPath());
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo borrar el temporal de boot.db", ex);
            }
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence;

public record RebuildResultado(boolean success, String reason) {

    public static RebuildResultado ok() {
        return new RebuildResultado(true, null);
    }

    public static RebuildResultado fallo(String reason) {
        return new RebuildResultado(false,
                reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "no se pudo reconstruir boot.db" : reason);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

final class CommsXmlIdentifiers {

    public static final String PLCOPEN_NS = "http://www.plcopen.org/xml/tc6_0201";
    public static final String DEVICE_NS = "Device";
    public static final String COMMS_NS = "Comunications";
    public static final String DEVICE_DATA_NAME = "http://apache.org/plc4x/malbec/device";
    public static final String COMMS_DATA_NAME = "http://apache.org/plc4x/malbec/comms";

    private CommsXmlIdentifiers() {
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.function.Function;
import javax.xml.namespace.QName;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlCursor;
import org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlObject;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.AddData;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument.Project.Instances.Configurations;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument.Project.Instances.Configurations.Configuration;

final class DeviceXmlMapper {

    private record Field<T>(String name, Function<T, String> read) {
    }

    private static final List<Field<DeviceConfigData>> DEVICE_ATTRS = List.of(
            new Field<>("uuid", DeviceConfigData::getUuid),
            new Field<>("enabled", d -> Boolean.toString(d.isEnabled())),
            new Field<>("s88Uuid", DeviceConfigData::getS88Uuid));

    private static final List<Field<DeviceConfigData>> DEVICE_ELEMENTS = List.of(
            new Field<>("brand", DeviceConfigData::getBrand),
            new Field<>("model", DeviceConfigData::getModel),
            new Field<>("protocol", DeviceConfigData::getProtocol),
            new Field<>("deviceKey", DeviceConfigData::getDeviceKey),
            new Field<>("description", DeviceConfigData::getDescription),
            new Field<>("s88Node", DeviceConfigData::getS88Node),
            new Field<>("specificParameters", DeviceConfigData::getSpecificParameters));

    private static final List<Field<CommConfigData.GroupConfig>> GROUP_FIELDS = List.of(
            new Field<>("uuid", CommConfigData.GroupConfig::getUuid),
            new Field<>("name", CommConfigData.GroupConfig::getName),
            new Field<>("description", CommConfigData.GroupConfig::getDescription),
            new Field<>("scantime", CommConfigData.GroupConfig::getScantime),
            new Field<>("enable", g -> Boolean.toString(g.isEnable())),
            new Field<>("md5", CommConfigData.GroupConfig::getMd5));

    private static final List<Field<CommConfigData.ItemConfig>> ITEM_FIELDS = List.of(
            new Field<>("uuid", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getUuid),
            new Field<>("name", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getName),
            new Field<>("description", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getDescription),
            new Field<>("tag", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getTag),
            new Field<>("enable", i -> Boolean.toString(i.isEnable())),
            new Field<>("group", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getGroupUuid),
            new Field<>("md5", CommConfigData.ItemConfig::getMd5));

    private static final List<Field<CommConfigData.PvConfig>> PV_FIELDS = List.of(
            new Field<>("uuid", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getUuid),
            new Field<>("name", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getName),
            new Field<>("type", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getType),
            new Field<>("id", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getAreaUuid),
            new Field<>("offset", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getOffset),
            new Field<>("descriptor", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDescriptorText),
            new Field<>("scanTime", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getScanTime),
            new Field<>("scanEnable", p -> Boolean.toString(p.isScanEnable())),
            new Field<>("writeEnable", p -> Boolean.toString(p.isWriteEnable())),
            new Field<>("displayLimitLow", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDisplayLimitLow),
            new Field<>("displayLimitHigh", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDisplayLimitHigh),
            new Field<>("displayDescription", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDisplayDescription),
            new Field<>("displayFormat", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDisplayFormat),
            new Field<>("displayUnits", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getDisplayUnits),
            new Field<>("controlLimitLow", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getControlLimitLow),
            new Field<>("controlLimitHigh", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getControlLimitHigh),
            new Field<>("controlMinStep", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getControlMinStep),
            new Field<>("s88Path", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getS88Path),
            new Field<>("md5", CommConfigData.PvConfig::getMd5));

    private DeviceXmlMapper() {
    }

    public static Configuration writeDevice(DeviceConfigData device, Configurations configurations) {
        Configuration configuration = configurations.addNewConfiguration();
        configuration.setName(device.getDeviceName());
        AddData addData = configuration.addNewAddData();
        AddData.Data data = addData.addNewData();
        data.setName(CommsXmlIdentifiers.DEVICE_DATA_NAME);
        data.setHandleUnknown(AddData.Data.HandleUnknown.PRESERVE);

        XmlObject root = parse(skeleton("device", CommsXmlIdentifiers.DEVICE_NS, DEVICE_ELEMENTS));
        XmlCursor cursor = root.newCursor();
        try {
            cursor.toFirstChild();
            for (Field<DeviceConfigData> field : DEVICE_ATTRS) {
                cursor.setAttributeText(new QName(field.name()), value(field, device));
            }
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
        fillChildText(root, DEVICE_ELEMENTS, device);
        appendAnyContent(data, root);
        return configuration;
    }

    public static void writeComms(CommConfigData comms, Configuration configuration) {
        if (comms == null) {
            return;
        }
        AddData addData = configuration.getAddData();
        if (addData == null) {
            addData = configuration.addNewAddData();
        }
        AddData.Data data = addData.addNewData();
        data.setName(CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_DATA_NAME);
        data.setHandleUnknown(AddData.Data.HandleUnknown.PRESERVE);

        XmlObject root = parse("<comm xmlns=\"" + CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_NS + "\">"
                + "<groups/><items/><pvs/></comm>");
        appendRows(root, "groups", "group", GROUP_FIELDS, comms.getGroups());
        appendRows(root, "items", "item", ITEM_FIELDS, comms.getItems());
        appendRows(root, "pvs", "pv", PV_FIELDS, comms.getPvs());
        appendAnyContent(data, root);
    }

    public static DeviceConfigData readDevice(Configuration configuration) {
        AddData addData = configuration.getAddData();
        if (addData == null) {
            return null;
        }
        for (AddData.Data data : addData.getDataArray()) {
            if (CommsXmlIdentifiers.DEVICE_DATA_NAME.equals(data.getName())) {
                XmlObject device = firstChild(data, "device");
                if (device == null) {
                    return null;
                }
                Properties pDevice = new Properties();
                Map<String, String> attrs = readFields(DEVICE_ATTRS, device);
                for (Field<DeviceConfigData> field : DEVICE_ELEMENTS) {
                    pDevice.put(field.name(), text(device, field.name()));
                }
                pDevice.put("deviceName", configuration.getName());
                pDevice.put("enable", Boolean.valueOf(attrs.get("enabled")));
                pDevice.put("uuid", attrs.get("uuid"));
                pDevice.put("s88Uuid", attrs.get("s88Uuid"));
                return new DeviceConfigData(pDevice);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static CommConfigData readComms(Configuration configuration) {
        AddData addData = configuration.getAddData();
        if (addData == null) {
            return null;
        }
        for (AddData.Data data : addData.getDataArray()) {
            if (CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_DATA_NAME.equals(data.getName())) {
                XmlObject comm = firstChild(data, "comm");
                if (comm == null) {
                    return null;
                }
                List<CommConfigData.GroupConfig> groups = new ArrayList<>();
                for (XmlObject g : children(comm, "groups", "group")) {
                    Map<String, String> m = readFields(GROUP_FIELDS, g);
                    groups.add(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig(
                            m.get("uuid"), m.get("name"), m.get("description"),
                            m.get("scantime"), Boolean.parseBoolean(m.get("enable")),
                            m.get("md5")));
                }
                List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> items = new ArrayList<>();
                for (XmlObject i : children(comm, "items", "item")) {
                    Map<String, String> m = readFields(ITEM_FIELDS, i);
                    items.add(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(
                            m.get("uuid"), m.get("name"), m.get("description"),
                            m.get("tag"), Boolean.parseBoolean(m.get("enable")),
                            m.get("md5"), m.get("group")));
                }
                List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvs = new ArrayList<>();
                for (XmlObject p : children(comm, "pvs", "pv")) {
                    Map<String, String> m = readFields(PV_FIELDS, p);
                    pvs.add(new CommConfigData.PvConfig(
                            m.get("uuid"), m.get("name"), m.get("type"),
                            m.get("id"),
                            m.get("offset"), m.get("descriptor"), m.get("scanTime"),
                            Boolean.parseBoolean(m.get("scanEnable")),
                            Boolean.parseBoolean(m.get("writeEnable")), m.get("displayLimitLow"),
                            m.get("displayLimitHigh"), m.get("displayDescription"),
                            m.get("displayFormat"), m.get("displayUnits"), m.get("controlLimitLow"),
                            m.get("controlLimitHigh"), m.get("controlMinStep"), m.get("md5"),
                            m.get("s88Path")));
                }
                return new CommConfigData(configuration.getName(), groups, items, pvs);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static <T> void appendRows(XmlObject root, String container, String element,
            List<Field<T>> fields, List<T> rows) throws RuntimeException {
        if (rows == null || rows.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        String ns = CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_NS;
        for (T row : rows) {
            XmlObject child = parse("<" + element + " xmlns=\"" + ns + "\"/>");
            XmlCursor source = child.newCursor();
            try {
                source.toFirstChild();
                for (Field<T> field : fields) {
                    source.setAttributeText(new QName(field.name()), value(field, row));
                }
                source.toFirstChild();
                XmlCursor target = root.newCursor();
                try {
                    target.toFirstChild();
                    target.toFirstChild();
                    while (!container.equals(localName(target))) {
                        if (!target.toNextSibling()) {
                            throw new IllegalStateException("No se encontro el contenedor " + container);
                        }
                    }
                    target.push();
                    target.toEndToken();
                    source.copyXml(target);
                    target.pop();
                } finally {
                    target.dispose();
                }
            } finally {
                source.dispose();
            }
        }
    }

    private static <T> void fillChildText(XmlObject root, List<Field<T>> fields, T value)
            throws RuntimeException {
        for (int i = 0; i < fields.size(); i++) {
            XmlCursor cursor = root.newCursor();
            try {
                cursor.toFirstChild();
                cursor.toFirstChild();
                for (int k = 0; k < i; k++) {
                    cursor.toNextSibling();
                }
                cursor.toFirstContentToken();
                cursor.insertChars(value(fields.get(i), value));
            } finally {
                cursor.dispose();
            }
        }
    }

    private static <T> String value(Field<T> field, T target) {
        String raw = field.read().apply(target);
        return raw == null ? "" : raw;
    }

    private static <T> Map<String, String> readFields(List<Field<T>> fields, XmlObject element) {
        Map<String, String> values = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Field<T> field : fields) {
            values.put(field.name(), attr(element, field.name()));
        }
        return values;
    }

    /** Esqueleto con un hijo vacio por cada elemento de la tabla; los nombres no llevan datos. */
    private static String skeleton(String element, String ns, List<? extends Field<?>> children) {
        StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder("<").append(element).append(" xmlns=\"").append(ns).append("\">");
        for (Field<?> child : children) {
            xml.append('<').append(child.name()).append("/>");
        }
        return xml.append("</").append(element).append('>').toString();
    }

    private static void appendAnyContent(AddData.Data data, XmlObject content) {
        XmlCursor cursor = data.newCursor();
        try {
            cursor.toEndToken();
            XmlCursor source = content.newCursor();
            try {
                source.toFirstChild();
                source.copyXml(cursor);
            } finally {
                source.dispose();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo serializar el contenido dev/comms", e);
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
    }

    private static List<XmlObject> children(XmlObject comm, String container, String localName) {
        List<XmlObject> result = new ArrayList<>();
        XmlObject parent = firstChild(comm, container);
        if (parent == null) {
            return result;
        }
        XmlCursor cursor = parent.newCursor();
        try {
            if (cursor.toFirstChild()) {
                do {
                    if (localName.equals(cursor.getName().getLocalPart())) {
                        result.add(cursor.getObject());
                    }
                } while (cursor.toNextSibling());
            }
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static XmlObject firstChild(XmlObject parent, String localName) {
        XmlCursor cursor = parent.newCursor();
        try {
            if (cursor.toFirstChild()) {
                do {
                    QName name = cursor.getName();
                    if (name != null && localName.equals(name.getLocalPart())) {
                        return cursor.getObject();
                    }
                } while (cursor.toNextSibling());
            }
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String localName(XmlCursor cursor) {
        QName name = cursor.getName();
        return name == null ? "" : name.getLocalPart();
    }

    private static String attr(XmlObject element, String name) {
        XmlCursor cursor = element.newCursor();
        try {
            String value = cursor.getAttributeText(new QName(name));
            return value == null ? "" : value;
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
    }

    private static String text(XmlObject parent, String name) {
        XmlCursor cursor = parent.newCursor();
        try {
            if (cursor.toFirstChild()) {
                do {
                    QName current = cursor.getName();
                    if (current != null && name.equals(current.getLocalPart())) {
                        String value = cursor.getTextValue();
                        return value == null ? "" : value;
                    }
                } while (cursor.toNextSibling());
            }
            return "";
        } finally {
            cursor.dispose();
        }
    }

    private static XmlObject parse(String xml) {
        try {
            return XmlObject.Factory.parse(xml);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo preparar el esqueleto del bloque dev/comms", e);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlOptions;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument.Project.Instances.Configurations;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument.Project.Instances.Configurations.Configuration;

public final class PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl implements CommConfigRepository {

    public static final String TEMPLATE = """
            <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
            <project xmlns="http://www.plcopen.org/xml/tc6_0201"
                     xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                     xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.plcopen.org/xml/tc6_0201 http://www.plcopen.org/xml/tc6_0201.xsd">
              <fileHeader companyName="Malbec" productName="Malbec Communication" productVersion="1.0" creationDateTime="2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
              <contentHeader name="MalbecCommunication">
                <coordinateInfo>
                  <fbd><scaling x="1" y="1"/></fbd>
                  <ld><scaling x="1" y="1"/></ld>
                  <sfc><scaling x="1" y="1"/></sfc>
                </coordinateInfo>
              </contentHeader>
              <types>
                <dataTypes/>
                <pous/>
              </types>
              <instances>
                <configurations/>
              </instances>
            </project>
            """;

    private static final XmlOptions SAVE_OPTIONS = new XmlOptions()
            .setSavePrettyPrint()
            .setSavePrettyPrintIndent(2)
            .setSaveAggressiveNamespaces()
            .setSaveSuggestedPrefixes(Map.of(
                    CommsXmlIdentifiers.DEVICE_NS, "d",
                    CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_NS, "c"));

    private final CommConfigStorage storage;

    public PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(CommConfigStorage storage) {
        this.storage = storage;
    }

    @Override
    public CommunicationsConfig load() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = parseOrNew();
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        for (Configuration configuration : configurationsOf(doc)) {
            DeviceConfigData device = DeviceXmlMapper.readDevice(configuration);
            if (device != null) {
                config.addDevice(device);
                CommConfigData comms = DeviceXmlMapper.readComms(configuration);
                if (comms != null) {
                    config.upsertComms(device.getUuid(), comms);
                }
            }
        }
        return config;
    }

    @Override
    public void save(CommunicationsConfig config) throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = parseOrNew();
        Configurations configurations = findConfigurations(doc);
        removeAllConfigurations(configurations);
        for (DeviceConfigData device : config.getDevices()) {
            Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(device, configurations);
            DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(config.getComms(device.getUuid()), configuration);
        }
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        doc.save(buffer, SAVE_OPTIONS);
        storage.write(buffer.toByteArray());
    }

    private ProjectDocument parseOrNew() throws Exception {
        String text = storage.open();
        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) {
            text = TEMPLATE;
        }
        return ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(text);
    }

    private static List<Configuration> configurationsOf(ProjectDocument doc) {
        return new ArrayList<>(findConfigurations(doc).getConfigurationList());
    }

    private static Configurations findConfigurations(ProjectDocument doc) {
        return doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();
    }

    private static void removeAllConfigurations(Configurations configurations) {
        configurations.setConfigurationArray(new Configuration[0]);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;

public class AllenBradleyPanelBuilder implements DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder {

    private String host = "";
    private String transport = "tcp";
    private String port = "";
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public void initForModel(DeviceModel model) {
    }

    @Override
    public String getProtocol() {
        return "eip";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDefaultTransport() {
        return transport;
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransportOptions() {
        return new String[]{"tcp"};
    }

    @Override
    public void setTransport(String transport) {
        this.transport = transport;
    }

    @Override
    public void setPort(String port) {
        this.port = port;
    }

    @Override
    public void setHost(String host) {
        this.host = host;
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> defaults = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        defaults.put("path", "");
        defaults.put("slot", "0");
        return defaults;
    }

    @Override
    public void addParameter(String key, String value) {
        params.put(key, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeLastParameter() {
        if (!params.isEmpty()) {
            String lastKey = null;
            for (String key : params.keySet()) {
                lastKey = key;
            }
            params.remove(lastKey);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void clearParameters() {
        params.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameters() {
        return new LinkedHashMap<>(params);
    }

    @Override
    public String getSpecificParametersAsString() {
        return DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl(getProtocol(), transport, host, port, params);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.List;

public class CommConfigData {

    private final String deviceName;
    private final List<GroupConfig> groups;
    private final List<ItemConfig> items;
    private final List<PvConfig> pvs;

    public CommConfigData(String deviceName, List<GroupConfig> groups, List<ItemConfig> items,
            List<PvConfig> pvs) {
        this.deviceName = deviceName;
        this.groups = groups;
        this.items = items;
        this.pvs = pvs;
    }

    public String getDeviceName() {
        return deviceName;
    }

    public List<GroupConfig> getGroups() {
        return groups;
    }

    public List<ItemConfig> getItems() {
        return items;
    }

    public List<PvConfig> getPvs() {
        return pvs;
    }

    /**
     * Grupo de escaneo: cada area pertenece como mucho a uno.
     */
    public record GroupConfig(String uuid, String name, String description, String scantime,
            boolean enable, String md5) {

        public String getUuid() {
            return uuid;
        }

        public String getName() {
            return name;
        }

        public String getDescription() {
            return description;
        }

        public String getScantime() {
            return scantime;
        }

        public boolean isEnable() {
            return enable;
        }

        public String getMd5() {
            return md5;
        }

        public GroupConfig withUuid(String uuid) {
            return new GroupConfig(uuid, name, description, scantime, enable, md5);
        }

        public GroupConfig withName(String name) {
            return new GroupConfig(uuid, name, description, scantime, enable, md5);
        }

        public GroupConfig withDescription(String description) {
            return new GroupConfig(uuid, name, description, scantime, enable, md5);
        }

    }

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationStore;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.SaveResult;

public class CommunicationWizardController {

    // El asistente no calcula hashes. Se deja vacio hasta que se decida si la columna
    // Md5 se usa; los md5 que ya vienen de un comunicacion.xml existente se respetan.
    private static final String MD5_PENDIENTE = "";

    private final CommunicationStore store;
    private final CommunicationWizardState state;

    /** Tags ya desglosados, para no repetir el parseo en cada validacion (T3.7). */
    private final Map<String, MemoryTag> cacheTags = new HashMap<>();

    public CommunicationWizardController(CommunicationStore store, CommunicationWizardState state) {
        this.store = store;
        this.state = state;
    }

    public CommunicationWizardState getState() {
        return state;
    }

    public CommunicationStore getStore() {
        return store;
    }

    // --- Device ---------------------------------------------------------

    public List<DeviceConfigData> getAvailableDevices() {
        return store != null ? store.getDevices() : new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void selectDevice(DeviceConfigData device) {
        state.setSelectedDevice(device);
        if (device != null && store != null) {
            state.reset(store.getComms(device.getUuid()));
        } else {
            state.reset(null);
        }
    }

    // --- Groups --------------------------------------------------------------

    public void addGroup(String uuid, String name, String desc, String scan, boolean enable) {
        state.getGroups().add(
                new CommConfigData.GroupConfig(uuid, name, desc, scan, enable, MD5_PENDIENTE));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
    }

    public void updateGroup(String uuid, String desc, String scan, boolean enable) {
        CommConfigData.GroupConfig actual = state.groupByUuid(uuid);
        if (actual == null) {
            return;
        }
        String scantime = scan != null && !scan.isEmpty() ? scan : actual.getScantime();
        int idx = state.indexOfGroup(uuid);
        state.getGroups().set(idx, actual
                .withDescription(desc)
                .withScantime(scantime)
                .withEnable(enable));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
    }

    public List<String> deleteGroup(String uuid) {
        CommConfigData.GroupConfig group = state.groupByUuid(uuid);
        if (group == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<String> areasDelGrupo = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : state.getItems()) {
            if (group.getUuid().equals(i.getGroupUuid())) {
                areasDelGrupo.add(i.getName());
            }
        }
        if (!areasDelGrupo.isEmpty()) {
            return areasDelGrupo;
        }
        state.getGroups().remove(state.indexOfGroup(uuid));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
        return List.of();
    }

    // --- Items -------------------------------------------------------

    public void addItem(String uuid, String name, String desc, String tag, boolean enable, String groupUuid) {
        state.getItems().add(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(
                uuid, name, desc, tag, enable, MD5_PENDIENTE, groupUuid));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
        cacheTags.clear();
    }

    public void updateItem(String uuid, String desc, String tag, boolean enable) {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig actual = state.itemByUuid(uuid);
        if (actual == null) {
            return;
        }
        int idx = state.indexOfItem(uuid);
        state.getItems().set(idx, actual
                .withDescription(desc)
                .withTag(tag)
                .withEnable(enable));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
        cacheTags.clear();
    }

    public List<String> deleteItem(String uuid) {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig item = state.itemByUuid(uuid);
        if (item == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : state.getPvs()) {
            if (item.getUuid().equals(pv.getAreaUuid())) {
                names.add(pv.getName());
            }
        }
        state.getPvs().removeIf(pv -> uuid.equals(pv.getAreaUuid()));
        state.getItems().remove(state.indexOfItem(uuid));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
        cacheTags.clear();
        return names;
    }

    // --- Pv Records -----------------------------------------------------

    public void addPv(CommConfigData.PvConfig pv) {
        state.getPvs().add(pv);
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
    }

    public void updatePv(String uuid, String descriptorText, String scanTime,
            boolean scanEnable, boolean writeEnable, String displayLimitLow,
            String displayLimitHigh, String displayDescription, String displayFormat,
            String displayUnits, String controlLimitLow, String controlLimitHigh,
            String controlMinStep) {
        CommConfigData.PvConfig actual = state.pvByUuid(uuid);
        if (actual == null) {
            return;
        }
        int idx = state.indexOfPv(uuid);
        state.getPvs().set(idx, actual
                .withDescriptorText(descriptorText)
                .withScanTime(scanTime)
                .withScanEnable(scanEnable)
                .withWriteEnable(writeEnable)
                .withDisplayLimitLow(displayLimitLow)
                .withDisplayLimitHigh(displayLimitHigh)
                .withDisplayDescription(displayDescription)
                .withDisplayFormat(displayFormat)
                .withDisplayUnits(displayUnits)
                .withControlLimitLow(controlLimitLow)
                .withControlLimitHigh(controlLimitHigh)
                .withControlMinStep(controlMinStep));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
    }

    public boolean deletePv(String uuid) {
        if (state.pvByUuid(uuid) == null) {
            return false;
        }
        state.getPvs().remove(state.indexOfPv(uuid));
        state.setUnsavedChanges(true);
        return true;
    }

    public static String pvMd5() {
        return MD5_PENDIENTE;
    }

    public static String groupMd5() {
        return MD5_PENDIENTE;
    }

    private MemoryTag parseTag(String tag) {
        if (tag == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return cacheTags.computeIfAbsent(tag, MemoryTag::parse);
    }

    private MemoryTag tagOf(String areaUuid) {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig item = state.itemByUuid(areaUuid);
        return item == null ? null : parseTag(item.getTag());
    }

    public DataType lockedType(String areaUuid) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag != null && tag.family() != null) {
            List<DataType> candidates = DataType.candidates(tag.family(), tag.codeBits());
            if (candidates.size() == 1) {
                return candidates.get(0);
            }
        }
        return typeOfFirstVariable(areaUuid);
    }

    private List<DataType> tagCandidates(String areaUuid) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag == null || tag.family() == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return DataType.candidates(tag.family(), tag.codeBits());
    }

    private DataType typeOfFirstVariable(String areaUuid) {
        List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> areaPvs = state.pvsOfArea(areaUuid);
        return areaPvs.isEmpty() ? null : DataType.find(areaPvs.get(0).getType());
    }

    public List<DataType> typesAllowed(String areaUuid) {
        if (state.itemByUuid(areaUuid) == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<DataType> candidates = tagCandidates(areaUuid);
        DataType elegido = typeOfFirstVariable(areaUuid);
        if (elegido != null && (candidates.isEmpty() || candidates.contains(elegido))) {
            return List.of(elegido);
        }
        if (!candidates.isEmpty()) {
            return candidates;
        }
        DataType fijado = lockedType(areaUuid);
        if (fijado != null) {
            return List.of(fijado);
        }
        List<DataType> todos = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DataType t : DataType.values()) {
            if (t.isEnabled()) {
                todos.add(t);
            }
        }
        return todos;
    }

    public String nextOffset(String areaUuid, DataType type) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag == null || type == null || !type.isEnabled() || tag.byteCapacity() <= 0) {
            return null;
        }
        Set<Integer> ocupados = bitsOcupados(areaUuid);
        int byteInicio = Math.max(0, tag.firstByte());
        int desde = byteInicio * 8;
        int hasta = desde + tag.byteCapacity() * 8;
        int width = type.slotBits();
        
        for (int bits = desde; bits + width <= hasta; bits += width) {
            if (free(bits, width, ocupados)) {
                return type.bitAddressed()
                        ? (bits / 8) + "." + (bits % 8)
                        : String.valueOf(bits / 8);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean free(int desde, int width, Set<Integer> ocupados) {
        for (int bit = desde; bit < desde + width; bit++) {
            if (ocupados.contains(bit)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private Set<Integer> bitsOcupados(String areaUuid) {
        Set<Integer> ocupados = new HashSet<>();
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : state.pvsOfArea(areaUuid)) {
            int bits = bitsOfOffset(pv.getOffset());
            if (bits < 0) {
                continue;
            }
            DataType type = DataType.find(pv.getType());
            int width = type == null ? 8 : type.slotBits();
            for (int bit = bits; bit < bits + width; bit++) {
                ocupados.add(bit);
            }
        }
        return ocupados;
    }

    private static int bitsOfOffset(String offset) {
        if (offset == null || offset.isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        try {
            int punto = offset.indexOf('.');
            int byteOffset = Integer.parseInt(punto < 0 ? offset : offset.substring(0, punto));
            int bitOffset = punto < 0 ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(offset.substring(punto + 1));
            return byteOffset * 8 + bitOffset;
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    public int areaCapacityInBytes(String areaUuid) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag == null) {
            return -1;
        }
        int bytes = tag.byteCapacity();
        return bytes > 0 ? bytes : -1;
    }

    public int freeAreaSlots(String areaUuid, DataType type) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag == null || type == null || !type.isEnabled()) {
            return -1;
        }
        int bytes = tag.byteCapacity();
        if (bytes <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }
        return Math.max(0, (bytes * 8) / type.slotBits() - state.pvsOfArea(areaUuid).size());
    }

    public int freeAreaBytes(String areaUuid) {
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        if (tag == null || tag.byteCapacity() <= 0) {
            return -1;
        }

        return Math.max(0, tag.byteCapacity() - bytesOcupados(areaUuid));
    }

    private int bytesOcupados(String areaUuid) {
        int total = 0;
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : state.pvsOfArea(areaUuid)) {
            DataType type = DataType.find(pv.getType());
            if (type == null) {
                continue;
            }
            total += (type.slotBits() + 7) / 8;
        }
        return total;
    }

    public CommConfigData.ItemConfig overlappingArea(String tag, String uuidEnEdicion) {
        MemoryTag nuevo = parseTag(tag);
        if (nuevo == null) {
            return null;
        }
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : state.getItems()) {
            if (uuidEnEdicion != null && uuidEnEdicion.equals(i.getUuid())) {
                continue;
            }
            if (nuevo.overlaps(parseTag(i.getTag()))) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public CommConfigData.ItemConfig areaWithSameTag(String tag, String uuidEnEdicion) {
        MemoryTag t = parseTag(tag);
        if (t == null || t.hasAddress()) {
            return null;
        }
        String buscado = normalizeText(tag);
        if (buscado.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : state.getItems()) {
            if (uuidEnEdicion != null && uuidEnEdicion.equals(i.getUuid())) {
                continue;
            }
            MemoryTag suyo = parseTag(i.getTag());
            if (suyo != null && suyo.hasAddress()) {
                continue;
            }
            if (buscado.equals(normalizeText(i.getTag()))) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String normalizeText(String tag) {
        if (tag == null) {
            return "";
        }
        String t = tag.trim();
        if (t.startsWith("%")) {
            t = t.substring(1).trim();
        }
        int dosPuntos = t.lastIndexOf(':');
        if (dosPuntos > 0) {
            t = t.substring(0, dosPuntos).trim();
        }
        return t.replaceAll("\\s+", "").toUpperCase();
    }

    public MemoryTag areaTag(String areaUuid) {
        return tagOf(areaUuid);
    }

    private static final List<DataType> TIPOS_PLC_ESTANDAR = List.of(
        DataType.BOOLEAN, DataType.BYTE, DataType.WORD, DataType.DWORD,
        DataType.SINT, DataType.USINT, DataType.INT, DataType.UINT,
        DataType.DINT, DataType.UDINT, DataType.LINT, DataType.ULINT,
        DataType.REAL, DataType.LREAL, DataType.TIME, DataType.DATE,
        DataType.TIME_OF_DAY, DataType.DATE_AND_TIME, DataType.STRING
    );

    public List<DataType> typesForCombo(String areaUuid) {
        List<DataType> combo = new ArrayList<>(typesAllowed(areaUuid));
        for (DataType t : DataType.values()) {
            if (!combo.contains(t) && !t.isEnabled()) {
                combo.add(t);
            }
        }
        if (combo.isEmpty()) {
            combo.addAll(TIPOS_PLC_ESTANDAR);
        }
        return combo;
    }

    public boolean typeAllowed(String areaUuid, DataType type) {
        return type != null && type.isEnabled()
                && typesAllowed(areaUuid).contains(type);
    }

    public boolean areaAcceptsType(String areaUuid, String plantType, DataType locked) {
        if (locked == null || plantType == null || plantType.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }

        if (!typesAllowed(areaUuid).contains(locked)) {
            return false;
        }
        MemoryTag tag = tagOf(areaUuid);
        List<DataType> posibles = tag == null
                ? List.of()
                : DataType.candidates(plantType, tag.codeBits());
        if (!posibles.isEmpty()) {
            return posibles.contains(locked);
        }
        DataType exacto = DataType.findIgnoreCase(plantType);
        return exacto == null || exacto == locked;
    }

    // --- variables de planta ya asignadas -----------------------------------

    public static String pvKey(String path, String name) {
        return (path == null || path.isEmpty() ? "" : path + "/") + name;
    }

    public Set<String> getUsedPvKeys() {
        Set<String> usedKeys = new HashSet<>();
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : state.getPvs()) {
            usedKeys.add(pvKey(pv.getS88Path(), pv.getName()));
        }
        return usedKeys;
    }
    public List<String> areasWithoutGroupNames() {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : state.areasWithoutGroup()) {
            names.add(i.getName());
        }
        return names;
    }

    public boolean hasAreasWithoutGroup() {
        return !state.areasWithoutGroup().isEmpty();
    }

    public SaveResult saveAll() {
        if (store == null || state.getSelectedDevice() == null) {
            return SaveResult.notSaved(
                    "no hay ningun dispositivo seleccionado sobre el que guardar");
        }
        CommConfigData config = new CommConfigData(
                state.getSelectedDevice().getDeviceName(),
                new ArrayList<>(state.getGroups()),
                new ArrayList<>(state.getItems()),
                new ArrayList<>(state.getPvs()));
        store.upsertComms(state.getSelectedDevice().getUuid(), config);
        SaveResult resultado = store.save();
            state.setUnsavedChanges(!resultado.isComplete());
            return resultado;
    }
}
