package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;

public class CommunicationWizardState {

    private DeviceConfigData selectedDevice;
    private final List<CommConfigData.GroupConfig> groups = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> items = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvs = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean cambiosSinGuardar = false;
    private boolean missingGroupsWarned = false;
    
    public void reset(CommConfigData comms) {
        groups.clear();
        items.clear();
        pvs.clear();
        cambiosSinGuardar = false;
        missingGroupsWarned = false;

        if (comms != null) {
            if (comms.getGroups() != null) {
                groups.addAll(comms.getGroups());
            }
            if (comms.getItems() != null) {
                items.addAll(comms.getItems());
            }
            if (comms.getPvs() != null) {
                pvs.addAll(comms.getPvs());
            }
        }
    }

    public CommConfigData.GroupConfig groupByUuid(String uuid) {
        int idx = indexOfGroup(uuid);
        return idx < 0 ? null : groups.get(idx);
    }

    public CommConfigData.ItemConfig itemByUuid(String uuid) {
        int idx = indexOfItem(uuid);
        return idx < 0 ? null : items.get(idx);
    }

    public CommConfigData.PvConfig pvByUuid(String uuid) {
        int idx = indexOfPv(uuid);
        return idx < 0 ? null : pvs.get(idx);
    }
    public int indexOfGroup(String uuid) {
        return find(groups, g -> sameUuid(uuid, g.getUuid()));
    }

    public int indexOfItem(String uuid) {
        return find(items, i -> sameUuid(uuid, i.getUuid()));
    }

    public int indexOfPv(String uuid) {
        return find(pvs, p -> sameUuid(uuid, p.getUuid()));
    }

    private static boolean sameUuid(String uuid, String otro) {
        return uuid != null && uuid.equals(otro);
    }

    private static <T> int find(List<T> lista, java.util.function.Predicate<T> coincide) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lista.size(); i++) {
            if (coincide.test(lista.get(i))) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    public String groupNameOf(String itemUuid) {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig item = itemByUuid(itemUuid);
        if (item == null || item.getGroupUuid() == null || item.getGroupUuid().isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        for (CommConfigData.GroupConfig g : groups) {
            if (g.getUuid().equals(item.getGroupUuid())) {
                return g.getName();
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    public List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> areasWithoutGroup() {
        List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> sinGrupo = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : items) {
            if (groupNameOf(i.getUuid()).isEmpty()) {
                sinGrupo.add(i);
            }
        }
        return sinGrupo;
    }

    public List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvsOfArea(String areaUuid) {
        List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (areaUuid == null) {
            return result;
        }
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig pv : pvs) {
            if (areaUuid.equals(pv.getAreaUuid())) {
                result.add(pv);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public DeviceConfigData getSelectedDevice() {
        return selectedDevice;
    }

    public void setSelectedDevice(DeviceConfigData selectedDevice) {
        this.selectedDevice = selectedDevice;
    }

    public List<CommConfigData.GroupConfig> getGroups() {
        return groups;
    }

    public List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> getItems() {
        return items;
    }

    public List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> getPvs() {
        return pvs;
    }

    

    public boolean hasUnsavedChanges() {
        return cambiosSinGuardar;
    }

    public void setUnsavedChanges(boolean cambiosSinGuardar) {
        this.cambiosSinGuardar = cambiosSinGuardar;
    }

    public boolean isMissingGroupsWarned() {
        return missingGroupsWarned;
    }

    public void setMissingGroupsWarned(boolean missingGroupsWarned) {
        this.missingGroupsWarned = missingGroupsWarned;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public enum DataType {

    BOOLEAN("boolean", 1, true, true),
    BYTE("byte", 1, false, true),
    WORD("word", 2, false, true),
    DWORD("dword", 4, false, true),
    SINT("sint", 1, false, true),
    USINT("usint", 1, false, true),
    INT("int", 4, false, true),
    UINT("uint", 4, false, true),
    DINT("dint", 4, false, true),
    UDINT("udint", 4, false, true),
    LINT("lint", 8, false, true),
    ULINT("ulint", 8, false, true),
    REAL("real", 4, false, true),
    LREAL("lreal", 8, false, true),
    // Legacy types (kept for backward compatibility)
    UBYTE("ubyte", 1, false, true),
    SHORT("short", 2, false, true),
    USHORT("ushort", 2, false, true),
    FLOAT("float", 4, false, true),
    LONG("long", 8, false, true),
    ULONG("ulong", 8, false, true),
    DOUBLE("double", 8, false, true),

    /** TamaÃ±o variable: no admite cÃ¡lculo de offset por ahora (esperar por definir). */
    STRING("string", 0, false, false),
    TIME("time", 4, false, true),
    DATE("date", 2, false, true),
    TIME_OF_DAY("tod", 4, false, true),
    DATE_AND_TIME("dt", 8, false, true),
    S5TIME("s5time", 0, false, false),
    S7DATE("s7date", 0, false, false),
    S7TIME("s7time", 0, false, false),
    S7TOD("s7tod", 0, false, false),
    S7DAT("s7dat", 0, false, false),
    S7COUNTER("s7counter", 0, false, false),
    S7DI("s7di", 0, false, false),
    S7AI("s7ai", 0, false, false),
    S7AO("s7ao", 0, false, false),
    S7VALVE("s7valve", 0, false, false),
    S7VLV("s7vlv", 0, false, false),
    S7AVLV("s7avlv", 0, false, false),
    S7MOTOR("s7motor", 0, false, false);

    private final String name;
    private final int byteSize;
    private final boolean bitAddressed;
    private final boolean enabled;


    private static final Set<String> ESPECIFICOS_DE_SIEMENS = Set.of(
            "S5TIME", "S7DATE", "S7TIME", "S7TOD", "S7DAT", "S7COUNTER", "S7DI", "S7AI",
            "S7AO", "S7VALVE", "S7VLV", "S7AVLV", "S7MOTOR");
    private static final Map<String, DataType> POR_NOMBRE = new HashMap<>();
    private static final Map<String, DataType> POR_NOMBRE_SIN_MAYUSCULAS = new HashMap<>();
    private static final String CONCATENATED_NAMES;

    static {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (DataType t : values()) {
            POR_NOMBRE.put(t.name, t);
            POR_NOMBRE_SIN_MAYUSCULAS.put(t.name.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT), t);
            if (text.length() > 0) {
                text.append(", ");
            }
            text.append(t.name);
        }
        CONCATENATED_NAMES = text.toString();
    }

    DataType(String name, int byteSize, boolean bitAddressed, boolean enabled) {
        this.name = name;
        this.byteSize = byteSize;
        this.bitAddressed = bitAddressed;
        this.enabled = enabled;
    }

    public String label() {
        return name;
    }

    public int byteSize() {
        return byteSize;
    }

    public boolean bitAddressed() {
        return bitAddressed;
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return enabled;
    }
    public boolean isProtocolSpecific() {
        return ESPECIFICOS_DE_SIEMENS.contains(name());
    }

    public int slotBits() {
        return bitAddressed ? 1 : byteSize * 8;
    }

    public static DataType find(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        return POR_NOMBRE.get(name);
    }

    public static DataType findIgnoreCase(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        return POR_NOMBRE_SIN_MAYUSCULAS.get(name.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    /** Nombres de todos los tipos, separados por coma. Se calcula una sola vez. */
    public static String names() {
        return CONCATENATED_NAMES;
    }

    public static List<DataType> candidates(String familia, int bitsArea) {
        if (familia == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return switch (familia.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BYTE" -> bitsArea == 8 ? List.of(BYTE, UBYTE) : List.of();
            case "UBYTE" -> List.of(BYTE, UBYTE);
            case "WORD" -> bitsArea == 16 ? List.of(WORD) : List.of();
            case "INTEGER" -> switch (bitsArea) {
                case 16 -> List.of(SHORT, USHORT);
                case 32 -> List.of(INT, UINT);
                case 64 -> List.of(LONG, ULONG);
                default -> List.of();
            };
            case "REAL" -> isReal(bitsArea) ? List.of(FLOAT, DOUBLE) : List.of();
            case "BOOL" -> bitsArea == 1 || bitsArea == 8 ? List.of(BOOLEAN) : List.of();
            case "INT", "UINT" -> List.of(SHORT, USHORT);
            case "DINT", "UDINT", "DWORD" -> List.of(INT, UINT);
            case "LINT", "ULINT", "LWORD" -> List.of(LONG, ULONG);
            case "SINT", "USINT" -> List.of(BYTE, UBYTE);
            case "CHAR" -> List.of(BYTE, UBYTE);
            case "WCHAR" -> bitsArea == 16 ? List.of(WORD) : List.of(BYTE, UBYTE);
            case "RAW_BYTE_ARRAY" -> List.of(BYTE, UBYTE);
            case "USHORT" -> List.of(SHORT, USHORT);
            case "ULONG" -> List.of(LONG, ULONG);
            case "LREAL" -> List.of(DOUBLE);
            default -> List.of();
        };
    }
    
    private static boolean isReal(int bitsArea) {
        return bitsArea == 0 || bitsArea >= 32;
    }

    public static int bitsOfType(String name) {
        if (name == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        return switch (name.toUpperCase()) {
            case "BOOL" -> 1;
            case "BYTE", "SINT", "USINT", "CHAR" -> 8;
            case "WORD", "INT", "UINT", "WCHAR" -> 16;
            case "DWORD", "DINT", "UDINT", "REAL" -> 32;
            case "LWORD", "LINT", "ULINT", "LREAL" -> 64;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }
}

        sb.append("Brand=").append(brand).append("\n");
        sb.append("Model=").append(model).append("\n");
        sb.append("Protocol=").append(protocol).append("\n");
        sb.append("Description=").append(description).append("\n");
        sb.append("UUID=").append(uuid).append("\n");
        sb.append("Enabled=").append(enabled).append("\n");
        sb.append("S88Node=").append(s88Node).append("\n");
        sb.append("S88UUID=").append(s88Uuid).append("\n");
        sb.append("--- Specific Parameters ---\n");
        sb.append(specificParameters);
        return sb.toString();

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public interface DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder {

    void initForModel(DeviceModel model);

    String getProtocol();

    void setHost(String host);

    void setTransport(String transport);

    void setPort(String port);

    String getDefaultTransport();

    String[] getTransportOptions();

    LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults();

    default LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults(String transport) {
        return getParameterDefaults();
    }

    default String getHostLabel() {
        return "Host/IP:";
    }

    default boolean isPortApplicable() {
        return true;
    }

    default void retainParameters(Set<String> validKeys) {
    }

    void addParameter(String key, String value);

    void removeLastParameter();

    void clearParameters();

    LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameters();

    String getSpecificParametersAsString();

    static String assembleUrl(String protocol, String transport, String host, String port,
            LinkedHashMap<String, String> params) {
        return assembleUrl(protocol, transport, host, port, params, true);
    }

    static String assembleUrl(String protocol, String transport, String host, String port,
            LinkedHashMap<String, String> params, boolean includePort) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.append(protocol == null ? "" : protocol);
        if (transport != null && !transport.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sb.append(":").append(transport);
        }
        sb.append("://").append(hostInBrackets(host == null ? "" : host));
        if (includePort && port != null && !port.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sb.append(":").append(port.trim());
        }
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> ordered = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (params != null) {
            ordered.putAll(params);
        }
        if (!ordered.isEmpty()) {
            sb.append("?");
            int i = 0;
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : ordered.entrySet()) {
                if (i++ > 0) {
                    sb.append("&");
                }
                // Los valores se codifican para que un '&' o un '=' dentro de ellos no
                // rompa el formato. Un valor sin caracteres reservados se escribe igual
                // que antes, asi que las URLs existentes no cambian.
                sb.append(UrlDisassembler.codificar(e.getKey()))
                        .append("=")
                        .append(UrlDisassembler.codificar(e.getValue() == null ? "" : e.getValue()));
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    private static String hostInBrackets(String host) {
        String limpio = host.trim();
        if (limpio.startsWith("[") && limpio.endsWith("]")) {
            return limpio;
        }
        if (!limpio.contains(":")) {
            return limpio;
        }
        return "[" + limpio + "]";
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

public final class MemoryTag {

    private final String raw;
    private final String block;
    private final String code;
    private final int baseByte;
    private final int bit;
    private final int firstByte;
    private final int lastByte;
    private final int amount;
    private final String family;
    private final boolean hasRange;

    private MemoryTag(String raw, String block, String code, int baseByte, int bit,
                      int firstByte, int lastByte, int amount, String family, boolean hasRange) {
        this.raw = raw;
        this.block = block;
        this.code = code;
        this.baseByte = baseByte;
        this.bit = bit;
        this.firstByte = firstByte;
        this.lastByte = lastByte;
        this.amount = amount;
        this.family = family;
        this.hasRange = hasRange;
    }

    public static MemoryTag parse(String raw) {
        MemoryTagParser.Partes partes = MemoryTagParser.parse(raw);
        if (partes == null) {
            return null;
        }
        return new MemoryTag(partes.original(), partes.block(), partes.code(),
                partes.baseByte(), partes.bit(), partes.firstByte(), partes.lastByte(),
                partes.amount(), partes.family(), partes.hasRange());
    }

    public boolean hasAddress() {
        return !code.isEmpty() || baseByte >= 0;
    }

    public String raw() {
        return raw;
    }

    public String block() {
        return block;
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    public int baseByte() {
        return baseByte;
    }

    public int bit() {
        return bit;
    }

    public boolean hasRange() {
        return hasRange;
    }

    public String family() {
        return family;
    }

    public int firstByte() {
        return firstByte;
    }

    public int lastByte() {
        return lastByte;
    }

    /** false solo si hay rango escrito y va de mayor a menor: -1 significa "no hay rango". */
    public boolean validRange() {
        return lastByte < 0 || lastByte >= firstByte;
    }

    public int byteCapacity() {
        if (firstByte >= 0 && lastByte >= 0) {
            return Math.max(0, lastByte - firstByte + 1);
        }

        if (amount > 0) {
            return amount;
        }

        if (!hasAddress() || bit >= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        if ("STRING".equalsIgnoreCase(family)) {
            return 254;
        }
        if ("WSTRING".equalsIgnoreCase(family)) {
            return 254 * 2;
        }

        int bitsCodigo = codeBits();
        if (bitsCodigo > 0) {
            return bitsCodigo / 8;
        }

        int bitsTipo = DataType.bitsOfType(family);
        return bitsTipo > 0 ? bitsTipo / 8 : 0;
    }

    public int codeBits() {
        if (bit >= 0) return 1;
        if (code.isEmpty()) return 0;
        String c = code.toUpperCase();
        if (c.endsWith("X")) return 1;
        if (c.endsWith("LD") || c.endsWith("L")) return 64;
        if (c.endsWith("B")) return 8;
        if (c.endsWith("W")) return 16;
        if (c.endsWith("D")) return 32;
        return 0;
    }

    public int startByteEffective() {
        int base = Math.max(0, baseByte);
        int offset = Math.max(0, firstByte);
        return base + offset;
    }

    public int endByteEffective() {
        int start = startByteEffective();
        int cap = byteCapacity();
        return start + Math.max(1, cap) - 1;
    }

    public boolean overlaps(MemoryTag otro) {
        if (otro == null || !hasAddress() || !otro.hasAddress()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!block.equalsIgnoreCase(otro.block)) {
            return false;
        }
        // ComparaciÃ³n de bits explÃ­citos en la misma posiciÃ³n de byte
        if (bit >= 0 && otro.bit >= 0) {
            return baseByte == otro.baseByte && bit == otro.bit;
        }
        // VerificaciÃ³n de intersecciÃ³n de rangos de bytes
        return this.startByteEffective() <= otro.endByteEffective() && 
               this.endByteEffective() >= otro.startByteEffective();
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

final class MemoryTagParser {

    private static final Pattern LONGITUD = Pattern.compile("\\((\\d+)\\)");
    private static final Pattern CORCHETE = Pattern.compile("\\[\\s*(\\d*)\\s*]");
    private static final Pattern RANGO = Pattern.compile("\\[\\s*(\\d+)\\s*\\.\\.\\s*(\\d+)\\s*]");

    private static final Pattern DB_CON_CODIGO
            = Pattern.compile("^([A-Za-z]+)(\\d+)\\.DB([A-Za-z]*)(\\d+)$");
    private static final Pattern DB_CORTO = Pattern.compile("^([A-Za-z]+)(\\d+):(\\d+)$");
    private static final Pattern CODIGO_Y_NUMERO
            = Pattern.compile("^((?:[MIQE]|[MIQE][BWDL]|C|T|D|DB|DBI|LD))(\\d+)$");
    private static final Pattern SOLO_NUMERO = Pattern.compile("^(\\d+)$");
    private static final Pattern type
            = Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\\s*\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*\\))?(\\s*\\[\\s*\\d*\\s*])?$");

    private MemoryTagParser() {
    }

    record Partes(String original, String block, String code, int baseByte, int bit,
            int firstByte, int lastByte, int amount, String family, boolean hasRange) {

    }

    private record ConTipo(String address, String type) {

    }

    private record Ubicacion(String block, String code, int number) {

    }

    private static int parseIntSafe(String grupo) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(grupo);
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    static Partes parse(String raw) {
        if (raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        String resto = raw.trim();
        if (resto.startsWith("%")) {
            resto = resto.substring(1);
        }

        ConTipo conTipo = splitType(resto);
        String type = null;
        int amount = -1;
        if (conTipo.type() != null) {
            type = conTipo.type();
            Matcher mt = LONGITUD.matcher(type);
            if (mt.find()) {
                amount = parseIntSafe(mt.group(1));
            }
            Matcher mc = CORCHETE.matcher(type);
            if (mc.find() && !mc.group(1).isEmpty()) {
                amount = parseIntSafe(mc.group(1));
            }
            type = type.replaceFirst("\\s*\\(\\s*\\d+\\s*\\)", "")
                    .replaceFirst("\\s*\\[\\s*\\d*\\s*]", "")
                    .trim().toUpperCase();
        }

        String direccionTags = conTipo.address();
        int firstByte = -1;
        int lastByte = -1;
        boolean rangoExplicito = false;

        Matcher rango = RANGO.matcher(direccionTags);
        if (rango.find()) {
            firstByte = parseIntSafe(rango.group(1));
            lastByte = parseIntSafe(rango.group(2));
            direccionTags = rango.replaceFirst("");
            rangoExplicito = true;
        } else {
            Matcher indice = CORCHETE.matcher(direccionTags);
            if (indice.find()) {
                String valor = indice.group(1);
                firstByte = valor.isEmpty() ? -1 : parseIntSafe(valor);
                lastByte = firstByte;
                direccionTags = indice.replaceFirst("");
            }
        }

        String address = direccionTags.replaceAll("\\s+", "");
        int bit = -1;
        int posPunto = address.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (posPunto > 0 && posPunto < address.length() - 1) {
            String posibleBit = address.substring(posPunto + 1);
            if (posibleBit.matches("[0-7]")) {
                bit = parseIntSafe(posibleBit);
                address = address.substring(0, posPunto);
            }
        }

        Ubicacion ubicacion = locate(address);
        return new Partes(raw, ubicacion.block(), ubicacion.code(), ubicacion.number(), bit,
                firstByte, lastByte, amount, type, rangoExplicito);
    }

    private static Ubicacion locate(String address) {
        Matcher dbCodigo = DB_CON_CODIGO.matcher(address);
        if (dbCodigo.matches()) {
            String code = dbCodigo.group(3).isEmpty() ? "" : "DB" + dbCodigo.group(3).toUpperCase();
            return new Ubicacion(dbCodigo.group(1).toUpperCase() + dbCodigo.group(2),
                    code, parseIntSafe(dbCodigo.group(4)));
        }
        Matcher dbCorto = DB_CORTO.matcher(address);
        if (dbCorto.matches()) {
            return new Ubicacion(dbCorto.group(1).toUpperCase() + dbCorto.group(2),
                    "", parseIntSafe(dbCorto.group(3)));
        }
        Matcher codNum = CODIGO_Y_NUMERO.matcher(address);
        if (codNum.matches()) {
            return new Ubicacion("", codNum.group(1).toUpperCase(),
                    parseIntSafe(codNum.group(2)));
        }
        Matcher soloNum = SOLO_NUMERO.matcher(address);
        if (soloNum.matches()) {
            return new Ubicacion("", "", parseIntSafe(soloNum.group(1)));
        }
        return new Ubicacion(address, "", -1);
    }

    private static ConTipo splitType(String text) {
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            if (text.charAt(i) == ':' && i + 1 < text.length()) {
                String tras = text.substring(i + 1).trim();
                if (type.matcher(tras).matches()) {
                    return new ConTipo(text.substring(0, i), tras);
                }
            }
        }
        return new ConTipo(text, null);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;

public class ModbusPanelBuilder implements DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder {

    public enum ModbusVariant {
        TCP("modbus-tcp", "tcp", new String[]{"tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}),
        RTU("modbus-rtu", "serial", new String[]{"serial", "tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}),
        ASCII("modbus-ascii", "serial", new String[]{"serial", "tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"});

        private final String code;
        private final String defaultTransport;
        private final String[] transports;

        ModbusVariant(String code, String defaultTransport, String[] transports) {
            this.code = code;
            this.defaultTransport = defaultTransport;
            this.transports = transports;
        }

        public String getCode() {
            return code;
        }

        public String getDefaultTransport() {
            return defaultTransport;
        }

        public String[] getTransports() {
            return transports;
        }

        public static ModbusVariant fromCode(String code) {
            for (ModbusVariant variant : values()) {
                if (variant.code.equalsIgnoreCase(code == null ? "" : code)) {
                    return variant;
                }
            }
            return TCP;
        }
    }

    private static final LinkedHashMap<String, String> COMMON_OPTIONS = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    }

    private static final Map<String, LinkedHashMap<String, String>> TRANSPORT_OPTIONS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    static {

    private String host = "";
    private String protocol = "modbus-tcp";
    private String transport = "tcp";
    private String port = "";
    private ModbusVariant variant = ModbusVariant.TCP;
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public void initForModel(DeviceModel model) {
        String p = model != null ? model.getProtocol() : null;
        variant = ModbusVariant.fromCode(p);
        protocol = variant.getCode();
        transport = variant.getDefaultTransport();
    }

    @Override
    public String getProtocol() {
        return protocol;
    }

    @Override
    public String getDefaultTransport() {
        return transport;
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransportOptions() {
        return variant.getTransports();
    }

    @Override
    public void setTransport(String transport) {
        this.transport = transport;
    }

    @Override
    public void setPort(String port) {
        this.port = port;
    }

    @Override
    public void setHost(String host) {
        this.host = host;
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults() {
        return getParameterDefaults(transport);
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults(String transport) {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> defaults = new LinkedHashMap<>(COMMON_OPTIONS);
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> options = TRANSPORT_OPTIONS.get(transport);
        if (options != null) {
            defaults.putAll(options);
        }
        return defaults;
    }

    @Override
    public String getHostLabel() {
        return "serial".equals(transport) ? "Puerto/Dispositivo:" : "Host/IP:";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPortApplicable() {
        return !"serial".equals(transport);
    }

    @Override
    public void retainParameters(Set<String> validKeys) {
        params.keySet().retainAll(validKeys == null ? List.of() : validKeys);
    }

    @Override
    public void addParameter(String key, String value) {
        params.put(key, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeLastParameter() {
        if (!params.isEmpty()) {
            String lastKey = null;
            for (String key : params.keySet()) {
                lastKey = key;
            }
            params.remove(lastKey);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void clearParameters() {
        params.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameters() {
        return new LinkedHashMap<>(params);
    }

    @Override
    public String getSpecificParametersAsString() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> ordered = new LinkedHashMap<>(params);
        return DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl(
                getProtocol(), transport, host, port, ordered, isPortApplicable());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public final class PanelBuilderRegistry {
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(PanelBuilderRegistry.class.getName());

    private static final String MARCA_SIEMENS = "siemens";
    private static final String MARCA_ALLEN_BRADLEY = "allen bradley";
    private static final String MARCA_MODBUS = "modbus";

    private final Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand;
    private final Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder> defaultSupplier;

    private PanelBuilderRegistry(Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand,
            Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder> defaultSupplier) {
        this.byBrand = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byBrand);
        this.defaultSupplier = defaultSupplier;
    }

    public static PanelBuilderRegistry withDefaults() {
        Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        byBrand.put(MARCA_SIEMENS, SiemensPanelBuilder::new);
        byBrand.put(MARCA_ALLEN_BRADLEY, AllenBradleyPanelBuilder::new);
        byBrand.put(MARCA_MODBUS, ModbusPanelBuilder::new);
        return new PanelBuilderRegistry(byBrand, SiemensPanelBuilder::new);
    }

    public static PanelBuilderRegistry from(Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand,
            Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder> defaultSupplier) {
        Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> copia = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        byBrand.forEach((brand, factory) -> copia.put(normalizar(brand), factory));
        return new PanelBuilderRegistry(copia, defaultSupplier);
    }

public DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder forBrand(String brand) {
        String clave = normalizar(brand);
        Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder> factory = byBrand.get(clave);
        if (factory != null) {
            return factory.get();
        }
        if (!clave.isEmpty()) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                    "La marca ''{0}'' no tiene panel de conexion propio; se usa el de"
                            + " {1} por defecto. Las URLs saldran como si fuera de ese"
                            + " protocolo.",
                    new Object[]{brand, defaultBuilder().getProtocol()});
        }
        return defaultSupplier.get();
    }

    public DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder defaultBuilder() {
        return defaultSupplier.get();
    }

    public Set<String> brands() {
        return byBrand.keySet();
    }

    public boolean registers(String brand) {
        return byBrand.containsKey(normalizar(brand));
    }

    private static String normalizar(String brand) {
        return brand == null ? "" : brand.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

    private String host = "";
    private String transport = "";
    private String port = "";
    private final LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public void initForModel(DeviceModel model) {
        params.put("controller-type", model.getModel().replace("-", "_"));
    }

    @Override
    public String getProtocol() {
        return "s7";
    }

    @Override
    public String getDefaultTransport() {
        return transport;
    }

    @Override
    public String[] getTransportOptions() {
        return new String[]{"", "cotp"};
    }

    @Override
    public void setTransport(String transport) {
        this.transport = transport;
    }

    @Override
    public void setPort(String port) {
        this.port = port;
    }

    @Override
    public void setHost(String host) {
        this.host = host;
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults() {
        return getParameterDefaults(transport);
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults(String transport) {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> defaults = new LinkedHashMap<>(DRIVER_OPTIONS);
        defaults.putAll(COTP_OPTIONS);
        return defaults;
    }

    @Override
    public String getHostLabel() {
        return "Host/IP:";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isPortApplicable() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public void retainParameters(Set<String> validKeys) {
        params.keySet().retainAll(validKeys == null ? List.of() : validKeys);
    }

    @Override
    public void addParameter(String key, String value) {
        params.put(key, value);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeLastParameter() {
        if (!params.isEmpty()) {
            String lastKey = null;
            for (String key : params.keySet()) {
                lastKey = key;
            }
            params.remove(lastKey);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void clearParameters() {
        params.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameters() {
        return new LinkedHashMap<>(params);
    }

    @Override
    public String getSpecificParametersAsString() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> ordered = new LinkedHashMap<>(params);
        String controllerType = ordered.remove("controller-type");
        if (controllerType != null) {
            ordered.put("controller-type", controllerType);
        }
        return DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl(getProtocol(), transport, host, port, ordered);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.TagIssue.Gravedad;

public final class TagDiagnostico {

    private static final Pattern content = Pattern.compile("\\[([^\\]]*)\\]");
    private static final Pattern CONTENIDO_VALIDO =
            Pattern.compile("\\s*\\d+\\s*(\\.\\.\\s*\\d+\\s*)?");
    private static final Pattern CARACTERES_RAROS =
            Pattern.compile("[^A-Za-z0-9_.:%\\[\\]()\\-\\s]");
    private static final Pattern NUMEROS = Pattern.compile("\\d+");

    private TagDiagnostico() {
    }

    public static List<TagIssue> errors(String tag) {
        List<TagIssue> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tag == null) {
            return errors;
        }
        String t = tag.trim();
        if (t.isEmpty()) {
            return errors;
        }
        revisarCorchetes(t, errors);
        revisarCaracteres(t, errors);
        reviewNumbers(t, errors);

        MemoryTag m = MemoryTag.parse(t);
        if (m != null && !m.hasAddress()) {
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.NO_ES_DIRECCION, Gravedad.ERROR, t));
        }
        if (m != null && m.family() != null
                && DataType.candidates(m.family(), m.codeBits()).isEmpty()) {
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.SIN_TIPOS, Gravedad.ERROR,
                    m.family(), DataType.names()));
        }
        return errors;
    }

    public static List<TagIssue> warnings(String tag) {
        List<TagIssue> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
        if (tag == null) {
            return warnings;
        }
        String t = tag.trim();
        if (t.isEmpty()) {
            return warnings;
        }
        MemoryTag m = MemoryTag.parse(t);
        if (m != null && m.hasAddress() && m.byteCapacity() == 0) {
            warnings.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.SIN_TAMANO, Gravedad.AVISO));
        }
        return warnings;
    }

    private static void reviewNumbers(String t, List<TagIssue> errors) {
        Matcher m = NUMEROS.matcher(t);
        while (m.find()) {
            String number = m.group();
            if (number.length() < 10) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                Integer.parseInt(number);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
                errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.NUMERO_DEMASIADO_GRANDE, Gravedad.ERROR, number));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void revisarCorchetes(String t, List<TagIssue> errors) {
        int abiertos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < t.length(); i++) {
            char c = t.charAt(i);
            if (c == '[') {
                abiertos++;
            } else if (c == ']') {
                abiertos--;
            }
        }
        if (abiertos > 0) {
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.CORCHETE_SIN_CERRAR, Gravedad.ERROR));
        } else if (abiertos < 0) {
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.CORCHETE_SOBRANTE, Gravedad.ERROR));
        }
        Matcher m = content.matcher(t);
        while (m.find()) {
            String dentro = m.group(1);
            if (dentro.isBlank() || CONTENIDO_VALIDO.matcher(dentro).matches()) {
                continue;
            }
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.RANGO_INVALIDO, Gravedad.ERROR, dentro.trim()));
        }
    }

    private static void revisarCaracteres(String t, List<TagIssue> errors) {
        Matcher m = CARACTERES_RAROS.matcher(t);
        StringBuilder raros = new StringBuilder();
        while (m.find()) {
            raros.append(m.group());
        }
        if (raros.length() > 0) {
            errors.add(new TagIssue(TagIssue.CARACTERES_RAROS, Gravedad.ERROR, raros.toString()));
        }
    }
}

import java.util.List;

public record TagIssue(String codigo, Gravedad gravedad, List<String> args) {

    public enum Gravedad {
        ERROR,
        AVISO
    }

    /** CÃ³digos de los avisos que este diagnostico sabe emitir. */
    public static final String CORCHETE_SIN_CERRAR = "tag.corchete.sinCerrar";
    public static final String CORCHETE_SOBRANTE = "tag.corchete.sobrante";

    public static final String SIN_TAMANO = "tag.sin.tamano";
    public static final String NUMERO_DEMASIADO_GRANDE = "tag.numero.demasiadoGrande";

    public TagIssue(String codigo, Gravedad gravedad, String... args) {
        this(codigo, gravedad, List.of(args));
    }

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;


public final class UrlDisassembler {

    private UrlDisassembler() {
    }

    public record Partes(String protocol, String transport, String host, String port,
                 LinkedHashMap<String, String> params) {
    }

    public static Partes disassemble(String url) {
        if (url == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String limpio = url.trim();
        int separador = limpio.indexOf("://");
        if (separador < 0) {
            return null;
        }

        String izquierda = limpio.substring(0, separador);
        String resto = limpio.substring(separador + 3);

        int colonTransporte = izquierda.indexOf(':');
        String protocol = colonTransporte < 0 ? izquierda : izquierda.substring(0, colonTransporte);
        String transport = colonTransporte < 0 ? "" : izquierda.substring(colonTransporte + 1);

        int interrogacion = resto.indexOf('?');
        String hostPort = interrogacion < 0 ? resto : resto.substring(0, interrogacion);
        String query = interrogacion < 0 ? "" : resto.substring(interrogacion + 1);

        String host;
        String port;
        if (hostPort.startsWith("[")) {
            // Direccion IPv6 entre corchetes. Sin esto, 'lastIndexOf(:)' partia por el
            // medio de la direccion y '::1' se leia como host '[' y puerto ':1]'.
            int cierre = hostPort.indexOf(']');
            if (cierre > 0) {
                host = hostPort.substring(1, cierre);
                String detras = hostPort.substring(cierre + 1);
                port = detras.startsWith(":") ? detras.substring(1) : "";
            } else {
                // Corchete sin cerrar: se toma todo como host, mejor que cortar la direccion.
                host = hostPort;
                port = "";
            }
        } else {
            host = hostPort;
            port = "";
            int colonPuerto = hostPort.lastIndexOf(':');
            if (colonPuerto >= 0) {
                host = hostPort.substring(0, colonPuerto);
                port = hostPort.substring(colonPuerto + 1);
            }
        }

        LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String par : query.split("&")) {
            if (par.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            int igual = par.indexOf('=');
            String clave = igual < 0 ? par : par.substring(0, igual);
            String valor = igual < 0 ? "" : par.substring(igual + 1);
            params.put(decodificar(clave), decodificar(valor));
        }

        return new Partes(protocol, transport, host, port, params);
    }

    static String decodificar(String text) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(text, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            return text;
        }
    }

    static String codificar(String text) {
        try {
            return URLEncoder.encode(text, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
        } catch (UnsupportedEncodingException ex) {
            return text;
        }
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api;

import java.util.Properties;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CommunicationsConfigTest {

    private DeviceConfigData device(String uuid, String name) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("brand", "Siemens");
        p.put("model", "S7-1500");
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", name);
        p.put("deviceKey", "K-" + name);
        p.put("description", "");
        p.put("uuid", uuid == null ? "" : uuid);
        p.put("enable", Boolean.TRUE);
        p.put("s88Node", "MD70");
        p.put("s88Uuid", "uuid-md70");
        p.put("specificParameters", "s7:cotp://192.168.0.10:102");
        return new DeviceConfigData(p);
    }

    @Test
    void modificarUnDispositivoLoReemplazaYNoLoDuplica() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("uuid-1", "Compresor 1"));

        config.upsertDevice(device("uuid-1", "Compresor 1 renombrado"));

        assertEquals(1, config.getDevices().size(),
                "modificar no puede agregar un dispositivo nuevo");
        assertEquals("Compresor 1 renombrado", config.getDevices().get(0).getDeviceName());
        assertEquals("Compresor 1 renombrado", config.findByUuid("uuid-1").getDeviceName(),
                "T3.2: el indice tiene que devolver el dispositivo ya cambiado");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- T3.2

    @Test
    void indexStaysAlignedWhenDeletingInTheMiddle() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "Uno"));
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "Dos"));
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-3", "Tres"));

        assertTrue(config.removeDevice("uuid-2"), "se borra el del medio");

        assertEquals(2, config.getDevices().size());
        assertEquals("Uno", config.getDevices().get(0).getDeviceName());
        assertEquals("Tres", config.getDevices().get(1).getDeviceName(),
                "T3.2: tras borrar, los siguientes se desplazan y el indice debe seguirlos");
        assertNull(config.findByUuid("uuid-2"), "el borrado ya no se encuentra");
        assertEquals("Tres", config.findByUuid("uuid-3").getDeviceName());
        assertEquals("Uno", config.findByUuid("uuid-1").getDeviceName());
    }

    @Test
    void indexSurvivesSeveralSafeDeletes() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
            config.addDevice(device("uuid-" + i, "D" + i));
        }
        config.removeDevice("uuid-1");
        config.removeDevice("uuid-3");
        config.removeDevice("uuid-5");

        assertEquals(2, config.getDevices().size());
        for (int i : new int[]{2, 4}) {
            assertEquals("D" + i, config.findByUuid("uuid-" + i).getDeviceName(),
                    "el indice debe seguir apuntando al sitio correcto tras varios borrados");
        }
        for (int i : new int[]{1, 3, 5}) {
            assertNull(config.findByUuid("uuid-" + i));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void dosDispositivosSinUuidNoSePisan() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid A"));
        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid B"));

        assertEquals(2, config.getDevices().size(),
                "T3.2: si compartieran clave, uno pisaria al otro");
        assertEquals("Sin uuid A", config.getDevices().get(0).getDeviceName());
        assertEquals("Sin uuid B", config.getDevices().get(1).getDeviceName());
    }

    @Test
    void deviceWithoutUuidIsAddedAndNotRejected() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid"));

        assertEquals(1, config.getDevices().size(),
                "T3.2: rechazarlo lo haria desaparecer en silencio y el dialogo de creacion"
                        + " seguiria anunciando que se guardo");
        assertNull(config.findByUuid(""), "buscar por uuid vacio no devuelve nada");
        assertNull(config.findByUuid(null));
    }

    @Test
    void deviceListCannotBeModified() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "Uno"));

        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class,
                () -> config.getDevices().add(device("uuid-2", "Dos")),
                "T3.2: la vista tiene que ser inmutable, si no se puede sortear el indice");
    }

    @Test
    void reemplazarEnUnaPosicionReindexa() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "Uno"));
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "Dos"));

        // Es lo que hace repararUuidsAusentes: el dispositivo gana su UUID.
        config.replaceDevice(0, device("uuid-nuevo", "Uno reparado"));

        assertEquals("Uno reparado", config.findByUuid("uuid-nuevo").getDeviceName());
        assertNull(config.findByUuid("uuid-1"),
                "T3.2: el UUID viejo debe desaparecer del indice");
        assertEquals("Dos", config.findByUuid("uuid-2").getDeviceName(),
                "el resto del indice no se mueve");
    }

    @Test
    void deviceWithoutUuidIsNotModifiedButAdded() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid"));

        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid editado"));

        assertEquals(2, config.getDevices().size(),
                "sin UUID no hay identidad: el comportamiento es agregar, y por eso avisa");
    }

    @Test
    void removeDeviceSacaElDispositivoYSuComunicacion() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("uuid-1", "Compresor 1"));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-1", null);

        assertTrue(config.removeDevice("uuid-1"));
        assertEquals(0, config.getDevices().size());
    }

    @Test
    void replaceDeviceCambiaElDispositivoDeLaPosicion() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.upsertDevice(device("", "Sin uuid"));

        config.replaceDevice(0, device("uuid-reparado", "Sin uuid"));

        assertEquals(1, config.getDevices().size());
        assertNotNull(config.getDevices().get(0).getUuid());
        assertEquals("uuid-reparado", config.getDevices().get(0).getUuid());
        assertEquals("Sin uuid", config.getDevices().get(0).getDeviceName(),
                "la reparaciÃ³n del UUID no debe perder el resto de los datos");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SaveResultTest {

    @Test
    void completeSaveReportsSuccessOnBoth() {
        SaveResult resultado = SaveResult.success();

        assertTrue(resultado.xmlSaved());
        assertTrue(resultado.databaseUpdated());
        assertTrue(resultado.isComplete());
        assertFalse(resultado.isPartial());
    }

    @Test
    void partialSaveReportsXmlYesAndDbNo() {
        SaveResult resultado = SaveResult.partial("boot.db no se pudo actualizar");

        assertTrue(resultado.xmlSaved(),
                "el XML si se escribio: el usuario tiene que saberlo para no repetir el guardado");
        assertFalse(resultado.databaseUpdated());
        assertFalse(resultado.isComplete());
        assertTrue(resultado.isPartial(),
                "es justo el caso que el booleano de antes no podia expresar");
    }

    @Test
    void saveThatWritesNothingReportsBothFlags() {
        SaveResult resultado = SaveResult.notSaved("la carga anterior fallo");

        assertFalse(resultado.xmlSaved(),
                "H-01: con la carga fallida no se puede escribir comunicacion.xml");
        assertFalse(resultado.databaseUpdated(),
                "y tampoco se reconstruye boot.db desde un modelo que no se ha leido");
        assertFalse(resultado.isComplete());
        assertFalse(resultado.isPartial(),
                "no es un guardado parcial: no se escribio nada");
    }

    @Test
    void messageExplainsWhatHappened() {
        assertEquals("boot.db no se pudo actualizar",
                SaveResult.partial("boot.db no se pudo actualizar").message());
        assertEquals("la carga anterior fallo",
                SaveResult.notSaved("la carga anterior fallo").message());
    }

    @Test
    void successfulSaveHasNoErrorMessage() {
        SaveResult resultado = SaveResult.success();

        assertTrue(resultado.message().isEmpty(),
                "no hay nada que avisar cuando todo va bien: " + resultado.message());
    }

    @Test
    void partialSaveWithoutReasonIsUseless() {
        // El mensaje es lo que evita el fallo silencioso de antes: un booleano no decia por
        // que habia vuelto false, y el que llamaba escribia su propio texto.
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SaveResult.partial(""),
                "un guardado parcial sin motivo no sirve de nada");
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> SaveResult.notSaved("  "),
                "ni tampoco uno que solo tenga espacios");
    }
}

    private static final String GOLDEN_SQL = "/golden/boot_db_reference.sql";
    private static final String CORRUPT_XML = "/golden/comunicacion_corrupto.xml";

    @TempDir
    Path tempDir;

    @Test
    void saveProducesExactlyTheGoldenXml() throws Exception {

        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        repo.save(GoldenFixture.config());

        assertEquals(resource(GOLDEN_XML), normalize(storage.text()),
                "El XML guardado ya no coincide con el golden. Si el cambio es intencionado,"
                        + " revisa el diff antes de actualizar el fichero golden.");
    }

    @Test
    void goldenXmlIsSchemaValid() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(resource(GOLDEN_XML));
        assertTrue(doc.validate(), "El golden debe seguir siendo valido contra tc6_0201");
    }

    @Test
    void goldenXmlLoadsBackIntoTheSameModel() throws Exception {
        GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage storage =
                new GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage(resource(GOLDEN_XML));
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig loaded = repo.load();

        assertEquals(canonical(GoldenFixture.config()), canonical(loaded),
                "El round-trip load(golden) debe reproducir el modelo completo");
    }

    @Test
    void savingTheLoadedGoldenReproducesTheGolden() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig loaded = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(
                new GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage(resource(GOLDEN_XML))).load();

        GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage target = new GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage();
        new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(target).save(loaded);

        assertEquals(resource(GOLDEN_XML), normalize(target.text()),
                "load -> save debe ser idempotente sobre el golden");
    }

    @Test
    void rebuildProducesTheGoldenBootDbContent() throws Exception {
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), GoldenFixture.config()),
                "rebuild() debe completar");

        String dump = SqlDump.dump(new File(tempDir.toFile(), "boot.db"));

        assertEquals(resource(GOLDEN_SQL), normalize(dump),
                "El contenido de boot.db cambio. El golden fija el esquema y las filas.");
    }

    @Test
    void corruptXmlIsRejectedWithAnException() {
        GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage storage =
                new GoldenFixture.BufferingStorage(resource(CORRUPT_XML));

        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage).load(),
                "El repositorio debe fallar ante un XML mal formado. Si dejara de fallar, "
                        + "quien este por encima esta tragandose el error (H-01).");
    }

    @Test
    void goldenFixtureCoversTheExpectedVolume() {
        CommunicationsConfig config = GoldenFixture.config();

        assertEquals(2, config.getDevices().size());
        assertEquals(3, config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_PLC).getGroups().size()
                + config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_VFD).getGroups().size());
        assertEquals(4, config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_PLC).getItems().size()
                + config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_VFD).getItems().size());
        assertEquals(6, config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_PLC).getPvs().size()
                + config.getComms(GoldenFixture.DEV_VFD).getPvs().size());
    }

    private static String canonical(CommunicationsConfig config) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        for (DeviceConfigData device : config.getDevices()) {
            out.append("device\n")
                    .append("  uuid=").append(device.getUuid()).append('\n')
                    .append("  deviceName=").append(device.getDeviceName()).append('\n')
                    .append("  brand=").append(device.getBrand()).append('\n')
                    .append("  model=").append(device.getModel()).append('\n')
                    .append("  protocol=").append(device.getProtocol()).append('\n')
                    .append("  deviceKey=").append(device.getDeviceKey()).append('\n')
                    .append("  description=").append(device.getDescription()).append('\n')
                    .append("  enabled=").append(device.isEnabled()).append('\n')
                    .append("  s88Node=").append(device.getS88Node()).append('\n')
                    .append("  s88Uuid=").append(device.getS88Uuid()).append('\n')
                    .append("  specificParameters=").append(device.getSpecificParameters()).append('\n');
            appendComms(out, config.getComms(device.getUuid()));
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static void appendComms(StringBuilder out, CommConfigData comms) {
        if (comms == null) {
            out.append("  comms=<null>\n");
            return;
        }
        out.append("  comms.deviceName=").append(comms.getDeviceName()).append('\n');
        for (CommConfigData.GroupConfig g : comms.getGroups()) {
            out.append("  group\n")
                    .append("    ").append(g.getUuid()).append('|').append(g.getName()).append('|')
                    .append(g.getDescription()).append('|').append(g.getScantime()).append('|')
                    .append(g.isEnable()).append('|').append(g.getMd5()).append('\n');
        }
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : comms.getItems()) {
            out.append("  item\n")
                    .append("    ").append(i.getUuid()).append('|').append(i.getName()).append('|')
                    .append(i.getDescription()).append('|').append(i.getTag()).append('|')
                    .append(i.isEnable()).append('|').append(i.getMd5()).append('|')
                    .append(i.getGroupUuid()).append('\n');
        }
        for (CommConfigData.PvConfig p : comms.getPvs()) {
            out.append("  pv\n")
                    .append("    ").append(p.getUuid()).append('|').append(p.getName()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getType()).append('|').append(p.getAreaUuid()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getOffset()).append('|').append(p.getDescriptorText()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getScanTime()).append('|').append(p.isScanEnable()).append('|')
                    .append(p.isWriteEnable()).append('|').append(p.getDisplayLimitLow()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getDisplayLimitHigh()).append('|').append(p.getDisplayDescription()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getDisplayFormat()).append('|').append(p.getDisplayUnits()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getControlLimitLow()).append('|').append(p.getControlLimitHigh()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getControlMinStep()).append('|').append(p.getMd5()).append('|')
                    .append(p.getS88Path()).append('\n');
        }
    }

    private static String normalize(String text) {
        return text.replace("\r\n", "\n").trim();
    }

    private static String resource(String name) {
        try (InputStream in = GoldenFileContractTest.class.getResourceAsStream(name)) {
            assertNotNull(in, "Falta el recurso golden " + name);
            return normalize(new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo leer el golden " + name, e);
        }
    }
}

            return new ByteArrayOutputStream() {
                @Override
                public void close() {

                }
            };
        }

 * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 * KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 * specific language governing permissions and limitations

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.golden;

import java.io.File;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.ResultSetMetaData;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

final class SqlDump {

    private SqlDump() {
    }

    static String dump(File dbFile) throws SQLException {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbFile.getAbsolutePath());
             Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {

            for (String table : tables(stmt)) {
                List<String> columns = columns(stmt, table);
                out.append("CREATE TABLE ").append(table).append(" (");
                for (int i = 0; i < columns.size(); i++) {
                    if (i > 0) {
                        out.append(", ");
                    }
                    out.append(columns.get(i));
                }
                out.append(");\n");

                String orderBy = String.join(", ", columns);
                try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM " + quote(table)
                        + " ORDER BY " + orderBy)) {
                    ResultSetMetaData meta = rs.getMetaData();
                    while (rs.next()) {
                        out.append("INSERT INTO ").append(table).append(" VALUES (");
                        for (int i = 1; i <= meta.getColumnCount(); i++) {
                            if (i > 1) {
                                out.append(", ");
                            }
                            out.append(literal(rs, i));
                        }
                        out.append(");\n");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static List<String> tables(Statement stmt) throws SQLException {
        List<String> tables = new ArrayList<>();
        try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'"
                        + " AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name")) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                tables.add(rs.getString(1));
            }
        }
        return tables;
    }

    private static List<String> columns(Statement stmt, String table) throws SQLException {
        List<String> columns = new ArrayList<>();
        try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("PRAGMA table_info(" + quote(table) + ")")) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                columns.add(rs.getString("name"));
            }
        }
        return columns;
    }

    private static String literal(ResultSet rs, int index) throws SQLException {
        Object value = rs.getObject(index);
        if (value == null) {
            return "NULL";
        }
        if (value instanceof byte[] bytes) {
            StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder("X'");
            for (byte b : bytes) {
                hex.append(String.format("%02X", b));
            }
            return hex.append('\'').toString();
        }
        if (value instanceof Number) {
            return value.toString();
        }
        return "'" + value.toString().replace("'", "''") + "'";
    }

    private static String quote(String identifier) {
        return '"' + identifier.replace("\"", "\"\"") + '"';
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class BootDbRepositoryIntegrityTest {

    @TempDir
    Path tempDir;
    
    @Test
    void unFalloEnElSegundoDispositivoNoDejaBootDbAPartial() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-ok", "PLC_Bueno", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-ok", commsWithGroup("g-ok", "it-ok", "pv-ok"));

        // Este dispositivo es invalido: su area no tiene grupo de escaneo.
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-malo", "PLC_Malo", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-malo", commsWithoutGroup("it-malo", "pv-malo"));

        boolean ok = BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config);

        assertFalse(ok, "un dispositivo invalido hace fallar el guardado");
        assertFalse(new File(tempDir.toFile(), "boot.db").exists(),
                "no habia boot.db antes, y un guardado fallido no debe dejar uno a medias");
        assertEquals(0, countTemporaryTables(),
                "el temporal de la base debe recogerse, no quedarse junto al panel");
    }

    @Test
    void unFalloDeInsertarConservaLaBaseAnterior() throws Exception {
        // Primero una base buena.
        CommunicationsConfig buena = new CommunicationsConfig();
        buena.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno", true));
        buena.upsertComms("uuid-1", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), buena));
        assertEquals(1, countDevices(), "precondicion: hay una base buena");

        // Ahora una configuracion que falla.
        CommunicationsConfig mala = new CommunicationsConfig();
        mala.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "PLC_Dos", true));
        mala.upsertComms("uuid-2", commsWithoutGroup("it-2", "pv-2"));
        assertFalse(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), mala));

        assertEquals(1, countDevices(),
                "H-03: la base anterior tiene que seguir ahi, no quedar destruida");
        assertTrue(deviceExists("uuid-1"),
                "H-03: el dispositivo que ya estaba sigue en la base");
        assertFalse(deviceExists("uuid-2"),
                "H-03: el dispositivo que fallo no debe colarse en la base anterior");
    }

    /** Dos guardados seguidos: el segundo reemplaza al primero sin dejar restos del anterior. */
    @Test
    void unGuardadoCorrectoSustituyeEnteroAlAnterior() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig primera = new CommunicationsConfig();
        primera.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno", true));
        primera.upsertComms("uuid-1", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), primera));

        CommunicationsConfig segunda = new CommunicationsConfig();
        segunda.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "PLC_Dos", true));
        segunda.upsertComms("uuid-2", commsWithGroup("g-2", "it-2", "pv-2"));
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), segunda));

        assertEquals(1, countDevices(), "la base nueva no hereda la anterior");
        assertFalse(deviceExists("uuid-1"));
        assertTrue(deviceExists("uuid-2"));
    }

    /** La base escrita lleva la version del esquema en el PRAGMA user_version. */
    @Test
    void laBaseEscribeLaVersionDelEsquema() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-1", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config));

        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("PRAGMA user_version")) {
            rs.next();
            assertEquals(BootDbWriter.SCHEMA_VERSION, rs.getInt(1),
                    "la base debe decir que version de esquema es");
        }
    }

    /** Cuantos ficheros temporales de boot.db quedan junto al panel. */
    private int countTemporaryTables() {
        File[] archivos = tempDir.toFile().listFiles(
                (dir, name) -> name.startsWith("boot.db.") || name.startsWith("boot.db-"));
        return archivos == null ? 0 : archivos.length;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- H-04

/**
 * El {@code Md5} del dispositivo se escribe vacÃ­o.
 *
 * <p>El modelo no tiene md5 para el dispositivo y no se calcula ninguno, asÃ­ que antes se
 * ponÃ­a el literal "md5_device_hash". Nada lee esta columna en runtime; queda vacÃ­a
 * hasta que se decida si se usa.
 */
@Test
void elMd5DelDispositivoSeEscribeVacio() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-1", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));

        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config));

        assertEquals("", deviceValue("uuid-1", "Md5"),
                "no hay hash del dispositivo que escribir, asÃ­ que no se escribe ninguno");
    }

/** No queda ninguno de los valores inventados en el codigo que escribe la base. */
@Test
void elCodigoYaNoTieneValoresInventados() throws Exception {
        for (String file : new String[]{
                "commsHmi/src/main/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/comms"
                        + "/persistence/BootDbRepository.java",
                "commsHmi/src/main/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/comms"
                        + "/persistence/BootDbWriter.java",
                "commsHmi/src/main/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/model"
                        + "/CommunicationWizardController.java"}) {
            java.nio.file.Path ruta = java.nio.file.Path.of("..", file);
            if (!java.nio.file.Files.exists(ruta)) {
                ruta = java.nio.file.Path.of(file);
            }
            String fuente = java.nio.file.Files.readString(ruta);
            for (String inventado : new String[]{
                    "md5_device_hash", "md5_group_hash", "md5_item_hash", "md5_pv_hash", "Key123",
                    "DefaultDriver", "tcp://localhost:502",
                    "Dispositivo guardado desde DeviceManager"}) {
                assertFalse(fuente.contains(inventado),
                        "H-04: '" + inventado + "' sigue apareciendo en " + ruta.getFileName());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
 * Un dispositivo sin clave no se guarda, y no se le inventa una.
 *
 * <p>Antes se sustituÃ­a por "Key123" y el runtime recibÃ­a esa clave de verdad, que no
 * corresponde a ninguna instalaciÃ³n. Ahora el guardado falla y la base anterior queda
 * como estaba.
 */
@Test
void unDispositivoSinClaveNoSeGuardaYNoSeLeInventaUna() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig buena = new CommunicationsConfig();
        buena.addDevice(device("uuid-ok", "PLC_Bueno", true));
        buena.upsertComms("uuid-ok", commsWithGroup("g-ok", "it-ok", "pv-ok"));
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), buena));

        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("brand", "Siemens");
        p.put("model", "S7-1500");
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", "Sin clave");
        p.put("uuid", "uuid-sin-clave");
        p.put("enable", true);
        p.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        p.put("s88Uuid", "s88-1");
        p.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1");
        // deviceKey ausente a proposito

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-ok", "PLC_Bueno", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-ok", commsWithGroup("g-ok", "it-ok", "pv-ok"));
        config.addDevice(new DeviceConfigData(p));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-sin-clave", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));

        RebuildResultado resultado =
                BootDbRepository.rebuildWithReason(tempDir.toFile(), config);

        assertFalse(resultado.success(),
                "un dispositivo sin clave tiene que hacer fallar el guardado");
        assertEquals(1, countDevices(),
                "la base anterior se conserva tal cual");
        assertTrue(resultado.reason().contains("Sin clave"),
                "el motivo debe nombrar el dispositivo: " + resultado.reason());
    }

    /** Una clave en blanco es lo mismo que no tenerla: tampoco se sustituye. */
    @Test
    void unaClaveEnBlancoTampocoSeSustituye() throws Exception {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", "Con clave vacia");
        p.put("uuid", "uuid-vacia");
        p.put("deviceKey", "   ");
        p.put("enable", true);
        p.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1");

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(new DeviceConfigData(p));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-vacia", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));

        assertFalse(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config),
                "una clave en blanco es una clave que falta");
    }

    @Test
    void conDispositivoLaUrlVieneDeLosParametricos() throws Exception {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", "Sin parametros");
        p.put("uuid", "uuid-sin-param");
        p.put("deviceKey", "key-1");
        p.put("enable", true);
        // specificParameters ausente a proposito

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(new DeviceConfigData(p));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-sin-param", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));

        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config));

        assertNull(deviceValue("uuid-sin-param", "DeviceUrl"),
                "con dispositivo no se inventa la URL: se escribe el valor, sea cual sea");
        assertEquals("S7", deviceValue("uuid-sin-param", "DriverName"),
                "con dispositivo el driver sale del protocolo, no de un literal");
    }
/**
     * Los grupos, Ã¡reas y PVs siguen llevando el md5 que trae el modelo.
     *
     * <p>Solo los literales fijos desaparecieron; lo que venga de un
     * {@code comunicacion.xml} existente no se toca.
     */
    @Test
    void losMd5DeGrupoAreaYPvSiVienenDelModelo() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno", true));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-1", commsWithGroup("g-1", "it-1", "pv-1"));

        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.rebuild(tempDir.toFile(), config));

        assertEquals("md5-real-del-grupo", valueOf("Groups", "GroupUuid", "g-1", "Md5"),
                "el md5 del grupo viene del modelo");
        assertEquals("md5-real-del-area", valueOf("Items", "ItemUuid", "it-1", "Md5"),
                "el md5 del area viene del modelo");
        assertEquals("md5-real-de-la-pv", valueOf("PvRecords", "PvUuId", "pv-1", "Md5"),
                "el md5 de la PV viene del modelo");
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ayudas

    private static Properties propiedades(String uuid, String name, boolean conClave) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("brand", "Siemens");
        p.put("model", "S7-1500");
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", name);
        p.put("uuid", uuid);
        p.put("enable", true);
        p.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        p.put("s88Uuid", "s88-" + uuid);
        p.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1,port=102");
        if (conClave) {
            p.put("deviceKey", "key-" + uuid);
        }
        return p;
    }

    private static DeviceConfigData device(String uuid, String name, boolean conClave) {
        return new DeviceConfigData(propiedades(uuid, name, conClave));
    }

    private static CommConfigData commsWithGroup(String groupUuid, String itemUuid, String pvUuid) {
        return new CommConfigData("PLC",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig(groupUuid, "Grupo", "descripcion",
                        "500", true, "md5-real-del-grupo")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(itemUuid, "Area", "descripcion",
                        "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, "md5-real-del-area", groupUuid)),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig(pvUuid, "PV", "INT", itemUuid, "0", "",
                        "500", true, false, "0", "10", "desc", "%.2f", "bar", "0", "10", "0.1",
                        "md5-real-de-la-pv")));
    }

    private static CommConfigData commsWithoutGroup(String itemUuid, String pvUuid) {
        return new CommConfigData("PLC",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g-otro", "Grupo", "descripcion",
                        "500", true, "md5-real-del-grupo")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(itemUuid, "Area sin grupo", "descripcion",
                        "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, "md5-real-del-area")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig(pvUuid, "PV", "INT", itemUuid, "0", "",
                        "500", true, false, "0", "10", "desc", "%.2f", "bar", "0", "10", "0.1",
                        "md5-real-de-la-pv")));
    }

    private Connection connection() throws Exception {
        return DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + new File(tempDir.toFile(), "boot.db"));
    }

    private int countDevices() throws Exception {
        return contar("Devices");
    }

    private int contar(String table) throws Exception {
        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM " + table)) {
            rs.next();
            return rs.getInt(1);
        }
    }

    private boolean deviceExists(String uuid) throws Exception {
        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                     "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Devices WHERE DeviceUuId = '" + uuid + "'")) {
            rs.next();
            return rs.getInt(1) > 0;
        }
    }

    private String deviceValue(String uuid, String columna) throws Exception {
        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                     "SELECT " + columna + " FROM Devices WHERE DeviceUuId = '" + uuid + "'")) {
            return rs.next() ? rs.getString(1) : null;
        }
    }

    private String uniqueValueOf(String table, String columna) throws Exception {
        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT DISTINCT " + columna + " FROM " + table)) {
            return rs.next() ? rs.getString(1) : null;
        }
    }

    private String valueOf(String table, String columnaClave, String clave, String columna) throws Exception {
        try (Connection conn = connection(); Statement stmt = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery("SELECT " + columna + " FROM " + table
                     + " WHERE " + columnaClave + " = '" + clave + "'")) {
            return rs.next() ? rs.getString(1) : null;
        }
    }
}
