package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.DriverManager;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class BootDbRepositoryTest {

    @TempDir
    Path tempDir;

    @Test
    void pvIdIsTheOnlyLinkBetweenPvAndItem() throws Exception {
        File dbFolder = tempDir.toFile();
        String deviceUuid = "uuid-1";
        String groupUuid = "g1";
        String itemUuid = "i1";
        String pvUuid = "p1";

        BootDbRepository.createDB(dbFolder.getAbsolutePath());
        BootDbRepository.insertDeviceConfig(
                dbFolder.getAbsolutePath(),
                device(deviceUuid, "PLC_Uno"),
                comms(groupUuid, itemUuid, pvUuid));

        File dbFile = new File(dbFolder, "boot.db");
        assertTrue(dbFile.isFile(), "boot.db debe haberse creado");

        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbFile.getAbsolutePath());
             Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT PvUuId, PvId FROM PvRecords WHERE PvUuId = '" + pvUuid + "'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next(), "La PV debe estar en PvRecords");
                assertEquals(itemUuid, rs.getString("PvId"),
                        "PvId debe contener el uuid del item (Ã¡rea)");
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT ItemUuid, DeviceUuid, GroupUuid FROM Items WHERE ItemUuid = '" + itemUuid + "'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next(), "El item debe estar en Items");
                assertEquals(itemUuid, rs.getString("ItemUuid"));
                assertEquals(deviceUuid, rs.getString("DeviceUuid"),
                        "El item debe quedar ligado al device");
                assertEquals(groupUuid, rs.getString("GroupUuid"),
                        "El item debe quedar ligado a su grupo de escaneo");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void savingTwiceOverwritesTheExistingRows() throws Exception {
        File dbFolder = tempDir.toFile();
        String deviceUuid = "uuid-3";
        String itemUuid = "i3";

        BootDbRepository.createDB(dbFolder.getAbsolutePath());
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.insertDeviceConfig(
                dbFolder.getAbsolutePath(), device(deviceUuid, "PLC_Tres"),
                comms("g1", itemUuid, "p3")));

        CommConfigData modificado = new CommConfigData("PLC_Tres",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", "Grupo1", "Grupo 1 editado",
                        "800", true, "md5g")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(itemUuid, "Item1", "Item 1 editado",
                        "tag1", false, "md5i", "g1")),
                List.of());
        assertTrue(BootDbRepository.insertDeviceConfig(
                dbFolder.getAbsolutePath(), device(deviceUuid, "PLC_Tres"), modificado));

        File dbFile = new File(dbFolder, "boot.db");
        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbFile.getAbsolutePath());
             Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Items WHERE ItemUuid = '" + itemUuid + "'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals(1, rs.getInt(1), "No debe duplicar el Ã¡rea al modificarla");
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT ItemDescription, GroupUuid FROM Items WHERE ItemUuid = '"
                            + itemUuid + "'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals("Item 1 editado", rs.getString("ItemDescription"),
                        "La descripciÃ³n debe quedar actualizada en la base");
                assertEquals("g1", rs.getString("GroupUuid"));
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Groups WHERE GroupUuid = 'g1'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals(1, rs.getInt(1), "No debe duplicar el grupo al modificarlo");
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT GroupDescription, GroupScantime FROM Groups WHERE GroupUuid = 'g1'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals("Grupo 1 editado", rs.getString("GroupDescription"));
                assertEquals("800", rs.getString("GroupScantime"));
            }
        }
    }

    private static CommConfigData comms(String groupUuid, String itemUuid, String pvUuid) {
        return new CommConfigData("PLC_Uno",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig(groupUuid, "Grupo1", "Grupo 1", "500", true, "md5g")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(itemUuid, "Item1", "Item 1", "tag1", false, "md5i",
                        groupUuid)),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig(pvUuid, "PV1", "INT", itemUuid, "0", "descr",
                        "500", true, false, "-100", "100", "desc", "%.2f", "gpm",
                        "-50", "50", "0.1", "md5p")));
    }

    @Test
    void itemWithoutGroupIsNotSavedAtAll() throws Exception {
        File dbFolder = tempDir.toFile();
        String deviceUuid = "uuid-2";
        String itemUuid = "i2";

        CommConfigData comms = new CommConfigData("PLC_Dos",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", "Grupo1", "Grupo 1", "500", true, "md5g"),
                        new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g2", "Grupo2", "Grupo 2", "500", true, "md5g")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(itemUuid, "Item2", "Item 2", "tag2", false, "md5i")),
                List.of());

        BootDbRepository.createDB(dbFolder.getAbsolutePath());
        boolean guardado = BootDbRepository.insertDeviceConfig(
                dbFolder.getAbsolutePath(), device(deviceUuid, "PLC_Dos"), comms);

        assertFalse(guardado,
                "Un Ã¡rea sin grupo de escaneo no se guarda: el grupo es obligatorio");

        File dbFile = new File(dbFolder, "boot.db");
        try (Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:sqlite:" + dbFile.getAbsolutePath());
             Statement stmt = conn.createStatement()) {
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Items WHERE ItemUuid = '" + itemUuid + "'")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals(0, rs.getInt(1),
                        "En la base no puede quedar un Ã¡rea sin GroupUuid");
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = stmt.executeQuery(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Items WHERE GroupUuid IS NULL")) {
                assertTrue(rs.next());
                assertEquals(0, rs.getInt(1), "No se admiten GroupUuid nulos en Items");
            }
        }
    }

    private static DeviceConfigData device(String uuid, String deviceName) {
        Properties pDevice = new Properties();
        pDevice.put("brand", "Siemens");
        pDevice.put("model", "S7-1500");
        pDevice.put("protocol", "S7");
        pDevice.put("deviceName", deviceName);
        pDevice.put("deviceKey", "key-" + uuid);
        pDevice.put("description", "Control principal");
        pDevice.put("uuid", uuid);
        pDevice.put("enable", true);
        pDevice.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        pDevice.put("s88Uuid", "s88-uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1");
        return new DeviceConfigData(pDevice);
    }
}

        DeviceConfigData device = new DeviceConfigData(pDevice);

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(device, configurations);

        DeviceConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readDevice(configurations.getConfigurationArray(0));

        assertNotNull(read);
        assertEquals(device.getBrand(), read.getBrand());
        assertEquals(device.getModel(), read.getModel());
        assertEquals(device.getProtocol(), read.getProtocol());

    @Test
    void roundTripComms() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();
        Properties pDevice = new Properties();

        pDevice.put("brand", "Siemens");
        pDevice.put("model", "S7-1500");
        pDevice.put("protocol", "S7");
        pDevice.put("deviceName", "PLC_Uno");
        pDevice.put("description", "Control principal");
        pDevice.put("uuid", "uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("enable", true);
        pDevice.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        pDevice.put("s88Uuid", "s88-uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("specificParameters", "");

        DeviceConfigData device = new DeviceConfigData(pDevice);

        Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(device, configurations);

        CommConfigData comms = new CommConfigData("PLC_Uno",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", "Grupo1", "Grupo 1", "500", true, "md5g")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig("i1", "Item1", "Item 1", "tag1", true, "md5i")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig("p1", "PV1", "INT", "pv-id", "0", "descriptor",
                        "500", true, true, "-100", "100", "PV uno", "%.2f", "gpm",
                        "-50", "50", "0.1", "md5p")));

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(comms, configuration);

        CommConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readComms(configuration);

        assertNotNull(read);
        assertEquals("PLC_Uno", read.getDeviceName());
        assertEquals(1, read.getGroups().size());
        CommConfigData.GroupConfig g = read.getGroups().get(0);
        assertEquals("g1", g.getUuid());
        assertEquals("Grupo1", g.getName());
        assertEquals("Grupo 1", g.getDescription());
        assertEquals("500", g.getScantime());
        assertEquals(true, g.isEnable());
        assertEquals("md5g", g.getMd5());
        assertEquals(1, read.getItems().size());
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig i = read.getItems().get(0);
        assertEquals("i1", i.getUuid());
        assertEquals("Item1", i.getName());
        assertEquals("Item 1", i.getDescription());
        assertEquals("tag1", i.getTag());
        assertEquals(true, i.isEnable());
        assertEquals(1, read.getPvs().size());
        CommConfigData.PvConfig p = read.getPvs().get(0);
        assertEquals("p1", p.getUuid());
        assertEquals("PV1", p.getName());
        assertEquals("INT", p.getType());
        assertEquals("pv-id", p.getAreaUuid());
        assertEquals("0", p.getOffset());
        assertEquals("descriptor", p.getDescriptorText());
        assertEquals("500", p.getScanTime());
        assertEquals(true, p.isScanEnable());
        assertEquals(true, p.isWriteEnable());
        assertEquals("-100", p.getDisplayLimitLow());
        assertEquals("100", p.getDisplayLimitHigh());
        assertEquals("PV uno", p.getDisplayDescription());
        assertEquals("%.2f", p.getDisplayFormat());
        assertEquals("gpm", p.getDisplayUnits());
        assertEquals("-50", p.getControlLimitLow());
        assertEquals("50", p.getControlLimitHigh());
        assertEquals("0.1", p.getControlMinStep());
        assertEquals("md5p", p.getMd5());
    }

    @Test
    void childrenKeepInsertionOrder() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(namedDevice("PLC"), configurations);

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(new CommConfigData("PLC",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g-1", "Uno", "", "500", true, "m1"),
                        new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g-2", "Dos", "", "500", true, "m2"),
                        new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g-3", "Tres", "", "500", true, "m3")),
                List.of(), List.of()), configuration);

        String xml = configuration.xmlText();

        assertTrue(xml.indexOf("\"g-1\"") < xml.indexOf("\"g-2\""), "g-1 debe preceder a g-2");
        assertTrue(xml.indexOf("\"g-2\"") < xml.indexOf("\"g-3\""), "g-2 debe preceder a g-3");
    }

    @Test
    void emptyListsProduceEmptyContainers() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(namedDevice("PLC"), configurations);

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(
                new CommConfigData("PLC", List.of(), List.of(), List.of()), configuration);

        String xml = configuration.xmlText();

        assertTrue(xml.contains("<groups/>"), "Un grupo sin filas debe quedar vacio: " + xml);
        assertTrue(xml.contains("<items/>"), "Un item sin filas debe quedar vacio: " + xml);
        assertTrue(xml.contains("<pvs/>"), "Un pv sin filas debe quedar vacio: " + xml);

        CommConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readComms(configuration);

        assertNotNull(read);
        assertTrue(read.getGroups().isEmpty());
        assertTrue(read.getItems().isEmpty());
        assertTrue(read.getPvs().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void valuesWithSpecialCharactersAreEscapedByTheSerializer() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Properties pDevice = new Properties();
        pDevice.put("deviceName", "PLC");
        pDevice.put("enable", true);
        pDevice.put("uuid", "VFD Bomba A <<1>>");
        pDevice.put("description", "linea1\nlinea2 & mas <ahora> \"Q\" 'Z'");

        Configuration configuration =
                DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(new DeviceConfigData(pDevice), configurations);

        String xml = configuration.xmlText();

        assertTrue(xml.contains("&amp;"), "El ampersand debe escaparse: " + xml);
        assertTrue(xml.contains("&lt;"), "El menor que debe escaparse: " + xml);
        assertFalse(xml.contains("escape"), "No debe quedar el nombre de un metodo de escape en el XML");
        assertFalse(xml.contains("&amp;amp;"), "No debe escaparse dos veces: " + xml);

        DeviceConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readDevice(configuration);

        assertEquals("linea1\nlinea2 & mas <ahora> \"Q\" 'Z'", read.getDescription(),
                "Los saltos de linea y los caracteres especiales deben volver intactos");
        assertEquals("VFD Bomba A <<1>>", read.getUuid());
    }

    @Test
    void everyGroupFieldSurvivesTheRoundTrip() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(namedDevice("PLC"), configurations);

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(new CommConfigData("PLC",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", "Escaneo Rapido", "Grupo de alta frecuencia",
                        "500", true, "b3f1a0c2d4e5")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig("i1", "Presion Zona 1", "Presion de la zona",
                        "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, "d5e6c2b4f6a7", "g1")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig("p1", "Presion Zona 1", "INT", "i1", "0", "descriptor",
                        "500", true, false, "0", "10", "Presion (bar)", "%.2f", "bar", "0", "10", "0.1",
                        "f7a8e4d6b8c9", "S88.1.Alfa"))),
                configuration);

        CommConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readComms(configuration);

        CommConfigData.GroupConfig g = read.getGroups().get(0);
        assertEquals("g1", g.getUuid());
        assertEquals("Escaneo Rapido", g.getName());
        assertEquals("Grupo de alta frecuencia", g.getDescription());
        assertEquals("500", g.getScantime());
        assertTrue(g.isEnable());
        assertEquals("b3f1a0c2d4e5", g.getMd5());

        CommConfigData.ItemConfig i = read.getItems().get(0);
        assertEquals("i1", i.getUuid());
        assertEquals("%DB1.DBB0:INT", i.getTag());
        assertEquals("d5e6c2b4f6a7", i.getMd5());
        assertEquals("g1", i.getGroupUuid(), "El campo group debe volver a su sitio");

        CommConfigData.PvConfig p = read.getPvs().get(0);
        assertEquals("descriptor", p.getDescriptorText());
        assertTrue(p.isScanEnable());
        assertFalse(p.isWriteEnable());
        assertEquals("Presion (bar)", p.getDisplayDescription());
        assertEquals("%.2f", p.getDisplayFormat());
        assertEquals("bar", p.getDisplayUnits());
        assertEquals("0.1", p.getControlMinStep());
        assertEquals("f7a8e4d6b8c9", p.getMd5());
        assertEquals("S88.1.Alfa", p.getS88Path(),
                "md5 y s88Path estan en orden distinto en el XML y en el constructor");
    }

    @Test
    void deviceKeepsEveryFieldIncludingTheOnesWithoutAttribute() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Properties pDevice = new Properties();
        pDevice.put("deviceName", "PLC_Uno");
        pDevice.put("brand", "Siemens");
        pDevice.put("model", "S7-1500");
        pDevice.put("protocol", "S7");
        pDevice.put("deviceKey", "key-1");
        pDevice.put("description", "Control principal");
        pDevice.put("uuid", "uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("enable", false);
        pDevice.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        pDevice.put("s88Uuid", "s88-uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1,rack=0");

        Configuration configuration =
                DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(new DeviceConfigData(pDevice), configurations);

        DeviceConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readDevice(configuration);

        assertEquals("Siemens", read.getBrand());
        assertEquals("S7-1500", read.getModel());
        assertEquals("S7", read.getProtocol());
        assertEquals("key-1", read.getDeviceKey());
        assertEquals("Control principal", read.getDescription());
        assertEquals("S88.1", read.getS88Node());
        assertEquals("s88-uuid-1", read.getS88Uuid());
        assertEquals("ipa=10.0.0.1,rack=0", read.getSpecificParameters());
        assertFalse(read.isEnabled(), "El atributo se llama enabled pero la propiedad enable");
        assertEquals("PLC_Uno", read.getDeviceName(), "El nombre viene de configuration, no del XML");
    }

    @Test
    void emptyValuesAreWrittenAsEmptyAttributesNotOmitted() throws Exception {
        ProjectDocument doc = ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl.TEMPLATE);
        Configurations configurations = doc.getProject().getInstances().getConfigurations();

        Configuration configuration = DeviceXmlMapper.writeDevice(namedDevice("PLC"), configurations);

        DeviceXmlMapper.writeComms(new CommConfigData("PLC",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", null, null, null, true, null)),
                List.of(),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig("p1", null, null, null, null, null, null,
                        true, true, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null, null))),
                configuration);

        String xml = configuration.xmlText();

        assertTrue(xml.contains("descriptor=\"\""),
                "Un valor nulo debe escribir el atributo vacio, no omitirlo: " + xml);
        assertTrue(xml.contains("s88Path=\"\""),
                "Un valor nulo debe escribir el atributo vacio, no omitirlo: " + xml);
        assertTrue(xml.contains("md5=\"\""),
                "Un valor nulo debe escribir el atributo vacio, no omitirlo: " + xml);

        CommConfigData read = DeviceXmlMapper.readComms(configuration);

        assertEquals("", read.getGroups().get(0).getName());
        assertEquals("", read.getGroups().get(0).getMd5());
        assertEquals("", read.getPvs().get(0).getDescriptorText());
        assertEquals("", read.getPvs().get(0).getMd5());
    }

    private static DeviceConfigData namedDevice(String name) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("deviceName", name);
        p.put("enable", true);
        return new DeviceConfigData(p);
    }

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;

final class InMemoryStorage implements CommConfigStorage {

    private String text = "";

    String text() {
        return text;
    }

    @Override
    public String open() {
        return text;
    }

    @Override
    public OutputStream create() {
        return new ByteArrayOutputStream() {
            @Override
            public void close() {
                text = new String(toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            }
        };
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.plcopen.xml.tc60201.ProjectDocument;

class PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImplTest {

    @Test
    void loadEmptyStorageReturnsEmptyConfig() throws Exception {
        InMemoryStorage storage = new InMemoryStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig config = repo.load();

        assertEquals(0, config.getDevices().size());
    }

    @Test
    void saveAndLoadRoundTrip() throws Exception {
        InMemoryStorage storage = new InMemoryStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno"));
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "VFD_Bomba"));
        repo.save(config);

        CommunicationsConfig loaded = repo.load();

        assertEquals(2, loaded.getDevices().size());
        assertDevice(loaded.getDevices().get(0), deviceProps("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno"));
        assertDevice(loaded.getDevices().get(1), deviceProps("uuid-2", "VFD_Bomba"));
    }

    @Test
    void savedXmlIsSchemaValid() throws Exception {
        InMemoryStorage storage = new InMemoryStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno"));
        repo.save(config);

        String saved = storage.text();
        assertTrue(saved.contains(CommsXmlIdentifiers.DEVICE_DATA_NAME));
        assertTrue(ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(saved).validate());
    }

    @Test
    void saveReplacesPreviousDevices() throws Exception {
        InMemoryStorage storage = new InMemoryStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig first = new CommunicationsConfig();
        first.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno"));
        repo.save(first);

        CommunicationsConfig second = new CommunicationsConfig();
        second.addDevice(device("uuid-2", "VFD_Bomba"));
        repo.save(second);

        CommunicationsConfig loaded = repo.load();
        assertEquals(1, loaded.getDevices().size());
        assertEquals("VFD_Bomba", loaded.getDevices().get(0).getDeviceName());
    }

    @Test
    void saveAndLoadRoundTripWithComms() throws Exception {
        InMemoryStorage storage = new InMemoryStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        config.addDevice(device("uuid-1", "PLC_Uno"));
        config.upsertComms("uuid-1", new CommConfigData("PLC_Uno",
                List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g1", "Grupo1", "Grupo 1", "500", true, "md5g")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig("i1", "Item1", "Item 1", "tag1", false, "md5i")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig("p1", "PV1", "INT", "i1", "0", "descr",
                        "500", true, false, "-100", "100", "desc", "%.2f", "gpm",
                        "-50", "50", "0.1", "md5p"))));
        repo.save(config);

        String saved = storage.text();
        assertTrue(saved.contains(CommsXmlIdentifiers.COMMS_DATA_NAME));
        assertTrue(ProjectDocument.Factory.parse(saved).validate());

        CommunicationsConfig loaded = repo.load();
        assertEquals(1, loaded.getDevices().size());
        CommConfigData comms = loaded.getComms("uuid-1");
        assertNotNull(comms);
        assertEquals("PLC_Uno", comms.getDeviceName());
        assertEquals(1, comms.getGroups().size());
        assertEquals("Grupo1", comms.getGroups().get(0).getName());
        assertEquals(1, comms.getItems().size());
        assertEquals("tag1", comms.getItems().get(0).getTag());
        assertEquals(1, comms.getPvs().size());
        assertEquals("PV1", comms.getPvs().get(0).getName());
        assertEquals("i1", comms.getPvs().get(0).getAreaUuid());
        assertTrue(comms.getPvs().get(0).isScanEnable());
        assertEquals(false, comms.getPvs().get(0).isWriteEnable());
    }

    private static Properties deviceProps(String uuid, String deviceName) {
        Properties pDevice = new Properties();

        pDevice.put("brand", "Siemens");
        pDevice.put("model", "S7-1500");
        pDevice.put("protocol", "S7");
        pDevice.put("deviceName", deviceName);
        pDevice.put("deviceKey", "key-" + uuid);
        pDevice.put("description", "Control principal");
        pDevice.put("uuid", uuid);
        pDevice.put("enable", true);
        pDevice.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        pDevice.put("s88Uuid", "s88-uuid-1");
        pDevice.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1");

        return pDevice;
    }

    private static DeviceConfigData device(String uuid, String deviceName) {
        return new DeviceConfigData(deviceProps(uuid, deviceName));
    }

    private static void assertDevice(DeviceConfigData actual, Properties pdevice) {
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("brand"), actual.getBrand());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("model"), actual.getModel());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("protocol"), actual.getProtocol());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("deviceName"), actual.getDeviceName());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("deviceKey"), actual.getDeviceKey());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("description"), actual.getDescription());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("uuid"), actual.getUuid());
        Object enableValue = pdevice.get("enable");
        assertEquals(enableValue != null && Boolean.parseBoolean(String.valueOf(enableValue)), actual.isEnabled());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("s88Node"), actual.getS88Node());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("s88Uuid"), actual.getS88Uuid());
        assertEquals(pdevice.getProperty("specificParameters"), actual.getSpecificParameters());
    }
}

FILE: commsHmi/src/test/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/comms/plcopen/PlcOpenSaveIntegrityTest.java

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.plcopen;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class PlcOpenSaveIntegrityTest {

    @Test
    void unaEscrituraFallidaDejaElArchivoComoEstaba() throws Exception {
        AtomicStorage storage = new AtomicStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        repo.save(configWith(1));
        String anterior = storage.text();
        assertFalse(anterior.isBlank(), "precondicion: hay contenido escrito previamente");

        storage.failOnWrite = true;
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> repo.save(configWith(20)),
                "la escritura debe fallar a mitad");

        assertEquals(anterior, storage.text(),
                "H-02: un fallo al guardar no puede cambiar lo que habia escrito");
        assertTrue(storage.text().contains("PLC_1"),
                "H-02: el dispositivo de la escritura anterior tiene que seguir ahi");
        assertFalse(storage.text().contains("PLC_20"),
                "H-02: el contenido a medias no debe aplicarse");
    }

    @Test
    void noSePideElDestinoHastaTenerElDocumentoEntero() throws Exception {
        AtomicStorage storage = new AtomicStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        repo.save(configWith(3));

        assertEquals(0, storage.vecesCreate,
                "save() no debe usar create(), que trunca el archivo al abrirlo");
        assertEquals(1, storage.vecesWrite, "el contenido se entrega de una vez");
        assertTrue(storage.ultimoContenido.length > 0);
        assertTrue(new String(storage.ultimoContenido, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).contains("PLC_3"),
                "lo entregado es el documento completo, no un trozo");
    }

    @Test
    void unaEscrituraCorrectaSiReemplazaElContenido() throws Exception {
        AtomicStorage storage = new AtomicStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);

        repo.save(configWith(1));
        String conUnDispositivo = storage.text();
        repo.save(configWith(3));

        assertNotEquals(conUnDispositivo, storage.text());
        assertTrue(storage.text().contains("PLC_1"));
        assertTrue(storage.text().contains("PLC_3"));
        assertEquals(3, ocurrencias(storage.text(), "<configuration "),
                "el guardado es un reemplazo completo: queda un <configuration> por"
                + " dispositivo y nada del contenido anterior");
    }

    @Test
    void despuesDeUnFalloSePuedeGuardarOtraVez() throws Exception {
        AtomicStorage storage = new AtomicStorage();
        CommConfigRepository repo = new PlcOpenCommConfigRepositoryImpl(storage);
        repo.save(configWith(1));

        storage.failOnWrite = true;
        assertThrows(Exception.class, () -> repo.save(configWith(5)));
        storage.failOnWrite = false;

        repo.save(configWith(2));

        assertEquals(2, ocurrencias(storage.text(), "<configuration "),
                "el fallo anterior no dejo el almacenamiento en un estado raro");
        assertFalse(storage.text().contains("PLC_5"));
    }

    private static CommunicationsConfig configWith(int numeroDeDispositivos) {
        CommunicationsConfig config = new CommunicationsConfig();
        for (int i = 1; i <= numeroDeDispositivos; i++) {
            String uuid = "uuid-" + i;
            config.addDevice(new DeviceConfigData(propiedades(uuid, "PLC_" + i)));
            config.upsertComms(uuid, new CommConfigData("PLC_" + i,
                    List.of(new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("g-" + i, "Grupo", "d", "500", true, "m")),
                    List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig("it-" + i, "Area", "d",
                            "%DB" + i + ".DBB0:INT", true, "m", "g-" + i)),
                    List.of(new CommConfigData.PvConfig("pv-" + i, "PV", "INT", "it-" + i,
                            "0", "", "500", true, false, "0", "10", "d", "%.2f", "u",
                            "0", "10", "0.1", "m"))));
        }
        return config;
    }

    private static int ocurrencias(String text, String aguja) {
        int total = 0;
        int desde = text.indexOf(aguja);
        while (desde >= 0) {
            total++;
            desde = text.indexOf(aguja, desde + aguja.length());
        }
        return total;
    }

    private static Properties propiedades(String uuid, String name) {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("brand", "Siemens");
        p.put("model", "S7-1500");
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", name);
        p.put("deviceKey", "key-" + uuid);
        p.put("description", "descripcion de " + name);
        p.put("uuid", uuid);
        p.put("enable", true);
        p.put("s88Node", "S88.1");
        p.put("s88Uuid", "s88-" + uuid);
        p.put("specificParameters", "ipa=10.0.0.1,port=102");
        return p;
    }

    private static final class AtomicStorage implements CommConfigStorage {

        private String text = "";
        private boolean failOnWrite;
        private int vecesCreate;
        private int vecesWrite;
        private byte[] ultimoContenido = new byte[0];

        String text() {
            return text;
        }

        @Override
        public String open() {
            return text;
        }

        @Override
        public OutputStream create() {
            vecesCreate++;
            text = "";
            ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            return new OutputStream() {
                @Override
                public void write(int b) {
                    buffer.write(b);
                }

                @Override
                public void write(byte[] b, int off, int len) {
                    buffer.write(b, off, len);
                }

                @Override
                public void close() {
                    text = new String(buffer.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
            };
        }

        @Override
        public void write(byte[] content) throws IOException {
            vecesWrite++;
            ultimoContenido = content;
            if (failOnWrite) {
                throw new IOException("no hay espacio en el dispositivo");
            }
            text = new String(content, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }
}

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class AreaCapacityTest {

    private static final String AREA = "area-1";
    private static final String GRUPO = "grupo-1";

    private static CommConfigData.ItemConfig area(String uuid, String name, String tag) {
        return new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(uuid, name, "", tag, true, "md5", GRUPO);
    }

    private static CommunicationWizardController controllerWith(CommConfigData.ItemConfig... areas) {
        CommunicationWizardState state = new CommunicationWizardState();
        state.getItems().addAll(List.of(areas));
        return new CommunicationWizardController(new NoopCommunicationStore(), state);
    }

    private static CommunicationWizardController controllerWith(String tag) {
        return controllerWith(area(AREA, "Temperaturas", tag));
    }

    private static void addPv(CommunicationWizardController c, String uuid, String offset,
            String type) {
        c.getState().getPvs().add(new CommConfigData.PvConfig(
                uuid, "variable-" + uuid, type, AREA, offset, "", "1000", true, false,
                "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "", "md5_pv_hash", "Area/" + uuid));
    }


    @Test
    void byteAreaFitsOneBytePerSlot() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(1849, c.areaCapacityInBytes(AREA));
        assertEquals(1849, c.freeAreaSlots(AREA, DataType.BYTE));
        assertEquals("0", c.nextOffset(AREA, DataType.BYTE));
    }

    @Test
    void bytePacksEightBooleans() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BOOL");
        assertEquals(1849, c.areaCapacityInBytes(AREA));
        assertEquals(1849 * 8, c.freeAreaSlots(AREA, DataType.BOOLEAN));
        assertEquals("0.0", c.nextOffset(AREA, DataType.BOOLEAN));
    }

    @Test
    void booleanOffsetsAdvanceByBitAndWrapInsideTheByte() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB21.DBB0[0..2]:BOOL");
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            String esperado = (i / 8) + "." + (i % 8);
            assertEquals(esperado, c.nextOffset(AREA, DataType.BOOLEAN),
                    "el booleano " + i + " deberÃ­a caer en " + esperado);
            addPv(c, "p" + i, esperado, "boolean");
        }
        assertEquals("1.0", c.nextOffset(AREA, DataType.BOOLEAN),
                "al llegar a ocho hay que saltar al byte siguiente");
    }

    @Test

        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB21.DBB4[0..9]:BOOL");
        assertEquals(10, c.areaCapacityInBytes(AREA));

                "el offset 0 del Ã¡rea es el byte 4 del DB21");
    }

    @Test
    void dosAreasQueSePisanConUnEspacioEnElTagDebenAvisar() {
        // Las dos Ã¡reas que el usuario tiene guardadas: comparten los bytes 4 a 13
        // del DB21 y la segunda lleva un espacio en el tag ("%DB21. DBB4"). El
        // espacio se quita para entender el tag, asÃ­ que el solapamiento tiene que
        // seguir viÃ©ndose.
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith(
                area("a1", "area4", "%DB21. DBB4[0..9]:INTEGER"));
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig choca = c.overlappingArea("%DB21. DBB4[0..12]:REAL", null);
        assertNotNull(choca, "las dos Ã¡reas comparten los bytes 4 a 13 del DB21");
        assertEquals("area4", choca.getName());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownPlantTypeIsNotDiscarded() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBD0[0..99]:INTEGER");
        addPv(c, "a", "0", "int");
        assertEquals(DataType.INT, c.lockedType(AREA));
        assertTrue(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "UDINT", DataType.INT),
                "UDINT sÃ­ es una familia y es de los mismos cuatro bytes");
        assertTrue(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "INVENTADO", DataType.INT),
                "un nombre que no se conoce no debe descartar la variable");
        assertTrue(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "", DataType.INT));
    }

    @Test
    void knownTypeFromAnotherFamilyIsNowRejected() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBD0[0..99]:INTEGER");
        addPv(c, "a", "0", "int");
        assertFalse(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "LREAL", DataType.INT),
                "un double no entra en un Ã¡rea de enteros");
    }

    @Test
    void lrealAreaAcceptsItsOwnVariables() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBLD0[0..7]:LREAL");
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.DOUBLE), c.typesAllowed(AREA));
        assertTrue(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "LREAL", DataType.DOUBLE));
        assertFalse(c.areaAcceptsType(AREA, "LREAL", DataType.FLOAT),
                "y un float no cabe en un Ã¡rea de ocho bytes");
    }

    @Test
    void dintAreaIsPinnedToFourByteIntegers() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controllerWith("%DB231.DBD0[0..7]:DINT");
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT), c.typesAllowed(AREA));
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.NoopCommunicationStore;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CommunicationWizardControllerCacheTest {

    private static final String AREA = "area-1";
    private static final String OTRO = "area-2";
    private static final String GRUPO = "grupo-1";

    private static CommunicationWizardController controller() {
        return new CommunicationWizardController(
                new NoopCommunicationStore(), new CommunicationWizardState());
    }

    private static void add(CommunicationWizardController c, String uuid, String tag) {
        c.addItem(uuid, "Area " + uuid, "", tag, true, GRUPO);
    }

    @Test
    void detectaElChoqueEntreDosTagsQueSeSolapan() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT");

        assertNotNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null),
                "dos rangos del mismo bloque que se pisan tienen que avisar");
    }

    @Test
    void updatedTagIsReflectedInValidation() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT");
        assertNotNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null), "precondiciÃ³n: chocan");

        // El usuario corrige el area para que ya no se solape.
        c.updateItem(AREA, "", "%DB2.DBB0[0..9]:INT", true);

        assertNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null),
                "T3.7: tras editar el tag, la cache no puede seguir devolviendo el solape viejo");
    }

    @Test
    void newTagAfterEditingIsAlsoValidated() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB9.DBB0[0..9]:INT");
        assertNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null), "precondiciÃ³n: no chocan");

        c.updateItem(AREA, "", "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT", true);

        assertNotNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null),
                "T3.7: el tag nuevo tiene que entrar en la validacion");
    }

    @Test
    void borrarUnAreaLiberaSuEspacio() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT");
        assertNotNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null), "precondiciÃ³n: chocan");

        c.deleteItem(AREA);

        assertNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null),
                "T3.7: un area borrada no puede seguir bloqueando el rango");
    }

    @Test
    void areaBeingEditedIsExcludedFromOverlapCalculation() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT");
        add(c, OTRO, "%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT");

        // Excluyendo el area-1, el unico solape legitimo es con el area-2, que se
        // pisa de verdad. Si el area en edicion no se excluyera, saldria el area-1.
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig choque =
                c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT", AREA);

        assertNotNull(choque, "el area-2 pisa el rango, asi que debe salir ella");
        assertEquals(OTRO, choque.getUuid(),
                "el area en edicion no debe chocar consigo misma");
    }

    @Test
    void sameTagIsReusedWithoutReparsing() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT");

        // Dos llamadas seguidas con el mismo tag tienen que devolver el mismo objeto,
        // que es justo lo que significa que la cache se esta usando.
        MemoryTag primero = c.areaTag(AREA);
        MemoryTag segundo = c.areaTag(AREA);

        assertSame(primero, segundo,
                "T3.7: el tag ya desglosado tiene que reutilizarse, no reparsearse");
    }

    @Test
    void areaWithoutAddressDoesNotCollideWithARange() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "Zona_Manual");

        assertNull(c.overlappingArea("%DB1.DBB5[0..9]:INT", null),
                "un nombre simbolico no tiene bytes, asi que no puede pisar un rango");
    }

    @Test
    void repeatedSymbolicTagIsDetected() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        add(c, AREA, "Zona_Manual");

        // Este si es el comportamiento wanted: dos areas con el mismo nombre son un
        // duplicado, y para eso existe areaConMismoTag.
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig duplicado = c.areaWithSameTag("Zona_Manual", null);

        assertNotNull(duplicado, "un tag simbolico repetido tiene que avisar");
        assertEquals(AREA, duplicado.getUuid());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationStore;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.SaveResult;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class CommunicationWizardSaveAllTest {

    private static final class AlmacenQueDevuelve implements CommunicationStore {

        private final SaveResult resultado;
        private int writes;

        AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult resultado) {
            this.resultado = resultado;
        }

        @Override
        public List<DeviceConfigData> getDevices() {
            return List.of();
        }

        @Override
        public DeviceConfigData findByUuid(String uuid) {
            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public CommConfigData getComms(String deviceUuid) {
            return null;
        }

        @Override
        public void upsertDevice(DeviceConfigData device) {
        }

        @Override
        public void upsertComms(String deviceUuid, CommConfigData config) {
        }

        @Override
        public boolean removeDevice(String uuid) {
            return false;
        }

        @Override
        public SaveResult save() {
            writes++;
            return resultado;
        }

        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener listener) {
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener listener) {
        }
    }

    private static DeviceConfigData device() {
        Properties p = new Properties();
        p.put("brand", "Siemens");
        p.put("model", "S7-1500");
        p.put("protocol", "S7");
        p.put("deviceName", "PLC de control");
        p.put("deviceKey", "key");
        p.put("description", "");
        p.put("uuid", "uuid-control");
        p.put("enable", "true");
        return new DeviceConfigData(p);
    }

    private static CommunicationWizardController controller(CommunicationStore store) {
        CommunicationWizardController c = new CommunicationWizardController(
                store, new CommunicationWizardState());
        c.getState().setSelectedDevice(device());
        return c;
    }

    @Test
    void completeSaveIsReportedAsComplete() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller(
                new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.success()));

        SaveResult resultado = c.saveAll();

        assertTrue(resultado.isComplete(), "un guardado completo tiene que decirselo");
        assertTrue(resultado.xmlSaved());
        assertTrue(resultado.databaseUpdated());
    }

    @Test
    void failedLoadIsReportedAsNothingSaved() {
        AlmacenQueDevuelve almacen = new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.notSaved(
                "la carga de comunicacion.xml fallo, asi que el modelo en memoria no es de fiar"));
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller(almacen);

        SaveResult resultado = c.saveAll();

        assertFalse(resultado.xmlSaved(),
                "con la carga fallida no se escribe nada, y hay que decirlo");
        assertFalse(resultado.isComplete());
        assertTrue(resultado.message().contains("comunicacion.xml"),
                "el motivo deberia nombrar el fichero: " + resultado.message());
    }

    @Test
    void partialSaveIsDistinguishedFromNotSaving() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller(
                new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.partial(
                        "se escribio comunicacion.xml pero no se pudo actualizar boot.db")));

        SaveResult resultado = c.saveAll();

        assertTrue(resultado.xmlSaved(),
                "aqui el XML si se escribio, que es lo que lo hace distinto");
        assertFalse(resultado.databaseUpdated());
        assertFalse(resultado.isComplete());
        assertFalse(resultado.message().isBlank());
    }

    @Test
    void withoutDeviceNoSaveIsInvented() {
        AlmacenQueDevuelve almacen = new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.success());
        CommunicationWizardController c = new CommunicationWizardController(
                almacen, new CommunicationWizardState());

        SaveResult resultado = c.saveAll();

        assertFalse(resultado.xmlSaved());
        assertTrue(resultado.message().contains("dispositivo"),
                "el motivo deberia decir que falta el dispositivo: " + resultado.message());
    }

    @Test
    void guardarBienDejaLosCambosMarcadosComoGuardados() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller(
                new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.success()));

        c.saveAll();

        assertFalse(c.getState().hasUnsavedChanges(),
                "tras un guardado completo no debe quedar nada sin guardar");
    }

    @Test
    void guardarAPartiasDejaLosCambosPendientes() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller(
                new AlmacenQueDevuelve(SaveResult.partial("boot.db no pudo actualizarse")));

        c.saveAll();

        assertTrue(c.getState().hasUnsavedChanges(),
                "con boot.db sin actualizar, el cambio sigue sin estar del todo guardado");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;


class CommunicationWizardStateUuidNuloTest {

    private static CommunicationWizardState stateWithOneVariable() {
        CommConfigData.GroupConfig grupo =
                new CommConfigData.GroupConfig("uuid-grupo", "Rapido", "d", "100", true, "md5-g");
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig item = new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(
                "uuid-area", "Area", "desc", "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:INT", true, "md5-a", "uuid-grupo");
        CommConfigData.PvConfig pv = new CommConfigData.PvConfig(
                "uuid-pv", "Level", "int", "uuid-area", "0", "descripcion",
                "100", true, false, "1", "5", "d", "f", "u", "2", "6", "1", "md5-p", "Area/Level");

        CommunicationWizardState state = new CommunicationWizardState();
        state.reset(new CommConfigData("PLC", List.of(grupo), List.of(item), List.of(pv)));
        return state;
    }

    @Test
    void buscarUnaVariableConListaLlenaYUuidNuloNoRevienta() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = stateWithOneVariable();

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfPv(null),
                "no hay ninguna fila editada todavia, y eso no es un error");
        assertNull(state.pvByUuid(null), "y por tanto no hay ninguna variable que devolver");
    }

    @Test
    void buscarUnAreaConListaLlenaYUuidNuloNoRevienta() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = stateWithOneVariable();

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfItem(null));
        assertNull(state.itemByUuid(null));
    }

    @Test
    void buscarUnGrupoConListaLlenaYUuidNuloNoRevienta() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = stateWithOneVariable();

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfGroup(null));
        assertNull(state.groupByUuid(null));
    }

    /** Con la lista vacia tampoco hay que reventar, que es el caso que nunca se notaba. */
    @Test
    void withEmptyListsANullUuidDoesNotBlowUp() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = new CommunicationWizardState();

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfPv(null));
        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfItem(null));
        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfGroup(null));
    }

    /** La guarda no puede romper la busqueda normal, que es para lo que existe. */
    @Test
    void validUuidStillFindsItsRow() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = stateWithOneVariable();

        assertEquals(0, state.indexOfPv("uuid-pv"));
        assertEquals(0, state.indexOfItem("uuid-area"));
        assertEquals(0, state.indexOfGroup("uuid-grupo"));

        assertEquals("uuid-pv", state.pvByUuid("uuid-pv").getUuid());
        assertEquals("uuid-area", state.itemByUuid("uuid-area").getUuid());
        assertEquals("uuid-grupo", state.groupByUuid("uuid-grupo").getUuid());
    }

    /** Un uuid que no existe sigue siendo "no encontrado", no un fallo. */
    @Test
    void uuidThatDoesNotExistIsStillNotFound() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = stateWithOneVariable();

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfPv("uuid-inexistente"));
        assertNull(state.pvByUuid("uuid-inexistente"));
    }

    @Test
    void rowWithNullUuidIsNotFoundWhenSearchingNull() {
        CommConfigData.PvConfig sinUuid = new CommConfigData.PvConfig(
                null, "Level", "int", "uuid-area", "0", "d",
                "100", true, false, "1", "5", "d", "f", "u", "2", "6", "1", "md5", "Area/Level");
        CommunicationWizardState state = new CommunicationWizardState();
        state.reset(new CommConfigData("PLC", List.of(), List.of(), List.of(sinUuid)));

        assertEquals(-1, state.indexOfPv(null),
                "buscar null no puede devolver la fila que tambien es null");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.NoopCommunicationStore;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CommunicationWizardUpdateTest {

    private static final String GRUPO_A = "grupo-a";
    private static final String GRUPO_B = "grupo-b";
    private static final String AREA = "area-1";
    private static final String PV = "pv-1";

    private static CommunicationWizardController controller() {
        return new CommunicationWizardController(
                new NoopCommunicationStore(), new CommunicationWizardState());
    }

    private static void twoGroups(CommunicationWizardController c) {
        c.addGroup(GRUPO_A, "Rapido", "desc rapido", "500", true);
        c.addGroup(GRUPO_B, "Lento", "desc lento", "2000", false);
    }

    @Test
    void actualizarUnGrupoCambiaSoloEseGrupo() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        c.updateGroup(GRUPO_B, "Lento editado", "900", true);

        assertEquals("Rapido", c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_A).getName(),
                "el grupo que no se edito no puede cambiar");
        assertEquals("500", c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_A).getScantime());
        assertEquals("Lento editado", c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_B).getDescription());
        assertEquals("900", c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_B).getScantime());
        assertTrue(c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_B).isEnable());
    }

    @Test
    void actualizarUnGrupoMantieneElOrdenDeLaLista() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        c.updateGroup(GRUPO_A, "Rapido editado", "100", false);

        List<CommConfigData.GroupConfig> grupos = c.getState().getGroups();
        assertEquals(2, grupos.size());
        assertEquals(GRUPO_A, grupos.get(0).getUuid(), "el grupo editado sigue en su posicion");
        assertEquals(GRUPO_B, grupos.get(1).getUuid());
    }

    @Test
    void dosGruposIdenticosSalvoElUuidSeEditanElElegido() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        
        c.addGroup(GRUPO_A, "Mismo nombre", "desc", "500", true);
        c.addGroup(GRUPO_B, "Mismo nombre", "desc", "500", true);
        c.updateGroup(GRUPO_B, "Editado", "500", true);

        List<CommConfigData.GroupConfig> grupos = c.getState().getGroups();
        assertEquals("desc", grupos.get(0).getDescription(),
                "T3.1: con equals estructural, indexOf puede devolver la fila gemela equivocada");
        assertEquals("Editado", grupos.get(1).getDescription(),
                "la edicion tiene que caer en la fila cuyo UUID se pidio");
    }

    @Test
    void dosRegistrosIdenticosSalvoElUuidSeEditanElElegido() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        c.addItem(AREA, "Area 1", "", "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, GRUPO_A);
        c.addPv(pv(PV, AREA, "mismo nombre"));
        c.addPv(pv("pv-2", AREA, "mismo nombre"));

        c.updatePv("pv-2", "Editado", "500", true, true,
                "0", "1", "", "", "", "0", "1", "1");

        List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvs = c.getState().getPvs();
        assertEquals("descriptor", pvs.get(0).getDescriptorText(),
                "T3.1: el registro gemelo no puede absorber la edicion");
        assertEquals("Editado", pvs.get(1).getDescriptorText());
    }

    @Test
    void scantimeVacioConservaElAnterior() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        c.updateGroup(GRUPO_A, "Rapido", "", true);

        assertEquals("500", c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_A).getScantime(),
                "un scantime vacio no debe borrar el que ya habia");
    }

    @Test
    void actualizarUnGrupoInexistenteNoRompeNada() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        c.updateGroup("no-existe", "x", "1", true);

        assertEquals(2, c.getState().getGroups().size());
    }

    @Test
    void borrarUnGrupoSinAreasLoElimina() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        assertTrue(c.deleteGroup(GRUPO_A).isEmpty(), "no hay areas, asi que no hay nada que avisar");
        assertEquals(1, c.getState().getGroups().size());
        assertNull(c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_A));
        assertEquals(GRUPO_B, c.getState().getGroups().get(0).getUuid(),
                "el otro grupo debe quedarse en su sitio");
    }

    @Test
    void borrarUnGrupoConAreasAvisarYNoBorra() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);
        c.addItem(AREA, "Area 1", "", "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, GRUPO_A);

        List<String> areas = c.deleteGroup(GRUPO_A);

        assertEquals(1, areas.size(), "debe devolver las areas que bloquean el borrado");
        assertEquals("Area 1", areas.get(0));
        assertEquals(2, c.getState().getGroups().size(), "el grupo no se puede borrar mientras tenga areas");
        assertNotNull(c.getState().groupByUuid(GRUPO_A), "y debe seguir en la lista");
    }

    @Test
    void borrarUnGrupoInexistenteNoDevuelveAreas() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);

        assertTrue(c.deleteGroup("no-existe").isEmpty());
        assertEquals(2, c.getState().getGroups().size());
    }

    @Test
    void actualizarUnAreaMantieneSuGrupoYSuMd5() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        twoGroups(c);
        c.addItem(AREA, "Area 1", "desc", "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, GRUPO_A);
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig antes = c.getState().itemByUuid(AREA);

        c.updateItem(AREA, "desc editada", "%DB1.DBB2:INT", false);

        CommConfigData.ItemConfig despues = c.getState().itemByUuid(AREA);
        assertEquals("desc editada", despues.getDescription());
        assertEquals("%DB1.DBB2:INT", despues.getTag());
        assertFalse(despues.isEnable());
        assertEquals(GRUPO_A, despues.getGroupUuid(), "editar un area no puede sacarla de su grupo");
        assertEquals(antes.getMd5(), despues.getMd5(), "el md5 lo fija el modelo, no la edicion");
        assertEquals(1, c.getState().getItems().size());
    }

    @Test
    void actualizarUnRegistroMantieneElOrdenYElArea() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();
        c.addItem(AREA, "Area 1", "", "%DB1.DBB0:INT", true, GRUPO_A);
        c.addPv(pv(PV, AREA, "pv-0"));
        c.addPv(pv("pv-2", AREA, "pv-2"));
        c.addPv(pv("pv-3", AREA, "pv-3"));

                "-1", "1", "Desc", "%.3f", "u", "-9", "9", "0.5");

        List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvs = c.getState().getPvs();
        assertEquals(3, pvs.size());
        assertEquals(PV, pvs.get(0).getUuid(), "el registro editado sigue el primero");
        assertEquals("descriptor nuevo", pvs.get(0).getDescriptorText());
        assertEquals("750", pvs.get(0).getScanTime());
        assertFalse(pvs.get(0).isScanEnable());
        assertTrue(pvs.get(0).isWriteEnable());
        assertEquals("%.3f", pvs.get(0).getDisplayFormat());
        assertEquals(AREA, pvs.get(0).getAreaUuid(), "editar un registro no puede cambiar su area");
        assertEquals("pv-2", pvs.get(1).getUuid(), "los demas no se tocan");
    }

    @Test

    @Test

    @Test

        assertTrue(c.getState().getItems().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void changesMarkTheStateAsDirty() {
        CommunicationWizardState state = new CommunicationWizardState();
        assertFalse(state.hasUnsavedChanges(), "precondiciÃ³n: reciÃ©n creado estÃ¡ limpio");

        CommunicationWizardController c =

        c.addGroup(GRUPO_A, "Rapido", "desc", "500", true);

                "crear un grupo ya es un cambio pendiente de guardar");

    @Test

                new CommunicationWizardController(new NoopCommunicationStore(), state);

        c.updateGroup("no-existe", "x", "1", true);

                "una edicion que no localiza su grupo no puede ensuciar el estado");
    }

    @Test

@Test

                        new CommConfigData.GroupConfig(GRUPO_B, "Lento", "d", "2000", false, "m")),
                List.of(new CommConfigData.ItemConfig(AREA, "Area 1", "", "%DB1.DBB0:INT",
                        true, "m", GRUPO_A)),

    }

    @Test
    void afterEditingAGroupTheStateIsDirtyAndCanBeDiscarded() {
        CommunicationWizardController c = controller();

        c.updateGroup(GRUPO_A, "Rapido editado", "100", false);

        assertFalse(c.getState().hasUnsavedChanges(),
                "descartar los cambios tiene que dejar el estado limpio");
        assertTrue(c.getState().getGroups().isEmpty());
    }

                "md5-pv", "S88.1");

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.lang.reflect.RecordComponent;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ConfigWithersTest {

    private static final String[] ORIGINAL = {
        "uuid-1", "nombre", "descripcion", "500", "etiqueta", "md5-1", "grupo-1",
        "segundo", "tercero", "cuarto", "quinto", "sexto", " septimo", "octavo", "noveno",
        "decimo", "undecimo", "duodecimo", "decimotercero", "catorce"};

    @Test
    void eachWitherChangesOnlyItsField() {
        for (Class<?> type : List.of(CommConfigData.GroupConfig.class,
                CommConfigData.ItemConfig.class, CommConfigData.PvConfig.class)) {
            for (RecordComponent campo : type.getRecordComponents()) {
                verifyWithOneField(type, campo);
            }
        }
    }

    private void verifyWithOneField(Class<?> type, RecordComponent campo) {
        String name = "with" + Character.toUpperCase(campo.getName().charAt(0))
                + campo.getName().substring(1);
        Object original = exampleInstance(type);
        Object copia = invoke(original, name, campo.getType(), differentValue(campo.getType()));

        assertNotEquals(original, copia,
                type.getSimpleName() + "." + name + " tendria que producir otra instancia");

        for (RecordComponent otro : type.getRecordComponents()) {
            boolean esElCampoEditado = otro.getName().equals(campo.getName());
            Object esperado = esElCampoEditado ? differentValue(otro.getType())
                    : leer(original, otro.getName());
            Object real = leer(copia, otro.getName());
            assertEquals(esperado, real,
                    type.getSimpleName() + "." + name + " no dejo "
                            + otro.getName() + " como estaba");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void withersReturnCopiesNotTheSameObject() {
        CommConfigData.PvConfig pv = pvOriginal();

        CommConfigData.PvConfig copia = pv.withDescriptorText("otro descriptor");

        assertEquals("otro descriptor", copia.getDescriptorText());
        assertEquals(pv.getUuid(), copia.getUuid());
        assertEquals(pv.getS88Path(), copia.getS88Path());
        assertTrue(pv != copia, "una copia tiene que ser un objeto distinto");
    }

    @Test
    void encadenarWithersAcumulaLosCambios() {
        CommConfigData.PvConfig pv = pvOriginal();

        CommConfigData.PvConfig copia = pv
                .withDescriptorText("nuevo descriptor")
                .withScanEnable(false)
                .withDisplayUnits("l/h")
                .withControlMinStep("2.5");

        assertEquals("nuevo descriptor", copia.getDescriptorText());
        assertFalseBoolean(copia.isScanEnable(), "scanEnable debe quedar desactivado");
        assertEquals("l/h", copia.getDisplayUnits());
        assertEquals("2.5", copia.getControlMinStep());
        assertEquals(pv.getUuid(), copia.getUuid(), "lo no tocado se conserva");
        assertEquals(pv.getAreaUuid(), copia.getAreaUuid());
        assertTrue(pv.isScanEnable(), "el original no se toca");
    }

    @Test
    void everyComponentHasItsWither() {
        for (Class<?> type : List.of(CommConfigData.GroupConfig.class,
                CommConfigData.ItemConfig.class, CommConfigData.PvConfig.class)) {
            for (RecordComponent campo : type.getRecordComponents()) {
                String name = "with" + Character.toUpperCase(campo.getName().charAt(0))
                        + campo.getName().substring(1);
                boolean existe = Arrays.stream(type.getDeclaredMethods())
                        .anyMatch(m -> m.getName().equals(name)
                                && m.getParameterCount() == 1);
                assertTrue(existe, type.getSimpleName() + " deberia tener " + name + "()");
            }
        }
    }

    private static void assertFalseBoolean(boolean valor, String mensaje) {
        assertEquals(false, valor, mensaje);
    }

    private static Object exampleInstance(Class<?> type) {
        RecordComponent[] componentes = type.getRecordComponents();
        Class<?>[] tipos = new Class<?>[componentes.length];
        Object[] valores = new Object[componentes.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < componentes.length; i++) {
            tipos[i] = componentes[i].getType();
            valores[i] = componentes[i].getType() == boolean.class
                    ? Boolean.FALSE : differentValues()[i];
        }
        try {
            return type.getDeclaredConstructor(tipos).newInstance(valores);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo construir " + type.getSimpleName(), e);
        }
    }

    private static String[] differentValues() {
        String[] v = new String[ORIGINAL.length];
        Arrays.fill(v, "x");
        v[0] = "uuid-original";
        return v;
    }

    private static Object differentValue(Class<?> type) {
        return type == boolean.class ? Boolean.TRUE : "valor-distinto";
    }

    private static Object leer(Object registro, String componente) {
        try {
            return registro.getClass().getMethod(componente).invoke(registro);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo leer " + componente, e);
        }
    }

    private static Object invoke(Object registro, String metodo, Class<?> type, Object valor) {
        try {
            Method m = registro.getClass().getDeclaredMethod(metodo, type);
            m.setAccessible(true);
            return m.invoke(registro, valor);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No existe " + metodo + "(" + type.getSimpleName()
                    + ") en " + registro.getClass().getName()
                    + "; metodos: " + namesOf(registro.getClass()), e);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo invocar " + metodo, e);
        }
    }

    private static String namesOf(Class<?> type) {
        return Arrays.stream(type.getDeclaredMethods()).map(Method::getName).sorted()
                .reduce((a, b) -> a + ", " + b).orElse("(ninguno)");
    }

    private static CommConfigData.PvConfig pvOriginal() {
        return new CommConfigData.PvConfig("uuid-1", "PV1", "INT", "area-1", "0", "descriptor",
                "500", true, true, "0", "10", "Presion (bar)", "%.2f", "bar", "0", "10", "0.1",
                "md5-pv", "S88.1");
    }
}
