package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class DataTypeTest {

    @Test
    void primitivesHaveTheWeightTheyShould() {
        assertEquals(1, DataType.BOOLEAN.byteSize());
        assertEquals(1, DataType.BYTE.byteSize());
        assertEquals(1, DataType.UBYTE.byteSize());
        assertEquals(2, DataType.WORD.byteSize());
        assertEquals(2, DataType.SHORT.byteSize());
        assertEquals(2, DataType.USHORT.byteSize());
        assertEquals(4, DataType.INT.byteSize());
        assertEquals(4, DataType.UINT.byteSize());
        assertEquals(4, DataType.FLOAT.byteSize());
        assertEquals(8, DataType.LONG.byteSize());
        assertEquals(8, DataType.ULONG.byteSize());
        assertEquals(8, DataType.DOUBLE.byteSize());
    }

    @Test
    void longYUlongOcupanOchoBytesYNoCuatro() {
        assertEquals(8, DataType.find("long").byteSize());
        assertEquals(8, DataType.find("ulong").byteSize());
    }

    @Test
    void onlyBooleanIsBitAddressed() {
        assertEquals(1, DataType.BOOLEAN.slotBits());
        assertTrue(DataType.BOOLEAN.bitAddressed());
        assertEquals(8, DataType.BYTE.slotBits());
        assertEquals(64, DataType.LONG.slotBits());
        assertFalse(DataType.BYTE.bitAddressed());
    }

    @Test
    void nameIsStoredLowercaseAndLookedUpExactly() {
        assertEquals("boolean", DataType.BOOLEAN.label());
        assertEquals("ubyte", DataType.UBYTE.label());
        assertEquals(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.find("float"));
        assertEquals(DataType.ULONG, DataType.find("ulong"));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownNameDoesNotGuessASizeByDefault() {
        assertNull(DataType.find("inter"));
        assertNull(DataType.find("INTER"));
        assertNull(DataType.find(""));
        assertNull(DataType.find(null));
        assertNull(DataType.find("Long"), "el nombre es en minÃºsculas");
    }

    @Test
    void byteFamilyAcceptsByteAndUbyteOnlyOnOneByte() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.UBYTE),
                DataType.candidates("BYTE", 8));
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("BYTE", 16).isEmpty(),
                "un byte no cabe en un DBW sin cambiar el cÃ³digo de Ã¡rea");
    }

    @Test
    void integerSeResuelveConElCodigoDeArea() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.SHORT, DataType.USHORT),
                DataType.candidates("INTEGER", 16));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT),
                DataType.candidates("INTEGER", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG),
                DataType.candidates("INTEGER", 64));
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("INTEGER", 8).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void realOfreceFloatYDoubleSiElAreaEsAncha() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.DOUBLE),
                DataType.candidates("REAL", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.DOUBLE),
                DataType.candidates("REAL", 64));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.DOUBLE),
                DataType.candidates("REAL", 128));
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("REAL", 16).isEmpty(),
                "ni float ni double caben en dos bytes");
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("REAL", 8).isEmpty());
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.DOUBLE),
                DataType.candidates("REAL", 0),
                "sin cÃ³digo de Ã¡rea no se sabe el ancho, asÃ­ que se ofrecen ambos");
    }

    @Test
    void boolAdmiteUnBitEnDbxYOchoEnDbb() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BOOLEAN), DataType.candidates("BOOL", 1));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BOOLEAN), DataType.candidates("BOOL", 8));
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("BOOL", 32).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void wordSoloCabeEnDosBytes() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.WORD), DataType.candidates("WORD", 16));
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("WORD", 32).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownFamilyReturnsNothing() {
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates("STRING", 8).isEmpty());
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates(null, 8).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void theWholePlc4xTypeTableIsCovered() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BOOLEAN), DataType.candidates("BOOL", 1));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.UBYTE), DataType.candidates("BYTE", 8));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.WORD), DataType.candidates("WORD", 16));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT), DataType.candidates("DWORD", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG), DataType.candidates("LWORD", 64));

        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.UBYTE), DataType.candidates("SINT", 8));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.UBYTE), DataType.candidates("USINT", 8));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.SHORT, DataType.USHORT), DataType.candidates("INT", 16));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.SHORT, DataType.USHORT), DataType.candidates("UINT", 16));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT), DataType.candidates("DINT", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT), DataType.candidates("UDINT", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG), DataType.candidates("LINT", 64));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG), DataType.candidates("ULINT", 64));

        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.FLOAT, DataType.DOUBLE), DataType.candidates("REAL", 32));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.DOUBLE), DataType.candidates("LREAL", 64));

        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.UBYTE), DataType.candidates("CHAR", 8));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.WORD), DataType.candidates("WCHAR", 16));
    }

    @Test
    void variableLengthTypesOfferNothing() {
        for (String temporal : new String[]{"STRING", "WSTRING", "S5TIME", "TIME",
                "LTIME", "DATE", "TIME_OF_DAY", "DATE_AND_TIME"}) {
            assertTrue(DataType.candidates(temporal, 64).isEmpty(),
                    temporal + " no deberÃ­a ofrecer tipos porque no se puede medir");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void rawByteArrayEsUnAliasDeByte() {
        assertEquals(DataType.candidates("BYTE", 8), DataType.candidates("RAW_BYTE_ARRAY", 8));
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[0..15]:RAW_BYTE_ARRAY");
        assertEquals("RAW_BYTE_ARRAY", t.family());
        assertEquals(16, t.byteCapacity());
        assertFalse(DataType.candidates(t.family(), t.codeBits()).isEmpty(),
                "y el Ã¡rea tiene que poder usarse con ese alias");
    }

    @Test
    void plc4xTypeNamesKnowTheirOwnSize() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.SHORT, DataType.USHORT),
                DataType.candidates("INT", 0));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.SHORT, DataType.USHORT),
                DataType.candidates("UINT", 32), "el nombre manda sobre el cÃ³digo de Ã¡rea");
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT),
                DataType.candidates("DINT", 0));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT),
                DataType.candidates("DWORD", 0));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG),
                DataType.candidates("LINT", 0));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.LONG, DataType.ULONG),
                DataType.candidates("LWORD", 0));
    }

    @Test
    void plc4xLrealIsADoubleNotAFloat() {
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.DOUBLE), DataType.candidates("LREAL", 64));
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.DOUBLE), DataType.candidates("LREAL", 0));
    }

    @Test
    void siemensTagWithPlc4xTypeFindsItsTypes() {
        MemoryTag tag = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBD0:DINT");
        assertEquals("DINT", tag.family());
        assertEquals(32, tag.codeBits());
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.INT, DataType.UINT),
                DataType.candidates(tag.family(), tag.codeBits()));

        MemoryTag largo = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBLD0:LREAL");
        assertEquals("LREAL", largo.family());
        assertEquals(64, largo.codeBits());
        assertEquals(List.of(DataType.DOUBLE),
                DataType.candidates(largo.family(), largo.codeBits()));
    }

    @Test
    void stringYLosTiposS5S7NoTienenPesoNiSePuedenElegir() {
        List<DataType> sinPeso = List.of(DataType.STRING, DataType.S5TIME, DataType.S7DATE,
                DataType.S7TIME, DataType.S7TOD, DataType.S7DAT, DataType.S7COUNTER,
                DataType.S7DI, DataType.S7AI, DataType.S7AO, DataType.S7VALVE,
                DataType.S7VLV, DataType.S7AVLV, DataType.S7MOTOR);
        for (DataType t : sinPeso) {
            assertEquals(0, t.byteSize(), t.label() + " no deberÃ­a tener peso todavÃ­a");
            assertFalse(t.isEnabled(), t.label() + " no deberÃ­a poder elegirse");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void primitivesCanBeChosen() {
        for (DataType t : DataType.values()) {
            if (t.byteSize() > 0) {
                assertTrue(t.isEnabled(), t.label() + " deberÃ­a poder elegirse");
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- T3.6

    @Test
    void nameLookupUsesTheIndexNotAWalk() {
        // Mismo resultado que el recorrido lineal, pero ahora sale de un mapa. Los
        // nombres se guardan en minuscula, asi que find es exacto: "BYTE" no existe.
        assertEquals(DataType.BYTE, DataType.find("byte"));
        assertNull(DataType.find("BYTE"),
                "find es exacto: el nombre guardado es 'byte' en minuscula");
        assertEquals(DataType.BYTE, DataType.findIgnoreCase("BYTE"),
                "para las mayusculas esta findIgnoreCase");
        assertNull(DataType.find("bytez"));
        assertNull(DataType.find(""));
        assertNull(DataType.find(null));
    }

    @Test
    void caseInsensitiveLookupCoversAllTypes() {
        for (DataType t : DataType.values()) {
            assertEquals(t, DataType.findIgnoreCase(t.label()),
                    "el indice debe contener " + t.label());
            assertEquals(t, DataType.findIgnoreCase(t.label().toUpperCase()),
                    "el indice sin mayusculas debe cubrir " + t.label());
        }
        assertNull(DataType.findIgnoreCase(null));
    }

    @Test
    void theNameListIsAlwaysTheSame() {
        String primera = DataType.names();
        assertEquals(primera, DataType.names(),
                "ahora es una constante calculada al cargar la clase");
        assertTrue(primera.contains("byte") && primera.contains("string"));
    }

    @Test
    void siemensTypesAreDistinguishedFromStandardOnes() {
        for (DataType t : List.of(DataType.S5TIME, DataType.S7DATE, DataType.S7TIME,
                DataType.S7TOD, DataType.S7DAT, DataType.S7COUNTER, DataType.S7DI,
                DataType.S7AI, DataType.S7AO, DataType.S7VALVE, DataType.S7VLV,
                DataType.S7AVLV, DataType.S7MOTOR)) {
            assertTrue(t.isProtocolSpecific(),
                    t.label() + " solo existe en Siemens");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void standardTypesAreNotProtocolSpecific() {
        for (DataType t : List.of(DataType.BYTE, DataType.INT, DataType.FLOAT,
                DataType.BOOLEAN, DataType.WORD, DataType.DOUBLE, DataType.STRING)) {
            assertFalse(t.isProtocolSpecific(),
                    t.label() + " es un tipo estandar, no de Siemens");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void stringNoEsDeProtocoloAunqueTampocoSeOfrezca() {
        // STRING no se ofrece al usuario, pero existe en IEC: no es de Siemens.
        assertFalse(DataType.STRING.isProtocolSpecific());
        assertFalse(DataType.STRING.isEnabled());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertDoesNotThrow;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class MemoryTagTest {

    @Test
    void theGeneralFormWithRangeAndType() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertEquals("DB231", t.block());
        assertEquals("DBB", t.code());
        assertEquals(0, t.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, t.firstByte());
        assertEquals(1848, t.lastByte());
        assertEquals("BYTE", t.family());
        assertTrue(t.hasRange());
        assertEquals(1849, t.byteCapacity());
    }

    @Test
    void theAmountGoesAfterTheType() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0:BYTE[1849]");
        assertEquals("DB231", t.block());
        assertEquals("DBB", t.code());
        assertEquals("BYTE", t.family());
        assertFalse(t.hasRange(), "aquÃ­ no hay rango, hay cantidad");
        assertEquals(1849, t.byteCapacity());
    }

    @Test
    void looseIndexBeforeTheTypeIsASingleItem() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[10]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(10, t.firstByte());
        assertEquals(10, t.lastByte());
        assertEquals(1, t.byteCapacity(), "un Ã­ndice es un elemento, no diez");
    }

    @Test
    void theShortBlockFormIsAccepted() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:0:INT");
        assertEquals("DB1", t.block());
        assertEquals(0, t.baseByte());
        assertEquals("INT", t.family());
        assertEquals(-1, t.bit(), "sin punto final no hay offset de bit");
    }

    @Test
    void bitAddressesCarryTheOffsetAtTheEnd() {
        MemoryTag m = MemoryTag.parse("%M0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals("M", m.code());
        assertEquals(0, m.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, m.bit());
        assertEquals("BOOL", m.family());
        assertEquals(1, m.codeBits());

        MemoryTag db = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBX0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals("DB1", db.block());
        assertEquals("DBX", db.code());
        assertEquals(0, db.bit());
        assertEquals(1, db.codeBits());
    }

    @Test
    void theShortFormAlsoAcceptsBit() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals("DB1", t.block());
        assertEquals(0, t.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, t.bit());
        assertEquals(1, t.codeBits());
    }

    @Test
    void percentAndTypeAreOptional() {
        MemoryTag con = MemoryTag.parse("%MW20:INT");
        MemoryTag sin = MemoryTag.parse("MW20");
        assertEquals("MW", con.code());
        assertEquals("MW", sin.code());
        assertEquals("INT", con.family());
        assertNull(sin.family());
        assertEquals(con.codeBits(), sin.codeBits(), "el % no cambia el cÃ³digo");
        assertEquals(2, sin.byteCapacity(), "un word son dos bytes aunque no declare nada");
    }

    @Test
    void bareAreaCodeGivesItsSize() {
        assertEquals(1, MemoryTag.parse("%MB20").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(2, MemoryTag.parse("%MW20").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(4, MemoryTag.parse("%MD20").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(0, MemoryTag.parse("%M0.0").byteCapacity(),
                "un bit no ocupa un byte entero, asÃ­ que no acota");
    }

    @Test
    void inputAndOutputMarkersAreAccepted() {
        assertEquals(1, MemoryTag.parse("%I0.0").codeBits());
        assertEquals(1, MemoryTag.parse("%Q0.0").codeBits());
        assertEquals("QB", MemoryTag.parse("%QB20").code());
    }

    @Test
    void theDeclaredLengthOfAStringIsAccepted() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0:STRING(20)");
        assertEquals("STRING", t.family());
        assertEquals(20, t.byteCapacity());
    }


    @Test
    void areaCodeGivesTheSize() {
        assertEquals(1, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBX7[0..3]").codeBits());
        assertEquals(8, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB7[0..3]").codeBits());
        assertEquals(16, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBW7[0..3]").codeBits());
        assertEquals(32, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBD7[0..3]").codeBits());
        assertEquals(64, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBLD7[0..3]").codeBits(),
                "DBLD es de ocho bytes, no de cuatro");
        assertEquals(8, MemoryTag.parse("%MB7[0..3]").codeBits());
        assertEquals(32, MemoryTag.parse("%MD7[0..3]").codeBits());
    }

    @Test
    void unrecognizedCodeDoesNotGiveAnInventedSize() {
        assertEquals(0, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBZ7[0..3]").codeBits(),
                "sin cÃ³digo conocido sÃ³lo se puede usar el rango");
        assertEquals(4, MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBZ7[0..3]").byteCapacity(),
                "el rango sigue mandando aunque el cÃ³digo no se conozca");
    }

    @Test
    void rangeIsRelativeToTheTagBaseByte() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB4[0..9]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(4, t.startByteEffective());
        assertEquals(13, t.endByteEffective());
        assertEquals(10, t.byteCapacity());
    }

    @Test
    void rangeStartingElsewhereShiftsTheSameWay() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB4[10..19]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(4, t.baseByte());
        assertEquals(10, t.firstByte());
        assertEquals(19, t.lastByte());
        assertEquals(14, t.startByteEffective());
        assertEquals(23, t.endByteEffective());
    }

    @Test
    void aSingleByteRangeFits() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB0[7..7]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(1, t.byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(7, t.startByteEffective());
        assertEquals(7, t.endByteEffective());
    }

    @Test
    void reversedRangeIsFlaggedInsteadOfRejected() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB0[1848..0]:BYTE");
        assertFalse(t.validRange(), "es un error de tecleo y hay que avisar");
        assertEquals(0, t.byteCapacity(), "pero no se calcula nada con Ã©l");
    }

    @Test
void blockWithoutAddressIsNotAnAddress() {
        assertTrue(MemoryTag.parse("%DB1[]").hasAddress(),
                "DB1 es un cA3digo de Aï¿½rea vAï¿½lido con bloque 1");
        assertTrue(MemoryTag.parse("%DB1[0..9]").hasAddress(),
                "DB1 con rango es vAï¿½lido");
        assertTrue(MemoryTag.parse("%DBI3").hasAddress(),
                "DBI es un cA3digo de Aï¿½rea vAï¿½lido");
    }

    @Test
    void driverAreaCodesAreAccepted() {
        assertEquals("MW", MemoryTag.parse("%MW20").code());
        assertEquals("MD", MemoryTag.parse("%MD100").code());
        assertEquals("IB", MemoryTag.parse("%IB0.0").code());
        assertEquals("C", MemoryTag.parse("%C5").code());
        assertEquals("T", MemoryTag.parse("%T5").code());
        assertTrue(MemoryTag.parse("%MW20").hasAddress());
    }

    @Test
    void garbageWithLettersAndNumbersIsNotAnAddress() {
        assertFalse(MemoryTag.parse("basura1").hasAddress());
        assertTrue(MemoryTag.parse("LD0").hasAddress());
        assertFalse(MemoryTag.parse("contador7").hasAddress());
    }

    @Test
    void withoutRangeTheSizeComesFromTheDeclaredType() {
        assertEquals(2, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:INT").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(2, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:UINT").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(4, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:DINT").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(4, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:REAL").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(8, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:LINT").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(8, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:LREAL").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals(1, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:10:SINT").byteCapacity());
    }

    @Test
    void spaceAroundAndInTheMiddleIsIgnored() {
        assertEquals(1849, MemoryTag.parse("  %DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE  ").byteCapacity());
        MemoryTag conEspacio = MemoryTag.parse("%DB20. DBB4[0..16]:REAL");
        assertEquals("DB20", conEspacio.block());
        assertEquals("DBB", conEspacio.code());
        assertEquals(4, conEspacio.baseByte());
        assertEquals("REAL", conEspacio.family());
        assertEquals(17, conEspacio.byteCapacity());
    }

    @Test
    void driverExamplesAreInterpretedAsStated() {
        MemoryTag bit = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBX0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals("DB1", bit.block());
        assertEquals("DBX", bit.code());
        assertEquals(0, bit.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, bit.bit());
        assertEquals("BOOL", bit.family());

        MemoryTag entero = MemoryTag.parse("%DB10.DBW20:INT");
        assertEquals("DB10", entero.block());
        assertEquals("DBW", entero.code());
        assertEquals(20, entero.baseByte());
        assertEquals(2, entero.byteCapacity());

        assertEquals("I", MemoryTag.parse("%I0.0:BOOL").code());
        assertEquals(0, MemoryTag.parse("%I0.0:BOOL").bit());

        MemoryTag marca = MemoryTag.parse("%MD100:DINT");
        assertEquals("MD", marca.code());
        assertEquals(100, marca.baseByte());
        assertEquals("DINT", marca.family());

        assertEquals(10, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:BYTE").byteCapacity());
        
        MemoryTag corto = MemoryTag.parse("%DB5:10:INT");
        assertEquals("DB5", corto.block());
        assertEquals(10, corto.baseByte());
        assertEquals("INT", corto.family());

        MemoryTag crudo = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[0..15]:RAW_BYTE_ARRAY");
        assertEquals(16, crudo.byteCapacity());
        assertEquals("RAW_BYTE_ARRAY", crudo.family());

        assertEquals("DB1", MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DB0:STRING(80)").block());
        assertEquals("", MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DB0:STRING(80)").code());
        assertEquals(80, MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DB0:STRING(80)").byteCapacity());
        assertEquals("STRING", MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DB0:STRING").family());
    }

    @Test
    void specialAddressesAreNotMemoryAddresses() {
        MemoryTag alarma = MemoryTag.parse("ALM");
        assertFalse(alarma.hasAddress());
        assertFalse(DataType.candidates(alarma.family(), alarma.codeBits()).size() > 0,
                "no debe ofrecer tipos");

        MemoryTag consulta = MemoryTag.parse("QUERY:ALARM_S");
        assertFalse(consulta.hasAddress());
        assertTrue(DataType.candidates(consulta.family(), consulta.codeBits()).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void modbusAddressIsAcceptedAsIs() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("40001");
        assertEquals(40001, t.baseByte());
        assertNull(t.family());
        assertEquals(0, t.byteCapacity(), "sin cÃ³digo ni rango no se puede acotar");
        assertEquals("", t.code());
        assertEquals("", t.block());
        assertTrue(t.hasAddress(), "el nÃºmero es una direcciÃ³n y sÃ­ se puede comparar");
        assertFalse(t.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("40002")));
        assertTrue(t.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("40001")));
    }

    @Test
    void symbolicTagIsNotInterpreted() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("Control_Panel.Start_Button");
        assertNotNull(t, "un tag simbÃ³lico nunca debe rechazarse");
        assertEquals("Control_Panel.Start_Button", t.raw());
        assertEquals("", t.code());
        assertEquals(-1, t.baseByte(), "no se inventa un nÃºmero de byte");
        assertEquals(0, t.byteCapacity());
        assertFalse(t.hasAddress(), "y por tanto no se compara con nadie");
    }

    @Test
    void symbolicTagWithTrailingNumberIsNotMistakenForABit() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("Data_Block_1.Motor1");
        assertEquals(-1, t.bit(), "el 1 final es parte del nombre, no un bit");
        assertEquals("", t.code(), "no es un bloque con cÃ³digo, es un nombre");
        assertFalse(t.hasAddress());
    }

    @Test
    void symbolicTagIsNotSplitInTwoByDots() {
        MemoryTag t = MemoryTag.parse("Struct.Field:Subfield");
        assertEquals(0, DataType.candidates(t.family(), t.codeBits()).size(),
                "una familia inventada no debe ofrecer tipos");
    }

    @Test
    void onlyAnEmptyTagReturnsNull() {
        assertNull(MemoryTag.parse(null));
        assertNull(MemoryTag.parse(""));
        assertNull(MemoryTag.parse("   "));
    }

    @Test
    void cualquierTagRaroSeAceptaYNoRevienta() {
        String[] raros = {
            "DB21.DBB0[0..9",              
            "%DB21.DBB0[0..9]:BYTE:B",      
            "%DB21.DBB0[0,9]",              
            "%DB21.DBB0[",                 
            "%DB21.DBB0:STRING(",           
            "basura",
            "%%",
            "%",
            "Data.1.Struct.Field",
            "%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BOOL:extra",
        };
        for (String tag : raros) {
            assertNotNull(MemoryTag.parse(tag), "el tag '" + tag + "' no deberÃ­a rechazarse");
        }
    }
    
    @Test
    void originalTagIsKeptForMessages() {
        assertEquals("%DB20. DBB4[0..16]:REAL",
                MemoryTag.parse("%DB20. DBB4[0..16]:REAL").raw());
        assertEquals("  %DB21.DBB4[0..9]:BYTE  ",
                MemoryTag.parse("  %DB21.DBB4[0..9]:BYTE  ").raw());
    }

    @Test
    void theAddressIsThePartWithoutSelectionNorType() {
        MemoryTag conRango = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB4[0..9]:INTEGER");
        assertEquals("DB21", conRango.block());
        assertEquals("DBB", conRango.code());
        assertEquals(4, conRango.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, conRango.firstByte());
        assertEquals(9, conRango.lastByte());

        MemoryTag sinRango = MemoryTag.parse("%DB21.DBB4:INT");
        assertEquals("DB21", sinRango.block());
        assertEquals("DBB", sinRango.code());
        assertEquals(4, sinRango.baseByte());
        assertEquals(-1, sinRango.firstByte(), "sin corchete no hay selecciÃ³n");

        MemoryTag palabra = MemoryTag.parse("%MW66:WORD");
        assertEquals("", palabra.block());
        assertEquals("MW", palabra.code());
        assertEquals(66, palabra.baseByte());

        MemoryTag bit = MemoryTag.parse("%M0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals(0, bit.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, bit.bit(), "el bit forma parte de la direcciÃ³n");

        MemoryTag formaCorta = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1:0.0:BOOL");
        assertEquals("DB1", formaCorta.block());
        assertEquals("", formaCorta.code(), "en la forma corta el cÃ³digo no estÃ¡, pero el sitio sÃ­");
        assertEquals(0, formaCorta.baseByte());
        assertEquals(0, formaCorta.bit());

        MemoryTag modbus = MemoryTag.parse("40001");
        assertEquals(40001, modbus.baseByte());
        assertEquals("", modbus.code());
    }

    @Test
    void tagWithoutAddressReturnsTheWholeTagAsIdentity() {
        assertEquals("Control_Panel.Start_Button",
                MemoryTag.parse("Control_Panel.Start_Button").block());
        assertEquals("basura", MemoryTag.parse("basura").block());
    }

    @Test
    void dosRangosSeguidosEnLaMismaDireccionNoSePisan() {
        MemoryTag primera = MemoryTag.parse("%DB22.DBB4[10..16]:REAL");
        MemoryTag segunda = MemoryTag.parse("%DB22.DBB4[17..22]:REAL");
        assertEquals(14, primera.startByteEffective());
        assertEquals(20, primera.endByteEffective());
        assertEquals(21, segunda.startByteEffective());
        assertEquals(26, segunda.endByteEffective());
        assertFalse(primera.overlaps(segunda), "son dos Ã¡reas legÃ­timas");
        assertFalse(segunda.overlaps(primera));
        assertEquals(primera.block(), segunda.block(),
                "mismo bloque y mismo byte de arranque, y aun asÃ­ no se pisan");
        assertEquals(primera.baseByte(), segunda.baseByte());
    }

    @Test
    void dosAreasDelMismoBloqueSeDetectan() {
        MemoryTag grande = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertTrue(grande.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB10[0..5]:BYTE")));
        assertTrue(grande.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("DB231.DBB1848[0..0]:BYTE")),
                "da igual si el usuario pone el % o no");
        assertFalse(grande.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB3000[0..5]:BYTE")));
    }

    @Test
    void areasDeBloquesDistintosNoSePisan() {
        MemoryTag a = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertFalse(a.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%DB232.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE")),
                "DB231 y DB232 son sitios distintos");
    }

    @Test
    void withRangeBytesAreComparedEvenIfTheCodeDiffers() {
        MemoryTag a = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertTrue(a.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBW0[0..100]:WORD")),
                "los dos ocupan los mismos bytes del mismo bloque");
    }

    @Test
    void eachBitIsADistinctSlot() {
        MemoryTag bit0 = MemoryTag.parse("%M0.0:BOOL");
        assertTrue(bit0.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%M0.0:BOOL")), "el mismo bit sÃ­ se repite");
        assertFalse(bit0.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%M0.1:BOOL")), "otro bit es otro sitio");
        assertFalse(bit0.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%M1.0:BOOL")), "otro byte es otro sitio");
        assertFalse(bit0.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBX0.0:BOOL")),
                "otra Ã¡rea de memoria es otro sitio");
    }

@Test
    void areaWithoutAddressOverlapsNobody() {
        MemoryTag grande = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertFalse(grande.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("Control_Panel.Start")));
        assertFalse(grande.overlaps(MemoryTag.parse("40001")),
                "una direcciA3n Modbus no se mide en bytes de bloque");
        assertFalse(grande.overlaps(null));
    }

    @Test
    void tooLargeNumberDoesNotThrow() {
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[99999999999]:BYTE"));
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("%DB99999999999.DBB1"));
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[0..99999999999]:BYTE"));
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[99999999999]"));
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0:STRING(99999999999)"));
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> MemoryTag.parse("99999999999"));
    }

    @Test
    void tooLargeNumberIsLeftWithoutRange() {
        MemoryTag tag = MemoryTag.parse("%DB1.DBB0[99999999999]:BYTE");

        assertTrue(tag.validRange(), "no se puede decir que un rango que no existe vaya al revÃ©s");
        assertEquals(-1, tag.firstByte());
    }

    @Test
    void numbersThatDoFitAreInterpretedAsBefore() {
        MemoryTag tag = MemoryTag.parse("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE");
        assertEquals(0, tag.firstByte());
        assertEquals(1848, tag.lastByte());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ModbusPanelBuilderTest {

    private static ModbusPanelBuilder builder(String protocol) {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = new ModbusPanelBuilder();
        b.initForModel(new DeviceModel("Modbus", protocol, protocol));
        return b;
    }

    @Test
    void tcpVariantDoesNotOfferSerial() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        assertArrayEquals(new String[]{"tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}, b.getTransportOptions());
        assertEquals("tcp", b.getDefaultTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void rtuVariantDefaultsToSerial() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        assertArrayEquals(new String[]{"serial", "tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}, b.getTransportOptions());
        assertEquals("serial", b.getDefaultTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void asciiVariantDefaultsToSerial() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-ascii");
        assertArrayEquals(new String[]{"serial", "tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}, b.getTransportOptions());
        assertEquals("serial", b.getDefaultTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownProtocolFallsBackToTcpVariant() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-weird");
        assertEquals("modbus-tcp", b.getProtocol());
        assertArrayEquals(new String[]{"tcp", "tls", "tls-psk", "udp"}, b.getTransportOptions());
    }

    @Test
    void commonOptionsAlwaysPresent() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> serial = b.getParameterDefaults("serial");
        assertEquals("1", serial.get("default-unit-identifier"));
        assertEquals("5000", serial.get("request-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("4x00001:BOOL", serial.get("ping-address"));
        assertEquals("BIG_ENDIAN", serial.get("default-payload-byte-order"));
        assertEquals("2000", serial.get("max-coils-per-request"));
        assertEquals("125", serial.get("max-registers-per-request"));
    }

    @Test
    void transportOptionsAppearOnlyForTheirTransport() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> tcp = b.getParameterDefaults("tcp");
        assertTrue(tcp.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("serial.")));
        assertTrue(tcp.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("udp.")));
        assertTrue(tcp.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("tls.")));
        assertTrue(tcp.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("tls-psk.")));
        assertEquals("5000", tcp.get("tcp.connect-timeout-ms"));
        assertFalse(tcp.isEmpty());

        LinkedHashMap<String, String> udp = b.getParameterDefaults("udp");
        assertEquals("65507", udp.get("udp.max-packet-size"));
        assertTrue(udp.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("tcp.")));
    }

    @Test
    void tlsCatalogInheritsTcpOptionsAndAddsTlsOnes() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> tls = b.getParameterDefaults("tls");
        assertEquals("5000", tls.get("tcp.connect-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("true", tls.get("tls.verify"));
        assertEquals("false", tls.get("tls.ignore-common-name"));
        assertEquals("PKCS12", tls.get("tls.trust-store-type"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.trust-store"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.trust-store-password"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.version"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.keystore"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.keystore-password"));
        assertTrue(tls.containsKey("tls.keystore-type"));
        assertEquals("false", tls.get("tls.log-session-keys"));
        assertEquals("1", tls.get("default-unit-identifier"));
    }

    @Test
    void tlsPskCatalogInheritsTcpOptionsAndAddsPskOnes() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> psk = b.getParameterDefaults("tls-psk");
        assertEquals("5000", psk.get("tcp.connect-timeout-ms"));
        assertTrue(psk.containsKey("tls-psk.psk-identity"));
        assertTrue(psk.containsKey("tls-psk.psk-key"));
        assertEquals("false", psk.get("tls-psk.log-session-keys"));
        assertTrue(psk.keySet().stream().noneMatch(k -> k.startsWith("tls.")));
    }

    @Test
    void tlsPskNotOfferedByDefaultButIsAPortTransport() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        b.setTransport("tls-psk");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.5");
        b.setPort("802");
        b.addParameter("tls-psk.psk-identity", "mydevice");
        b.addParameter("tls-psk.psk-key", "0011223344556677");
        assertEquals("modbus-rtu:tls-psk://10.0.0.5:802?tls-psk.psk-identity=mydevice&tls-psk.psk-key=0011223344556677",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
        assertTrue(b.isPortApplicable());
        assertEquals("Host/IP:", b.getHostLabel());
    }

    @Test
    void tlsTransportUsesHostAndPort() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        b.setTransport("tls");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.5");
        b.setPort("802");
        b.addParameter("tls.verify", "false");
        assertEquals("modbus-rtu:tls://10.0.0.5:802?tls.verify=false",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    @Test
    void serialTransportIgnoresPortAndUsesDevicePath() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        b.setTransport("serial");
        b.setHost("/dev/ttyUSB0");
        b.setPort("1234");
        b.addParameter("default-unit-identifier", "2");
        assertEquals("modbus-rtu:serial:///dev/ttyUSB0?default-unit-identifier=2",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
        assertFalse(b.isPortApplicable());
        assertEquals("Puerto/Dispositivo:", b.getHostLabel());
    }

    @Test
    void tcpTransportAppendsPortAndParams() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-rtu");
        b.setTransport("tcp");
        b.setHost("127.0.0.1");
        b.setPort("5020");
        b.addParameter("default-unit-identifier", "1");
        assertEquals("modbus-rtu:tcp://127.0.0.1:5020?default-unit-identifier=1",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
        assertTrue(b.isPortApplicable());
        assertEquals("Host/IP:", b.getHostLabel());
    }

    @Test
    void udpTransportUsesHostAndPort() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        b.setTransport("udp");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.5");
        b.setPort("502");
        b.addParameter("udp.broadcast", "true");
        assertEquals("modbus-tcp:udp://10.0.0.5:502?udp.broadcast=true",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    @Test
    void omitOptionalFields() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        b.setTransport("tcp");
        b.setHost("127.0.0.1");
        assertEquals("modbus-tcp:tcp://127.0.0.1", b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    @Test
    void retainParametersPrunesKeysOutsideCatalog() {
        ModbusPanelBuilder b = builder("modbus-tcp");
        b.setTransport("tcp");
        b.addParameter("tcp.no-delay", "true");
        b.addParameter("default-unit-identifier", "1");
        b.setTransport("udp");
        b.retainParameters(b.getParameterDefaults("udp").keySet());
        String url = b.getSpecificParametersAsString();
        assertTrue(url.contains("default-unit-identifier=1"));
        assertFalse(url.contains("tcp.no-delay"));
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertInstanceOf;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class PanelBuilderRegistryTest {

    private final PanelBuilderRegistry registro = PanelBuilderRegistry.withDefaults();

    @Test
    void eachKnownBrandGivesItsBuilder() {
        assertInstanceOf(SiemensPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("Siemens"));
        assertInstanceOf(AllenBradleyPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("Allen Bradley"));
        assertInstanceOf(ModbusPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("Modbus"));
    }

@Test
    void unknownBrandFallsBackToTheDefaultBuilder() {
        assertInstanceOf(SiemensPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("Omron"));
        assertInstanceOf(SiemensPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand(""));
        assertInstanceOf(SiemensPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand(null));
        assertFalse(registro.registers("Omron"));
    }

    @Test
    void emptyBrandDoesNotComplainBecauseItIsNormalOnOldDevices() {
        var warnings = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger();
        var logger = java.util.logging.Logger.getLogger(PanelBuilderRegistry.class.getName());
        var anteriores = logger.getHandlers();
        var nivel = logger.getLevel();
        try {
            for (var h : anteriores) {
                logger.removeHandler(h);
            }
            logger.setUseParentHandlers(false);
            logger.setLevel(java.util.logging.Level.ALL);
            logger.addHandler(new java.util.logging.Handler() {
                @Override
                public void publish(java.util.logging.LogRecord r) {
                    if (r.getLevel().intValue() >= java.util.logging.Level.WARNING.intValue()) {
                        warnings.incrementAndGet();
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void flush() {
                }

                @Override
                public void close() {
                }
            });

            registro.forBrand("");
            registro.forBrand(null);

            assertEquals(0, warnings.get(),
                    "sin marca no hay nada que avisar: el equipo es de los antiguos");
        } finally {
            logger.setLevel(nivel);
            logger.setUseParentHandlers(true);
            for (var h : logger.getHandlers()) {
                logger.removeHandler(h);
            }
            for (var h : anteriores) {
                logger.addHandler(h);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void registeredBrandDoesNotWarn() {
        var warnings = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger();
        var logger = java.util.logging.Logger.getLogger(PanelBuilderRegistry.class.getName());
        var anteriores = logger.getHandlers();
        var nivel = logger.getLevel();
        try {
            for (var h : anteriores) {
                logger.removeHandler(h);
            }
            logger.setUseParentHandlers(false);
            logger.setLevel(java.util.logging.Level.ALL);
            logger.addHandler(new java.util.logging.Handler() {
                @Override
                public void publish(java.util.logging.LogRecord r) {
                    if (r.getLevel().intValue() >= java.util.logging.Level.WARNING.intValue()) {
                        warnings.incrementAndGet();
                    }
                }

                @Override
                public void flush() {
                }

                @Override
                public void close() {
                }
            });

            registro.forBrand("Siemens");
            registro.forBrand("modbus");

            assertEquals(0, warnings.get(), "una marca registrada es el caso normal");
        } finally {
            logger.setLevel(nivel);
            logger.setUseParentHandlers(true);
            for (var h : logger.getHandlers()) {
                logger.removeHandler(h);
            }
            for (var h : anteriores) {
                logger.addHandler(h);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void brandDoesNotDependOnHowItIsWritten() {
        assertInstanceOf(ModbusPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("modbus"));
        assertInstanceOf(ModbusPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("MODBUS"));
        assertInstanceOf(ModbusPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("MoDbUs"));
        assertInstanceOf(ModbusPanelBuilder.class, registro.forBrand("  Modbus  "),
                "los espacios sobrantes no deberian decidir el builder");
        assertTrue(registro.registers("MODBUS"));
    }

    @Test
    void eachLookupReturnsANewInstance() {
        DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder primero = registro.forBrand("Modbus");
        DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder segundo = registro.forBrand("Modbus");

        assertNotSame(primero, segundo,
                "T3.5: si se compartiera la instancia, un dispositivo heredaria los "
                        + "parametros de conexion del anterior");
    }

    @Test
    void returnedBuilderIsUsable() {
        DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder builder = registro.forBrand("Siemens");

        builder.initForModel(new DeviceModel("Siemens", "S7-1500", "S7"));
        builder.setHost("10.0.0.1");
        builder.setPort("102");

        assertEquals("s7", builder.getProtocol());
        assertTrue(builder.getSpecificParametersAsString().contains("10.0.0.1"),
                "el builder recibido por el panel tiene que conservar el host: "
                        + builder.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    @Test
    void registryDeclaresTheBrandsItKnows() {
        assertEquals(3, registro.brands().size());
        assertTrue(registro.brands().contains("siemens"));
        assertTrue(registro.brands().contains("allen bradley"));
        assertTrue(registro.brands().contains("modbus"));
    }

    @Test
    void brandMapCannotBeModifiedFromOutside() {
        try {
            registro.brands().add("omron");
            org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.fail("marcas() deberia devolver una vista de solo lectura");
        } catch (UnsupportedOperationException esperada) {
        }
    }

    @Test
    void ownRegistryAllowsAddingAProtocolWithoutChangingThePanel() {
        Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        byBrand.put("Omron", () -> new FakePanelBuilder("fins"));
        PanelBuilderRegistry propio =
                PanelBuilderRegistry.from(byBrand, SiemensPanelBuilder::new);

        assertInstanceOf(FakePanelBuilder.class, propio.forBrand("Omron"));
        assertEquals("fins", propio.forBrand("Omron").getProtocol());
        assertInstanceOf(SiemensPanelBuilder.class, propio.forBrand("Siemens"));
    }

    @Test
    void enUnRegistroPropioLasClavesSeNormalizan() {
        Map<String, Supplier<DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder>> byBrand = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        byBrand.put("  OMRON ", () -> new FakePanelBuilder("fins"));
        PanelBuilderRegistry propio = PanelBuilderRegistry.from(byBrand, SiemensPanelBuilder::new);

        assertInstanceOf(FakePanelBuilder.class, propio.forBrand("omron"));
        assertEquals(1, propio.brands().size(), "la clave debe quedar normalizada, no duplicada");
    }

    private static final class FakePanelBuilder implements DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder {

        private final String protocol;
        private final LinkedHashMap<String, String> parametros = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        private String host = "";
        private String port = "";
        private String transport = "";

        FakePanelBuilder(String protocol) {
            this.protocol = protocol;
        }

        @Override
        public void initForModel(DeviceModel model) {
        }

        @Override
        public String getProtocol() {
            return protocol;
        }

        @Override
        public void setHost(String host) {
            this.host = host;
        }

        @Override
        public void setTransport(String transport) {
            this.transport = transport;
        }

        @Override
        public void setPort(String port) {
            this.port = port;
        }

        @Override
        public String getDefaultTransport() {
            return "tcp";
        }

        @Override
        public String[] getTransportOptions() {
            return new String[]{"tcp"};
        }

        @Override
        public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameterDefaults() {
            return new LinkedHashMap<>();
        }

        @Override
        public void addParameter(String key, String value) {
            parametros.put(key, value);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeLastParameter() {
            String ultima = null;
            for (String clave : parametros.keySet()) {
                ultima = clave;
            }
            if (ultima != null) {
                parametros.remove(ultima);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void clearParameters() {
            parametros.clear();
        }

        @Override
        public LinkedHashMap<String, String> getParameters() {
            return parametros;
        }

        @Override
        public String getSpecificParametersAsString() {
            return host + port + transport;
        }

        String getHost() {
            return host;
        }

        String getPort() {
            return port;
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class SiemensPanelBuilderTest {

    private static SiemensPanelBuilder builder(String model) {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = new SiemensPanelBuilder();
        b.initForModel(new DeviceModel("Siemens", model, "s7"));
        return b;
    }

    @Test
    void transportIsOptionalAndDefaultsToOfficialScheme() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1200");
        assertArrayEquals(new String[]{"", "cotp"}, b.getTransportOptions());
        assertEquals("", b.getDefaultTransport());
    }

    @Test
    void catalogContainsAllDriverAndCotpOptions() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1200");
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> catalog = b.getParameterDefaults();
        assertEquals(27, catalog.size());

        assertEquals("1024", catalog.get("pdu-size"));
        assertEquals("8", catalog.get("max-amq-caller"));
        assertEquals("8", catalog.get("max-amq-callee"));
        assertEquals("ANY", catalog.get("controller-type"));
        assertEquals("10000", catalog.get("read-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("4000", catalog.get("ha-heartbeat-interval-ms"));
        assertEquals("2000", catalog.get("ha-failover-timeout-ms"));

        assertEquals("1", catalog.get("cotp.local-rack"));
        assertEquals("1", catalog.get("cotp.local-slot"));
        assertEquals("OTHERS", catalog.get("cotp.local-device-group"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.remote-rack"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.remote-slot"));
        assertEquals("PG_OR_PC", catalog.get("cotp.remote-device-group"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.local-tsap"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.remote-tsap"));
        assertEquals("8192", catalog.get("cotp.tpdu-size"));
        assertEquals("5000", catalog.get("cotp.handshake-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.protocol-class"));
        assertEquals("5000", catalog.get("cotp.connect-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.read-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.write-timeout-ms"));
        assertEquals("true", catalog.get("cotp.no-delay"));
        assertEquals("false", catalog.get("cotp.keep-alive"));
        assertEquals("81920", catalog.get("cotp.send-buffer-size"));
        assertEquals("81920", catalog.get("cotp.receive-buffer-size"));
        assertEquals("", catalog.get("cotp.local-address"));
        assertEquals("0", catalog.get("cotp.local-port"));
    }

    @Test
    void noArgAndTransportCatalogsAreIdentical() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1200");
        assertEquals(b.getParameterDefaults(), b.getParameterDefaults("cotp"));
        assertEquals(b.getParameterDefaults(), b.getParameterDefaults(""));
    }

    @Test
    void initForModelSeedsControllerTypeFromModel() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1200");
        b.setHost("10.10.1.33");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-rack", "0");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-slot", "3");
        String url = b.getSpecificParametersAsString();
        assertTrue(url.startsWith("s7://10.10.1.33?"));
        assertTrue(url.contains("cotp.remote-rack=0"));
        assertTrue(url.contains("cotp.remote-slot=3"));
        assertTrue(url.endsWith("controller-type=S7_1200"));
        assertEquals("s7://10.10.1.33?cotp.remote-rack=0&cotp.remote-slot=3&controller-type=S7_1200",
                url);
        assertTrue(b.isPortApplicable());
        assertEquals("Host/IP:", b.getHostLabel());
    }

    @Test
    void explicitTransportCanBeDeclared() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-300");
        b.setTransport("cotp");
        b.setHost("192.168.0.10");
        b.addParameter("controller-type", "S7_300");
        assertEquals("s7:cotp://192.168.0.10?controller-type=S7_300",
                b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    @Test
    void controllerTypeIsMovedToTheEnd() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1500");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.1");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-rack", "0");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-slot", "1");
        b.addParameter("read-timeout-ms", "20000");
        String url = b.getSpecificParametersAsString();
        assertTrue(url.indexOf("controller-type=S7_1500") > url.indexOf("read-timeout-ms=20000"));
        assertEquals("s7://10.0.0.1?cotp.remote-rack=0&cotp.remote-slot=1&read-timeout-ms=20000&controller-type=S7_1500",
                url);
    }

    @Test
    void retainParametersPrunesKeysOutsideCatalog() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-400");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.2");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-rack", "0");
        b.addParameter("pdu-size", "512");
        b.addParameter("legacy.no-delay", "true");
        b.retainParameters(b.getParameterDefaults().keySet());
        String url = b.getSpecificParametersAsString();
        assertTrue(url.contains("cotp.remote-rack=0"));
        assertTrue(url.contains("pdu-size=512"));
        assertFalse(url.contains("legacy.no-delay"));

        b.retainParameters(java.util.Set.of("controller-type"));
        url = b.getSpecificParametersAsString();
        assertFalse(url.contains("cotp.remote-rack"));
        assertFalse(url.contains("pdu-size"));
        assertTrue(url.contains("controller-type=S7_400"));
    }

    @Test
    void removeLastParameterAndClearWork() {
        SiemensPanelBuilder b = builder("S7-1200");
        b.setHost("10.0.0.3");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-rack", "0");
        b.addParameter("cotp.remote-slot", "2");
        b.removeLastParameter();
        assertFalse(b.getSpecificParametersAsString().contains("cotp.remote-slot"));
        b.clearParameters();
        assertEquals("s7://10.0.0.3", b.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class TagDiagnosticoTest {

    private static boolean anyErrors(String tag) {
        return !TagDiagnostico.errors(tag).isEmpty();
    }

    private static boolean anyWarnings(String tag) {
        return !TagDiagnostico.warnings(tag).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void wellWrittenTagsAreNotWarned() {
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:BYTE"), "no debe avisar de un tag vÃ¡lido");
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BOOL"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBX0.0:BOOL"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB5:10:INT"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0:BYTE[1849]"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%M0.0:BOOL"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%MD100:DINT"));
        assertFalse(anyErrors("40001"));
        assertFalse(anyWarnings("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:BYTE"),
                "un tag con rango y tipo no deja avisos");
    }

    @Test
    void rangeThatIsNotARangeIsWarned() {
        assertTrue(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[.0.9]:BYTE"));
        assertTrue(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0,9]:BYTE"), "la coma no separa nada");
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:BYTE"), "pero el rango bueno no avisa");
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[10]:BYTE"), "ni un Ã­ndice suelto");
    }

    @Test
    void unbalancedBracketsAreWarned() {
        assertTrue(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9:BYTE"), "falta cerrar el corchete");
        assertTrue(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB00..9]:BYTE"), "falta abrirlo");
    }

    @Test
    void loQueNoEsUnaDireccionSeAvisa() {
        List<TagIssue> errors = TagDiagnostico.errors("-lkÃ±l{l0'o");
        assertFalse(errors.isEmpty(), "un tag sin forma de direcciÃ³n debe avisar");
        assertTrue(errors.stream().anyMatch(i -> TagIssue.NO_ES_DIRECCION.equals(i.codigo())),
                "el aviso tiene que decir por quÃ©: " + errors);
        assertTrue(errors.stream().anyMatch(i -> i.args().contains("-lkÃ±l{l0'o")),
                "el tag concreto va en los argumentos: " + errors);
    }

    @Test
    void weirdCharactersAreWarned() {
        List<TagIssue> errors = TagDiagnostico.errors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:Ã‘BYTE");
        assertFalse(errors.isEmpty(), "la Ã± no puede ser parte de una direcciÃ³n");
        assertTrue(errors.stream().anyMatch(i -> TagIssue.CARACTERES_RAROS.equals(i.codigo())),
                "debe llegar el aviso de caracteres raros: " + errors);
    }

    @Test
    void symbolicTagIsNotMarkedAsError() {
        assertTrue(anyErrors("Control_Panel.Start_Button"));
        assertTrue(TagDiagnostico.warnings("Control_Panel.Start_Button").isEmpty(),
                "un sÃ­mbolo no necesita ademÃ¡s un aviso de tamaÃ±o");
    }

    @Test
    void unknownTypeIsWarned() {
        assertTrue(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:RAW_BYTE_ARRAY_ALIAS"),
                "un tipo que no existe no debe dejar el Ã¡rea sin tipos");
        assertFalse(anyErrors("%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:RAW_BYTE_ARRAY"),
                "pero el alias de BYTE sÃ­ se reconoce");
    }

    @Test
    void addressWithoutSizeIsWarnedWithoutBeingAnError() {
        List<TagIssue> errors = TagDiagnostico.errors("%DB1:0");
        assertTrue(errors.isEmpty(), "una direcciÃ³n vÃ¡lida no se marca: " + errors);
        List<TagIssue> warnings = TagDiagnostico.warnings("%DB1:0");
        assertTrue(warnings.stream().anyMatch(i -> TagIssue.SIN_TAMANO.equals(i.codigo())),
                "deberÃ­a avisar de que no se sabe el tamaÃ±o: " + warnings);
        assertTrue(warnings.stream().allMatch(
                        i -> TagIssue.Gravedad.AVISO.equals(i.gravedad())),
                "lo que no impide usar el tag es un aviso, no un error");
    }

    @Test
void blockWithoutAddressIsWarned() {
        List<TagIssue> vacio = TagDiagnostico.errors("%DBZ[]");
        assertTrue(vacio.stream().anyMatch(i -> TagIssue.NO_ES_DIRECCION.equals(i.codigo())),
                "un bloque con cA3digo desconocido debe avisar: " + vacio);

        List<TagIssue> rango = TagDiagnostico.errors("%DBZ[0..9]");
        assertTrue(rango.stream().anyMatch(i -> TagIssue.NO_ES_DIRECCION.equals(i.codigo())),
                "un cA3digo desconocido con rango debe avisar: " + rango);
    }

    @Test
    void emptyTagSaysNothing() {
        assertEquals(0, TagDiagnostico.errors("").size());
        assertEquals(0, TagDiagnostico.errors(null).size());
        assertEquals(0, TagDiagnostico.errors("   ").size());
        assertEquals(0, TagDiagnostico.warnings("").size());
    }

    @Test
    void diagnosticDoesNotReturnPresentation() {
        // T3.8: la capa de modelo no debe emitir nada de HTML. El texto lo compone
        // quien lo pinta.
        for (String tag : new String[]{"%DB1[]", "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:Ã‘BYTE", "-lkÃ±l{l0'o",
                "%DB1.DBB0[.0.9]:BYTE", "%DB1:0", "%DB1.DBB0[0..9]:RAW_BYTE_ARRAY_ALIAS"}) {
            for (TagIssue issue : TagDiagnostico.errors(tag)) {
                assertFalse(issue.codigo().contains("<"),
                        "el cÃ³digo no debe traer HTML: " + issue);
                assertFalse(issue.args().stream().anyMatch(a -> a.contains("<br")),
                        "los argumentos no deben traer HTML: " + issue);
            }
            for (TagIssue issue : TagDiagnostico.warnings(tag)) {
                assertFalse(issue.codigo().contains("<"), "el cÃ³digo no debe traer HTML");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void tooLargeNumberIsWarned() {
        for (String tag : new String[]{"%DB1.DBB0[99999999999]:BYTE",
                "%DB99999999999.DBB1", "%DB1.DBB0[0..99999999999]:BYTE",
                "%DB1.DBB0:STRING(99999999999)"}) {
            List<String> codigos = TagDiagnostico.errors(tag).stream()
                    .map(TagIssue::codigo).toList();
            assertTrue(codigos.contains(TagIssue.NUMERO_DEMASIADO_GRANDE),
                    "Â«" + tag + "Â» tiene un nÃºmero que no cabe en un entero");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void normalNumbersAreNotWarned() {
        for (String tag : new String[]{"%DB231.DBB0[0..1848]:BYTE", "%DB1.DBB0:STRING(80)",
                "%I0.0:BOOL", "%DB9999.DBW20:INT"}) {
            List<String> codigos = TagDiagnostico.errors(tag).stream()
                    .map(TagIssue::codigo).toList();
            assertFalse(codigos.contains(TagIssue.NUMERO_DEMASIADO_GRANDE),
                    "Â«" + tag + "Â» no tiene ningÃºn nÃºmero demasiado grande");
        }
    }
}

FILE: commsHmi/src/test/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/model/UrlDisassemblerTest.java

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class UrlDisassemblerTest {

    @Test
    void splitsProtocolAndTransport() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7:cotp://192.168.0.10:102");
        assertEquals("s7", partes.protocol());
        assertEquals("cotp", partes.transport());
        assertEquals("192.168.0.10", partes.host());
        assertEquals("102", partes.port());
        assertTrue(partes.params().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void withoutTransportNorPort() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7://192.168.0.10");
        assertEquals("s7", partes.protocol());
        assertEquals("", partes.transport());
        assertEquals("192.168.0.10", partes.host());
        assertEquals("", partes.port());
    }

    @Test
    void keepsTheParameterOrder() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes =
                UrlDisassembler.disassemble("eip://10.0.0.5:44818?path=1&slot=0");
        assertEquals("10.0.0.5", partes.host());
        assertEquals("44818", partes.port());
        assertEquals("[path, slot]", partes.params().keySet().toString(),
                "el orden importa porque es el que assembleUrl escribe");
        assertEquals("1", partes.params().get("path"));
        assertEquals("0", partes.params().get("slot"));
    }

    @Test
    void leeUnPuertoSerieComoHost() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("modbus-rtu://COM3");
        assertEquals("modbus-rtu", partes.protocol());
        assertEquals("COM3", partes.host());
        assertEquals("", partes.port());
    }

    @Test
    void devuelveNullSiNoTieneElSeparadorDeProtocolo() {
        assertNull(UrlDisassembler.disassemble("192.168.0.10:102"));
        assertNull(UrlDisassembler.disassemble(""));
        assertNull(UrlDisassembler.disassemble(null));
    }

    @Test
    void roundTripKeepsTheUrl() {
        assertRoundTrip("s7:cotp://192.168.0.10:102?controller-type=S7_1500&pdu-size=512");
        assertRoundTrip("s7://192.168.0.10");
        assertRoundTrip("eip://10.0.0.5:44818?path=1&slot=0");
        assertRoundTrip("modbus-tcp://10.0.0.9:502?unit-identifier=3");
        assertRoundTrip("modbus-rtu://COM3");
        assertRoundTrip("modbus-rtu:///dev/ttyUSB0");
    }

    private void assertRoundTrip(String original) {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble(original);
        assertTrue(partes != null, "no se pudo desensamblar: " + original);
        String reconstruida = DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl(
                partes.protocol(), partes.transport(), partes.host(),
                partes.port(), new LinkedHashMap<>(partes.params()));
        assertEquals(original, reconstruida,
                "desensamblar y volver a armar tiene que devolver la misma URL");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- T3.10: IPv6

    @Test
    void leeUnaIpv6ConPuerto() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7://[fe80::1c2d]:102");

        assertEquals("fe80::1c2d", partes.host(),
                "los corchetes son solo notacion y no forman parte de la direccion");
        assertEquals("102", partes.port());
    }

    @Test
    void leeUnaIpv6SinPuerto() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7://[::1]");

        assertEquals("::1", partes.host(),
                "sin puerto, los dos puntos de '::1' no pueden interpretarse como separador");
        assertEquals("", partes.port());
    }

    @Test
    void ipv6RoundTrips() {
        assertRoundTrip("s7://[fe80::1c2d]:102");
        assertRoundTrip("s7://[::1]");
        assertRoundTrip("eip://[2001:db8::a]:44818?path=1");
    }

    @Test
    void normalHostIsNotWrappedInBrackets() {
        String url = DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl(
                "s7", "cotp", "192.168.0.10", "102", new LinkedHashMap<>());

        assertEquals("s7:cotp://192.168.0.10:102", url,
                "T3.10: solo se envuelven los hosts con dos puntos, que son los IPv6");
    }

    @Test
    void unclosedBracketDoesNotBreakParsing() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7://[fe80::1c2d");

        assertTrue(partes != null);
        assertEquals("[fe80::1c2d", partes.host(),
                "malformado, se conserva el texto en vez de cortar la direccion");
        assertEquals("", partes.port());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- T3.10: codificacion

    @Test
    void valueWithReservedCharsDoesNotBreakFormat() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        params.put("comentario", "a&b=c");

        String url = DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl("s7", "", "10.0.0.1", "102", params);
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble(url);

        assertEquals(1, partes.params().size(),
                "un '&' sin codificar partia los parametros en dos");
        assertEquals("a&b=c", partes.params().get("comentario"));
    }

    @Test
    void codificaYDecodificaSimetricamente() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        params.put("ruta", "C:\\maquina\\linea 1");
        params.put("acentos", "presiÃ³n");

        String url = DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl("s7", "", "10.0.0.1", "102", params);
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble(url);

        assertEquals("C:\\maquina\\linea 1", partes.params().get("ruta"));
        assertEquals("presiÃ³n", partes.params().get("acentos"));
    }

    @Test
    void valueWithoutReservedCharsIsWrittenAsIs() {
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        params.put("ipa", "10.0.0.1");
        params.put("port", "102");

        String url = DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder.assembleUrl("s7", "cotp", "192.168.0.10", "102", params);

        assertEquals("s7:cotp://192.168.0.10:102?ipa=10.0.0.1&port=102", url,
                "T3.10: las URLs ya guardadas no deben cambiar al pasar a codificar");
    }

    @Test
    void strayPercentDoesNotBreakParsing() {
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble("s7://10.0.0.1?nota=100%");

        assertTrue(partes != null);
        assertEquals("100%", partes.params().get("nota"),
                "un '%' que no forma una secuencia valida se deja como estaba");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.configphoebus;

import java.beans.PropertyChangeListener;
import java.beans.PropertyChangeSupport;
import java.util.prefs.Preferences;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import org.netbeans.spi.options.OptionsPanelController;
import org.openide.util.HelpCtx;
import org.openide.util.Lookup;
import org.openide.util.NbPreferences;

@OptionsPanelController.TopLevelRegistration(
        categoryName = "#OptionsCategory_Name_Phoebus",
        iconBase = "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/configphoebus/phoebus.png",
        keywords = "#OptionsCategory_Keywords_Phoebus",
        keywordsCategory = "Phoebus"
)
@org.openide.util.NbBundle.Messages({"OptionsCategory_Name_Phoebus=Phoebus", "OptionsCategory_Keywords_Phoebus=abc"})
public final class PhoebusOptionsPanelController extends OptionsPanelController {

    private PhoebusPanel panel;
    private final PropertyChangeSupport pcs = new PropertyChangeSupport(this);
    private boolean changed;

    // 1. Carga los datos guardados cuando el usuario abre la ventana de Opciones
    @Override
    public void update() {
        Preferences prefs = NbPreferences.forModule(PhoebusPanel.class);
        // Recupera el valor. Si no existe, deja el campo vacÃ­o ""
        String rutaGuardada = prefs.get("phoebus.path", "");
         getPanel().setRutaPhoebus(rutaGuardada);
    }

    // 2. Guarda los datos cuando el usuario hace clic en "OK" o "Apply"
    @Override
    public void applyChanges() {
        Preferences prefs = NbPreferences.forModule(PhoebusPanel.class);
        String rutaActual = getPanel().getRutaPhoebus().trim();
        prefs.put("phoebus.path", rutaActual);
    }

    // 3. Activa o desactiva el botÃ³n "Apply" de NetBeans si detecta cambios en el texto
    @Override
    public boolean isChanged() {
        Preferences prefs = NbPreferences.forModule(PhoebusPanel.class);
        String rutaGuardada = prefs.get("phoebus.path", "");
        String rutaActual = getPanel().getRutaPhoebus().trim();
        
        // Si el texto actual es diferente al guardado, hay cambios
        return !rutaActual.equals(rutaGuardada);
    }

    // El asistente maneja este mÃ©todo para inicializar el panel visual
    private PhoebusPanel getPanel() {
        if (panel == null) {
            panel = new PhoebusPanel(this);
        }
        return panel;
    }
    @Override
    public void cancel() {
        // need not do anything special, if no changes have been persisted yet
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isValid() {
        return getPanel().valid();
    }


    @Override
    public HelpCtx getHelpCtx() {
        return null; // new HelpCtx("...ID") if you have a help set
    }

    @Override
    public JComponent getComponent(Lookup masterLookup) {
        return getPanel();
    }

    @Override
    public void addPropertyChangeListener(PropertyChangeListener l) {
        pcs.addPropertyChangeListener(l);
    }

    @Override
    public void removePropertyChangeListener(PropertyChangeListener l) {
        pcs.removePropertyChangeListener(l);
    }

    void changed() {
        if (!changed) {
            changed = true;
            pcs.firePropertyChange(OptionsPanelController.PROP_CHANGED, false, true);
        }
        pcs.firePropertyChange(OptionsPanelController.PROP_VALID, null, null);
    }

}

    private void btnExaminarActionPerformed(java.awt.event.ActionEvent evt) {//GEN-FIRST:event_btnExaminarActionPerformed

        boolean esWindows = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("win");
        String extensionRequerida = esWindows ? "bat" : "sh";
        String descripcionFiltro = esWindows ? "Script de Windows (*.bat)" : "Script de Linux/Unix (*.sh)";

        org.openide.filesystems.FileChooserBuilder builder = new org.openide.filesystems.FileChooserBuilder("DirectorioPhoebus")
                .setTitle("Seleccionar ejecutable de CS-Studio Phoebus")
                .setFilesOnly(true);

        javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter filtro
                = new javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter(descripcionFiltro, extensionRequerida);
        builder.setFileFilter(filtro);

        java.io.File archivoSeleccionado = builder.showOpenDialog();

        if (archivoSeleccionado != null) {
            String ruta = archivoSeleccionado.getAbsolutePath();

            if (!ruta.toLowerCase().endsWith("." + extensionRequerida)) {
                org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                        new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message(
                                "Archivo invÃ¡lido. En este sistema operativo debe seleccionar un archivo con extensiÃ³n ." + extensionRequerida,
                                org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.WARNING_MESSAGE
                        )
                );
                return; 
            }

            txtRutaPhoebus.setText(ruta);
        }


    }//GEN-LAST:event_btnExaminarActionPerformed

        return txtRutaPhoebus.getText();
