package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FilenameFilter;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.TreeSet;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88RepositoryProvider;
import org.openide.util.Lookup;

public final class FormatosDeImportacion {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(FormatosDeImportacion.class.getName());
    public static final Map<String, String> FORMATOS =
            Map.of("xml", "Modelo de planta (*.xml)");

    private FormatosDeImportacion() {
    }

    public static String extensionOf(File file) {
        String name = file.getName();
        int punto = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        return punto < 0 || punto == name.length() - 1
                ? "" : name.substring(punto + 1).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    public static boolean extensionAdmitida(File file) {
        return FORMATOS.containsKey(extensionOf(file));
    }

    public static String allowedFormats() {
        return String.join(" o ", FORMATOS.values());
    }

    public static FilenameFilter fileFilter() {
        return (directorio, name) -> new File(directorio, name).isDirectory()
                || FORMATOS.containsKey(extensionOf(new File(name)));
    }

    public static Set<String> formatsWithoutProvider(
            Collection<? extends S88RepositoryProvider> providers, Collection<String> declarados) {
        Set<String> sinProvider = new TreeSet<>(declarados);
        for (S88RepositoryProvider provider : providers) {
            sinProvider.removeIf(provider::accepts);
        }
        return sinProvider;
    }

    private static final AtomicBoolean AVISO_DADO = new AtomicBoolean();

    public static boolean warnMisalignedFormats() {
        if (!AVISO_DADO.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        Set<String> sinProvider = formatsWithoutProvider(
                Lookup.getDefault().lookupAll(S88RepositoryProvider.class),
                FORMATOS.keySet());
        if (!sinProvider.isEmpty()) {
            
LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Se declaran formatos de modelo de planta que ningun S88RepositoryProvider"
                            + " acepta: {0}",
                    sinProvider);
        }
        return true;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.ImportResult.Exito;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.ImportResult.Fallo;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.PlantSnapshot.AreaNode;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88Element;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88PlantModel;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88Repository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88Storage;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.plant.services.S88ProjectServices;
import org.netbeans.api.project.ProjectManager;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileUtil;

public final class PlantImporter {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(PlantImporter.class.getName());

    private PlantImporter() {
    }

private static final String INVALIDOS = "/\\:*?\"<>|";

    public static ImportResult importPlant(File file, FileObject panel) {
        S88Repository repositorio;
        try {
            repositorio = S88ProjectServices.createRepository(
                    extensionOf(file), new Storage(file));
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No hay repositorio para " + file.getName(), ex);
            return new Fallo(file, "el formato " + extensionOf(file) + " no estÃƒÂ¡ soportado.");
        }

        S88PlantModel modelo;
        try {
            modelo = repositorio.loadPlant();
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo interpretar " + file.getName(), ex);
            return new Fallo(file, describe(ex));
        }

        S88Element root = modelo == null ? null : modelo.getRoot();
        String areaId = root == null || root.getId() == null ? "" : root.getId().trim();
        if (areaId.isEmpty()) {
            return new Fallo(file, "el archivo no define un ÃƒÂ¡rea de planta.");
        }

        File panelFile = FileUtil.toFile(panel);
        if (panelFile != null) {
            FileUtil.refreshFor(panelFile);
        }

        FileObject imageFo = panel.getFileObject("image");
        String problema = targetProblem(imageFo);
        if (problema != null) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se importÃƒÂ³ {0}: {1}",
                    new Object[]{file.getName(), problema});
            return new Fallo(file, problema);
        }

        int fallidos = 0;

        String nombreInvalido = firstInvalidName(root);
        if (nombreInvalido != null) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se importÃƒÂ³ {0}: {1}",
                    new Object[]{file.getName(), nombreInvalido});
            return new Fallo(file, nombreInvalido);
        }

        List<FileObject> creados = new ArrayList<>();
        if (root.getChildren() != null) {
            for (S88Element child : root.getChildren()) {
                fallidos += reverseChildStack(child, imageFo, creados);
            }
        }
        if (fallidos > 0) {
            undo(creados);
            return new Fallo(file, fallidos + " nodo(s) del modelo no se pudieron crear;"
                    + " la importaciÃƒÂ³n estÃƒÂ¡ incompleta.");
        }

        try {
            File dir = FileUtil.toFile(panel);
            if (dir == null) {
                undo(creados);
                return new Fallo(file, "no se pudo escribir " + PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME
                        + " en el proyecto.");
            }
            AreaNode snapshot = PlantSnapshot.collectElement(root);
            File target = new File(dir, PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME);
            PlantModelXml.export(snapshot, target);
            FileUtil.refreshFor(target);
            LOGGER.log(Level.INFO, "Snapshot del modelo de planta en: {0}",
                    target.getAbsolutePath());
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            undo(creados);
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo escribir " + PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME, ex);
            return new Fallo(file, describe(ex));
        }

        if (panelFile != null) {
            FileUtil.refreshAll();
            ProjectManager.getDefault().clearNonProjectCache();
        }
        return new Exito(file, areaId);
    }

    public static int reverseChildStack(S88Element root, FileObject baseDir) {
        return reverseChildStack(root, baseDir, new ArrayList<>());
    }

    public static int reverseChildStack(S88Element root, FileObject baseDir,
            List<FileObject> creados) {
        if (root == null || baseDir == null) {
            return 0;
        }

        Deque<S88Element> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        Map<S88Element, FileObject> dirMap = new HashMap<>();
        int fallidos = 0;

        stack.push(root);
        dirMap.put(root, baseDir);

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            S88Element node = stack.pop();
            FileObject parentDir = dirMap.remove(node);

            if (parentDir == null) {
                continue;
            }

            try {

String name = validFolderName(node.getId());
                if (name == null) {
                    fallidos++;
                    LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Nodo rechazado: {0}",
                            nameProblem(node.getId()));
                    continue;
                }
                FileObject currentDir = createFolder(name, parentDir, creados);
                createCfgFile(currentDir, creados);

                LOGGER.fine(() -> "Propiedades en " + node.getId() + ": " + node.getProperties());
                LOGGER.fine(() -> "check: " + node.isCheck());
                if (node.isCheck()) {
                    LOGGER.fine(() -> "Creando BOB para: " + node.getId());
                    createBobFile(name, currentDir, creados);
                }

                List<S88Element> children = node.getChildren();
                if (children != null) {
                    for (int i = children.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        S88Element child = children.get(i);
                        dirMap.put(child, currentDir);
                        stack.push(child);
                    }
                }
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                fallidos++;
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo crear el nodo '" + node.getId() + "'", ex);
            }
        }
        return fallidos;
    }

static String validFolderName(String id) {
        return nameProblem(id) == null ? id.trim() : null;
    }

static String nameProblem(String id) {
        if (id == null || id.isBlank()) {
            return "a model node has no identifier";
        }
        String name = id.trim();
        if (name.isEmpty()) {
            return "a model node has an empty identifier";
        }

        if (name.contains("..")) {
            return "identifier '" + name + "' contains '..' and could create folders outside the panel";
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < INVALIDOS.length(); i++) {
            char c = INVALIDOS.charAt(i);
            if (name.indexOf(c) >= 0) {
                return "identifier '" + name + "' contains character '" + c + "' which cannot be used in a folder name";
            }
        }
        if (Character.isISOControl(name.charAt(0))
                || Character.isISOControl(name.charAt(name.length() - 1))) {
            return "identifier '" + name + "' starts or ends with a control character";
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static String firstInvalidName(S88Element root) {
        Deque<S88Element> pendientes = new ArrayDeque<>();
        if (root != null) {
            pendientes.push(root);
        }
        while (!pendientes.isEmpty()) {
            S88Element node = pendientes.pop();
            String problema = nameProblem(node.getId());
            if (problema != null) {
                return problema;
            }
            List<S88Element> children = node.getChildren();
            if (children != null) {
                for (int i = children.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    S88Element child = children.get(i);
                    if (child != null) {
                        pendientes.push(child);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

public static String targetProblem(FileObject imageFo) {
        if (imageFo == null) {
            return "the panel does not have the 'image' folder where the structure is created; nothing was created.";
        }
        if (!imageFo.isFolder()) {
            return "'image' exists but is not a folder; nothing was created.";
        }
        return null;
    }

    static String extensionOf(File file) {
        String name = file.getName();
        int punto = name.lastIndexOf('.');
        return punto < 0 || punto == name.length() - 1
                ? "" : name.substring(punto + 1).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static String describe(Throwable ex) {
        String mensaje = ex.getMessage();
        return mensaje == null || mensaje.isBlank() ? ex.getClass().getSimpleName() : mensaje;
    }

    private static FileObject createFolder(String name, FileObject parentDir,
            List<FileObject> creados) throws IOException {
        FileObject folder = parentDir.getFileObject(name);
        if (folder != null) {
            return folder;
        }
        FileObject nuevo = parentDir.createFolder(name);
        creados.add(nuevo);
        return nuevo;
    }

    private static void createCfgFile(FileObject folder, List<FileObject> creados) throws IOException {
        if (folder.getFileObject(ProjectIds.CATEGORY_MARKER_FILE) == null) {
            creados.add(folder.createData(ProjectIds.CATEGORY_MARKER_FILE));
        }
    }

    private static void createBobFile(String name, FileObject folder,
            List<FileObject> creados) throws IOException {
        if (folder.getFileObject(name + ".bob") == null) {
            creados.add(folder.createData(name, "bob"));
        }
    }

    static void undo(List<FileObject> creados) {
        for (int i = creados.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            FileObject fo = creados.get(i);
            try {
                if (fo.isValid()) {
                    fo.delete();
                }
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo deshacer " + fo.getName(), ex);
            }
        }
        creados.clear();
    }

    private record Storage(File file) implements S88Storage {

        @Override
        public InputStream openInput() throws IOException, FileNotFoundException {
            return new FileInputStream(file);
        }

        @Override
        public OutputStream openOutput() throws IOException {
            return new FileOutputStream(file);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
import javax.xml.transform.OutputKeys;
import javax.xml.transform.Transformer;
import javax.xml.transform.TransformerException;
import javax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory;
import javax.xml.transform.dom.DOMSource;
import javax.xml.transform.stream.StreamResult;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.xml.XmlSafe;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.PlantSnapshot.AreaNode;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.PlantSnapshot.Variable;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;
import org.xml.sax.SAXException;

public final class PlantModelXml {

    public static final String FILE_NAME = "plant-model.xml";

    private static final String ROOT_TAG = "plant-model";

    private PlantModelXml() {
    }

    public static void export(AreaNode snapshot, File target) throws IOException {
        Document doc = loadOrCreateDocument(target);
        String areaId = snapshot.id();
        String areaUuid = findAreaUuid(doc, areaId);
        Element areaXml = buildElementXml(doc, snapshot);
        areaXml.setAttribute("uuid", areaUuid != null ? areaUuid : UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        removePlant(doc, areaId);
        doc.getDocumentElement().appendChild(areaXml);
        writeSnapshotDocument(target, doc);
    }

    private static String findAreaUuid(Document doc, String id) {
        Element root = doc.getDocumentElement();
        if (root == null) {
            return null;
        }
        NodeList nodes = root.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++) {
            Node node = nodes.item(i);
            if (node.getNodeType() != Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                continue;
            }
            Element element = (Element) node;
            if ("area".equals(element.getTagName()) && id.equals(element.getAttribute("id"))) {
                String uuid = element.getAttribute("uuid");
                return uuid.isEmpty() ? null : uuid;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Document loadOrCreateDocument(File target) throws IOException {
        if (target.exists()) {
            try {
                // SinXmlSafe, una DOCTYPE con entidades externas permitiria leer ficheros
                // locales o hacer peticiones salientes desde un plant-model.xml manipulado.
                return builder().parse(target);
            } catch (SAXException | ParserConfigurationException ex) {
                throw new IOException(FILE_NAME + " ya existe pero no se puede leer, "
                        + "por lo que la importaciÃ³n se cancelÃ³ para no perder su contenido. "
                        + "RevisÃ¡ el archivo y, si ya no sirve, borralo a mano.", ex);
            }
        }
        try {
            Document doc = builder().newDocument();
            doc.appendChild(doc.createElement(ROOT_TAG));
            return doc;
        } catch (ParserConfigurationException ex) {
            throw new IOException(ex);
        }
    }

    /** Quita el area con ese id, para que la reimportacion la sustituya en vez de duplicarla. */
    private static void removePlant(Document doc, String id) {
        Element root = doc.getDocumentElement();
        if (root == null) {
            return;
        }
        NodeList nodes = root.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = nodes.getLength() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            Node node = nodes.item(i);
            if (node.getNodeType() != Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                continue;
            }
            Element element = (Element) node;
            if ("area".equals(element.getTagName()) && id.equals(element.getAttribute("id"))) {
                root.removeChild(node);
            }
        }
    }

    private static Element buildElementXml(Document doc, AreaNode element) {
        Element xml = doc.createElement(element.tag());
        xml.setAttribute("id", element.id());
        appendSectionXml(doc, xml, "variables", element.variables());
        appendSectionXml(doc, xml, "parameters", element.parameters());
        appendSectionXml(doc, xml, "report", element.report());

        for (AreaNode child : element.children()) {
            xml.appendChild(buildElementXml(doc, child));
        }
        return xml;
    }

    private static void appendSectionXml(Document doc, Element parent, String tag,
            List<Variable> variables) {
        if (variables == null || variables.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        Element section = doc.createElement(tag);
        for (Variable variable : variables) {
            Element variableXml = doc.createElement("variable");
            variableXml.setAttribute("name", variable.name());
            variableXml.setAttribute("Type", variable.type());
            section.appendChild(variableXml);
        }
        parent.appendChild(section);
    }

    private static void writeSnapshotDocument(File target, Document doc) throws IOException {
        Path temporal = Files.createTempFile(target.toPath().getParent(), FILE_NAME, ".tmp");
        try {
            TransformerFactory factory = TransformerFactory.newInstance();
            Transformer transformer = factory.newTransformer();
            transformer.setOutputProperty(OutputKeys.INDENT, "yes");
            transformer.setOutputProperty(OutputKeys.ENCODING, "UTF-8");
            transformer.setOutputProperty("{http://xml.apache.org/xslt}indent-amount", "2");
            transformer.transform(new DOMSource(doc), new StreamResult(temporal.toFile()));
            verificarLegible(temporal.toFile());
            Files.move(temporal, target.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (TransformerException ex) {
            throw new IOException(ex);
        } finally {
            Files.deleteIfExists(temporal);
        }
    }

    private static void verificarLegible(File file) throws IOException {
        try {
            builder().parse(file);
        } catch (SAXException | ParserConfigurationException ex) {
            throw new IOException("El " + FILE_NAME + " generado no se pudo leer, "
                    + "por lo que no se reemplazÃ³ el archivo existente.", ex);
        }
    }

    private static DocumentBuilder builder() throws ParserConfigurationException {
        return XmlSafe.newFactory().newDocumentBuilder();
    }
}

/*

 * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 * KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 * specific language governing permissions and limitations
 * under the License.

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.s88.api.S88Element;

public final class PlantSnapshot {

    public record Variable(String name, String type) {
    }

    public record AreaNode(String id,
                           String tag,
                           List<Variable> variables,
                           List<Variable> parameters,
                           List<Variable> report,
                           List<AreaNode> children) {

        public AreaNode {
            variables = List.copyOf(variables);
            parameters = List.copyOf(parameters);
            report = List.copyOf(report);
            children = List.copyOf(children);
        }
    }

    private PlantSnapshot() {
    }

    public static AreaNode collectElement(S88Element node) {
        List<Variable> variables = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Variable> parameters = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Variable> report = new ArrayList<>();

        for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : node.getProperties().entrySet()) {
            if (!(entry.getValue() instanceof Map<?, ?> map)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (map.containsKey("Type")) {
                variables.add(variable(entry.getKey(), map.get("Type")));
            } else {
                List<Variable> target = switch (entry.getKey().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
                    case "parameters" -> parameters;
                    case "reports" -> report;
                    default -> variables;
                };
                target.addAll(collectVariables(map));
            }
        }

        List<AreaNode> children = new ArrayList<>();
        if (node.getChildren() != null) {
            for (S88Element child : node.getChildren()) {
                children.add(collectElement(child));
            }
        }

        return new AreaNode(
                node.getId() == null ? "" : node.getId(),
                tagFor(node),
                variables,
                parameters,
                report,
                children);
    }

    public static Variable variable(String name, Object type) {
        return new Variable(name, type == null ? "" : String.valueOf(type));
    }

    public static List<Variable> collectVariables(Object value) {
        List<Variable> collected = new ArrayList<>();
        if (value instanceof Map<?, ?> map) {
            for (Map.Entry<?, ?> entry : map.entrySet()) {
                if (entry.getValue() instanceof Map<?, ?> nested) {
                    Object type = nested.get("Type");
                    if (type != null) {
                        collected.add(variable(String.valueOf(entry.getKey()), type));
                    } else {
                        collected.addAll(collectVariables(nested));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return collected;
    }

    public static String tagFor(S88Element node) {
        if (node.getLevel() == null) {
            return "element";
        }
        return switch (node.getLevel()) {
            case AREA -> "area";
            case PROCESSCELL -> "processcell";
            default -> "element";
        };
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.action;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ZipUtilsTest {

    private static Set<String> entries(Path zip) throws IOException {
        Set<String> names = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        try (ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(Files.newInputStream(zip))) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            while ((entry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                names.add(entry.getName());
            }
        }
        return names;
    }

    private static String content(Path zip, String entrada) throws IOException {
        try (ZipInputStream zis = new ZipInputStream(Files.newInputStream(zip))) {
            ZipEntry entry;
            while ((entry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
                if (entrada.equals(entry.getName())) {
                    return new String(zis.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
            }
        }
        throw new AssertionError("no esta la entrada " + entrada);
    }

    @Test
    void comprimeLosFicherosConservandoLaEstructuraDeCarpetas(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(origen.resolve("Image/CELDA1"));
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("panel.cfg"), "contenido del panel");
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("Image/CELDA1/CELDA1.bob"), "plantilla");
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        assertEquals(Set.of("panel.cfg", "Image/", "Image/CELDA1/", "Image/CELDA1/CELDA1.bob"),
                entries(zip));
    }

    @Test
    void conservaLasCarpetasVacias(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(origen.resolve("Image/SIN_NADA_QUE_MOSTRAR"));
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("panel.cfg"), "x");
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        assertTrue(entries(zip).contains("Image/SIN_NADA_QUE_MOSTRAR/"),
                "una carpeta vacia tambien es parte del panel");
    }

    @Test
    void elContenidoLlegaIntacto(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        String text = "uuid=abc-123\nenable=TRUE\n";
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("comunicacion.xml"), text);
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        assertEquals(text, content(zip, "comunicacion.xml"));
    }

    @Test
    void losFicherosNoQuedanBajoElNombreDeLaCarpetaDeOrigen(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("panel.cfg"), "x");
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        for (String entrada : entries(zip)) {
            assertTrue(!entrada.startsWith(origen.getFileName().toString()),
                    "el ZIP no debe repetir la carpeta de origen en cada ruta: " + entrada);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void unaCarpetaVaciaProduceUnZipSinEntradas(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        assertTrue(Files.size(zip) > 0, "un ZIP valido, aunque este vacio");
        assertTrue(entries(zip).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void elOrigenQuedaLibreParaBorrarse(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Path file = Files.writeString(origen.resolve("panel.cfg"), "x");
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        Files.delete(file);
        assertDoesNotThrowOnWindows(() -> Files.delete(origen),
                "el ZIP se cerro mal y la carpeta de origen sigue bloqueada");
    }

    @Test
    void elOrigenSePuedeRenombrar(@TempDir Path origen) throws IOException {
        Files.writeString(origen.resolve("panel.cfg"), "x");
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(origen, zip);

        Path destino = origen.resolveSibling("renombrada-" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID());
        assertDoesNotThrowOnWindows(() -> Files.move(origen, destino),
                "no se pudo renombrar la carpeta de origen: sigue abierta");
    }

    private static void assertDoesNotThrowOnWindows(IoRunnable accion, String mensaje) {
        try {
            accion.run();
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new AssertionError(mensaje, ex);
        }
    }

    private interface IoRunnable {

        void run() throws IOException;
    }

    @Test
    void unaRutaInexistenteFalla(@TempDir Path temp) throws IOException {
        Path zip = Files.createTempFile("panel", ".zip");

        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> ZipUtils.zipFolder(temp.resolve("no-existe"), zip),
                "comprimir algo que no esta tiene que decirse");
    }

    @Test
    void elZipDestinoNoSeComprimeASiMismo(@TempDir Path panel) throws Exception {
        Files.createDirectories(panel.resolve("Image"));
        Files.writeString(panel.resolve("panel.cfg"), "contenido");
        Files.writeString(panel.resolve("Image/CELDA1.bob"), "plantilla");
        Path destino = panel.resolve("respaldo.zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(panel, destino);

        Set<String> entries = entries(destino);
        assertFalse(entries.contains("respaldo.zip"),
                "el zip no puede contenerse: " + entries);
        assertEquals(Set.of("panel.cfg", "Image/", "Image/CELDA1.bob"), entries);
    }

    @Test
    void elZipDeFueraDelPanelTampocoSeArrastra(@TempDir Path panel) throws Exception {
        Files.writeString(panel.resolve("panel.cfg"), "contenido");
        Path destino = Files.createTempFile("respaldo", ".zip");

        ZipUtils.zipFolder(panel, destino);

        assertEquals(Set.of("panel.cfg"), entries(destino));
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.PlantSnapshot.AreaNode;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panel.plant.PlantSnapshot.Variable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class PlantModelXmlTest {

    private static AreaNode area(String id) {
        return new AreaNode(id, "area",
                List.of(new Variable("Temperatura", "REAL")),
                List.of(new Variable("Presion", "INT")),
                List.of(),
                List.of());
    }

    private static Document leer(File target) throws Exception {
        return javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance()
                .newDocumentBuilder().parse(target);
    }

    @Test
    void escribeElAreaConSusIdYUuid(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        Document doc = leer(target);
        assertEquals("plant-model", doc.getDocumentElement().getTagName());
        Element area = (Element) doc.getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").item(0);
        assertEquals("area", area.getTagName());
        assertEquals("CELDA1", area.getAttribute("id"));
        assertTrue(!area.getAttribute("uuid").isEmpty(), "el area necesita uuid");
    }

    @Test
    void elTipoSeEscribeConMayusculaComoEnLosFicherosExistentes(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        String content = Files.readString(target.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        assertTrue(content.contains("Type=\"REAL\""),
                "los lectores existentes buscan 'Type' con mayuscula: " + content);
    }

    @Test
    void reparteLasVariablesEnSuSeccion(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        Element area = (Element) leer(target).getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").item(0);
        assertEquals("variables", ((Element) area.getElementsByTagName("variables").item(0))
                .getTagName());
        assertNotNull(area.getElementsByTagName("parameters").item(0));
        assertEquals(0, area.getElementsByTagName("report").getLength(),
                "una seccion sin elementos no debe escribirse, se leeria como vacia de todos modos");
    }

    @Test
    void reimportarElMismoAreaLoSustituye(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();
        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        assertEquals(1, leer(target).getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").getLength(),
                "dos areas con el mismo id serian ambiguas para el lector");
    }

    @Test
    void elUuidSeConservaAlReimportar(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();
        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);
        String uuidOriginal = ((Element) leer(target).getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").item(0))
                .getAttribute("uuid");

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        assertEquals(uuidOriginal,
                ((Element) leer(target).getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").item(0)).getAttribute("uuid"),
                "cambiar el uuid haria que el operador perdiera lo ya configurado");
    }

    @Test
    void areasDistintasConviven(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);
        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA2"), target);

        assertEquals(2, leer(target).getDocumentElement().getElementsByTagName("area").getLength());
    }

    @Test
    void unFicheroExistenteQueNoSePuedeLeerNoSeSobrescribe(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();
        Files.writeString(target.toPath(), "<plant-model><area id=\"CELDA1\"");
        String original = Files.readString(target.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        IOException ex = assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA9"), target),
                "no se puede decidir nada sobre un fichero ilegible");

        assertTrue(ex.getMessage().contains(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME),
                "el mensaje debe nombrar el fichero: " + ex.getMessage());
        assertEquals(original, Files.readString(target.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8),
                "el fichero que el usuario tenia debe seguir intacto");
    }

    @Test
    void unPlantModelConEntidadExternaNoSeLee(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();
        Files.writeString(target.toPath(),
                "<!DOCTYPE plant-model [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM \"file:///etc/passwd\">]>"
                        + "<plant-model><area id=\"&xxe;\"/></plant-model>");

        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target),
                "una entidad externa debe rechazarse, no resolverse");
    }

    @Test
    void noQuedanFicherosTemporales(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        try (var archivos = Files.list(dir)) {
            List<Path> sobrantes = archivos.filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".tmp"))
                    .toList();
            assertEquals(List.of(), sobrantes, "el temporal deberia haberse movido o borrado");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void elXmlGeneradoSeVuelveALeer(@TempDir Path dir) throws Exception {
        File target = dir.resolve(PlantModelXml.FILE_NAME).toFile();

        PlantModelXml.export(area("CELDA1"), target);

        assertNotNull(leer(target).getDocumentElement());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;

final class DeteccionCategoria {

    static final List<String> FICHEROS_MARCADOR = List.of(
            "template.bob", ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE, "base.oppc", "record.record",
            "base.rcp", "base.rpt", "base.scp", "base.wmg", "base.tlc", "base.rtum");

    private DeteccionCategoria() {
    }

    static Optional<String> detect(ProjectTree raiz) {
        if (raiz == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Set<String> names = new HashSet<>();
        recorrer(raiz, names);
        Optional<String> porMarcador = FICHEROS_MARCADOR.stream()
                .filter(marcador -> names.contains(normalizar(marcador)))
                .findFirst();
        if (porMarcador.isPresent()) {
            return porMarcador;
        }
        return HMICategoryDefinition.byFolderName(raiz.name())
                .map(HMICategoryDefinition::detectionKey)
                .filter(clave -> clave != null);
    }

    private static void recorrer(ProjectTree raiz, Set<String> names) {
        Deque<ProjectTree> pendientes = new ArrayDeque<>();
        pendientes.push(raiz);
        while (!pendientes.isEmpty()) {
            ProjectTree actual = pendientes.pop();
            if (actual.isFolder()) {
                for (ProjectTree hijo : actual.children()) {
                    if (hijo != null) {
                        pendientes.push(hijo);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                names.add(normalizar(actual.name()));
            }
        }
    }

    private static String normalizar(String name) {
        return name == null ? "" : name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }
}

/*

 * specific language governing permissions and limitations

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;

final class FileObjectTree implements ProjectTree {

    private final FileObject file;

    FileObjectTree(FileObject file) {
        this.file = file;
    }

    static ProjectTree fromFileObject(FileObject file) {
        return file == null ? null : new FileObjectTree(file);
    }

    @Override
    public String name() {
        return file.getNameExt();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isFolder() {
        return file.isFolder();
    }

    @Override
    public List<ProjectTree> children() {
        if (!file.isFolder()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<ProjectTree> children = new ArrayList<>();
        for (FileObject hijo : file.getChildren()) {
            if (hijo != null) {
                children.add(new FileObjectTree(hijo));
            }
        }
        return children;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return file.getPath();
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

public enum HMICategoryDefinition {

    IMAGE("image", "Image", null, null,
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    COMUNICATION("communication", "Comunicacion", null, null,
            CategoryIcons.COMMUNICATION),
    NOTICE_MANAGEMENT("warning-management", "Gestion de Avisos", "wmg", "base.wmg",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    RECIPE("recipe", "Recetas", "rcp", "base.rcp",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    HISTORIAL("history", "Historial", "record", "record.record",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    SCRIPTS("scripts", "Scripts", "scp", "base.scp",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    REPORT("report", "Informes", "rpt", "base.rpt",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    TEXT_GRAPHIC("text-and-list-charts", "Texto y Lista de graficos", "tlc", "base.tlc",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    ADMIN_USER("runtime-user-management", "Administracion de Usuarios runtime", "rtum", "base.rtum",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT),
    CONFIG_PANEL("operator-panel-config", "Configuracion de panel de operador", "oppc", "base.oppc",
            CategoryIcons.DEFAULT);

    private final String id;
    private final String displayName;
    private final String fileExtension;
    private final String hiddenFile;
    private final String iconPath;

    HMICategoryDefinition(String id, String displayName, String fileExtension, String hiddenFile,
            String iconPath) {
        this.id = id;
        this.displayName = displayName;
        this.fileExtension = fileExtension;
        this.hiddenFile = hiddenFile;
        this.iconPath = iconPath;
    }

    public String getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public String getDisplayName() {
        return displayName;
    }

    public String getFileExtension() {
        return fileExtension;
    }

    public String getHiddenFile() {
        return hiddenFile;
    }

    public String getIconPath() {
        return iconPath;
    }

    public boolean matchesFolder(String nombreCarpeta) {
        return nombreCarpeta != null && displayName.equalsIgnoreCase(nombreCarpeta.trim());
    }

    public String detectionKey() {
        return this == COMUNICATION ? ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE : hiddenFile;
    }

    public static java.util.Optional<HMICategoryDefinition> byFolderName(
            String nombreCarpeta) {
        for (HMICategoryDefinition category : values()) {
            if (category.matchesFolder(nombreCarpeta)) {
                return java.util.Optional.of(category);
            }
        }
        return java.util.Optional.empty();
    }

    public boolean acepta(String nombreExt, String extension, boolean esCarpeta) {
        if (esCarpeta || fileExtension == null || extension == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!fileExtension.equalsIgnoreCase(extension)) {
            return false;
        }
        return hiddenFile == null || !hiddenFile.equalsIgnoreCase(nombreExt);
    }
}

public class HMIPanelCategorySubprojectImpl implements Project {

    private static final java.util.logging.Logger ExceptionsLOGGER =
            java.util.logging.Logger.getLogger(HMICategoryCreateCommAction.class.getName());
    private final FileObject fo;
    private final ProjectState ps;
    private Lookup lkp;

    public HMIPanelCategorySubprojectImpl(FileObject fo, ProjectState ps) {
        this.fo = fo;
        this.ps = ps;
    }

    @Override
    public FileObject getProjectDirectory() {
        return fo;
    }

    @Override
    public Lookup getLookup() {
        if (lkp == null) {
            ArrayList<Object> services = new ArrayList<>(4);
            services.add(this);
            services.add(new HMIPanelCategorySubprojectInfoImpl());
            services.add(new HMIPanelCategorySubprojectLogicalViewImpl(this));
            try {
                services.add(new HMICommunicationModel(this));
            } catch (Throwable t) {
                Exceptions.attachMessage(t,
                        "El modelo de comunicaciones no pudo inicializarse; "
                        + "se omite del Lookup para no bloquear el Ã¡rbol de proyectos.");
                ExceptionsLOGGER.log(
                        java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                        "No se pudo crear el modelo de comunicaciones del proyecto "
                                + getProjectDirectory().getName()
                                + "; el asistente de comunicaciÃ³n quedarÃ¡ sin funcionar.",
                        t);
            }
            lkp = Lookups.fixed(services.toArray());
        }
        return lkp;
    }

    public class HMIPanelCategorySubprojectInfoImpl implements ProjectInformation {

        @StaticResource()
        public static final String PROJECT_ICON = "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/hmipanelsubprojectcategory/FolderBlue.png";

        }
    }

    public class HMIPanelCategorySubprojectLogicalViewImpl implements LogicalViewProvider {

        @StaticResource()
        public static final String CATEGORY_SUBPROJECT_ICON = "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/hmipanelsubprojectcategory/FolderBlue.png";

        private final Project project;

        public HMIPanelCategorySubprojectLogicalViewImpl(Project project) {
            this.project = project;
        }

        public Node createLogicalView() {
            try {
                //Obtain the project directory's node:
                FileObject projectDirectory = project.getProjectDirectory();
                DataFolder projectFolder = DataFolder.findFolder(projectDirectory);
                Node nodeOfProjectFolder = projectFolder.getNodeDelegate();
                return new PanelProjectNode(nodeOfProjectFolder, project);
            } catch (DataObjectNotFoundException donfe) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(donfe);
                return new AbstractNode(Children.LEAF);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public Node findPath(Node node, Object o) {
            return null;
        }

        private final class PanelProjectNode extends FilterNode {

            final Project project;

            public PanelProjectNode(Node node, Project project)
                    throws DataObjectNotFoundException {
                super(node,
                        NodeFactorySupport.createCompositeChildren(project,
                                "Projects/org-apache-plc4x-category/Nodes"),

                        new ProxyLookup(
                                new Lookup[]{
                                    Lookups.singleton(project),
                                    node.getLookup()
                                }));
                this.project = project;
            }

            public Action[] getActions(boolean context) {
                Optional<String> detected = DeteccionCategoria.detect(
                        FileObjectTree.fromFileObject(this.project.getProjectDirectory()));
                if (detected.isEmpty()) {
                    return getActionForName(new Action[0]);
                }

                // Identificar la acciÃ³n especÃ­fica asociada al archivo
                Action[] customAction = switch (detected.get()) {
                    case "template.bob" ->
                        new Action[]{
                            new HMICategoryCreateDisplayAction(this.project),                        
                        };
                    case ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE ->
                        new Action[]{
                            new HMICategoryCreateCommAction(this.project),
                            new HMICategoryCreateDeviceAction(this.project),
                        };
//                    case "base.oppc" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateOperatorPanelConfigAction(this.project);
//                    case "record.record" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateRecordAction(this.project);
//                    case "base.rcp" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateRecipeAction(this.project);
//                    case "base.rpt" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateReportAction(this.project);
//                    case "base.scp" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateScriptsAction(this.project);
//                    case "base.wmg" ->
//                        new HMICategoryCreateWarningManagementAction(this.project);
                    default ->
                        new Action[0];
                };
                return getActionForName(customAction);
            }

            public Action[] getActionForName(Action[] customAction) {
                List<Action> actionList = new ArrayList<>();

                // 2. Si existen acciones personalizadas, agregamos separador y el listado
                if (customAction.length > 0) {
                    actionList.addAll(Arrays.asList(customAction));
                }

                return actionList.toArray(Action[]::new);
            }

            @Override
            public Image getIcon(int type) {
                return ImageUtilities.loadImage(CATEGORY_SUBPROJECT_ICON);
            }

            @Override
            public Image getOpenedIcon(int type) {
                return getIcon(type);
            }

            @Override
            public String getDisplayName() {
                return project.getProjectDirectory().getName();
            }

        }
    }

}

import org.openide.DialogDisplayer;
import org.openide.NotifyDescriptor;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import javax.swing.Action;

public abstract class AbstractNotImplementedAction extends AbstractAction {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(AbstractNotImplementedAction.class.getName());

    private final FileObject fileObject;

    protected AbstractNotImplementedAction(String name, FileObject fileObject) {
        super(name);
        this.fileObject = fileObject;
    }

    protected final FileObject fileObject() {
        return fileObject;
    }

    public String notImplementedMessage() {
        String name = getValue(Action.NAME) == null ? getClass().getSimpleName()
                : String.valueOf(getValue(Action.NAME));
        return "La acciÃ³n '" + name + "' todavÃ­a no estÃ¡ implementada.";
    }

    @Override
    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
        String mensaje = notImplementedMessage();
        LOGGER.log(Level.FINE, "{0} sobre {1}",
                new Object[]{mensaje, fileObject == null ? null : fileObject.getNameExt()});
        try {
            DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                    new NotifyDescriptor.Message(mensaje, NotifyDescriptor.WARNING_MESSAGE));
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.FINE, "No se pudo mostrar el aviso de accion no implementada", ex);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action;

import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import javax.swing.AbstractAction;
import javax.swing.Action;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.CreateDisplay;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.openide.DialogDescriptor;
import org.openide.DialogDisplayer;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.util.ContextAwareAction;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.Lookup;


public class HMICategoryCreateDisplayAction extends AbstractAction implements ContextAwareAction {

    private final static String FILE_NAME_DISPLAY_EXT = "bob";
    public final static String DISPLAY_TEMPLATE_PATH =
            "org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/ftype/DisplayTemplate.bob";
    private Project project;

    public HMICategoryCreateDisplayAction(Project project) {
        super("Crear pantalla");
        this.project = project;
    }

    @Override
    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
        FileObject targetFolder = project.getProjectDirectory();

        CreateDisplay cd = new CreateDisplay();

        DialogDescriptor descriptorText = new DialogDescriptor(
                cd,
                "Crear Display",
                true,
                new Object[0],
                null,
                DialogDescriptor.DEFAULT_ALIGN,
                null,
                null
        );

        DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(descriptorText);

        if (cd.isConfirmed()) {
            String fileName = cd.getFileName();
            try (InputStream in = getClass().getClassLoader()
                    .getResourceAsStream(DISPLAY_TEMPLATE_PATH)) {

                if (in == null) {
                    throw new IOException("No se encontro la plantilla " + DISPLAY_TEMPLATE_PATH);
                }

                FileObject newFile = targetFolder.createData(fileName, FILE_NAME_DISPLAY_EXT);

                try (OutputStream out = newFile.getOutputStream()) {
                    in.transferTo(out);
                }

            } catch (IOException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null,
                        "No se pudo crear la pantalla: " + ex.getMessage(),
                        "Crear pantalla", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Action createContextAwareInstance(Lookup lkp) {
        return null;
    }
    

}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action;

import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import javax.swing.AbstractAction;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.RequestProcessor;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;


public class HMICategoryDuplicateDisplayAction extends AbstractAction{

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(HMICategoryDuplicateDisplayAction.class.getName());
     private final FileObject bobFile;

    public HMICategoryDuplicateDisplayAction(FileObject bobFile) {
        super("Duplicar pantalla");
        this.bobFile = bobFile;
    }

    @Override
    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
        RequestProcessor.getDefault().post(() -> duplicate(this.bobFile));
    }
    
    private void duplicate(FileObject nuevobobFile){
        FileObject parent = nuevobobFile.getParent();
        if (parent == null) {
            return;
        }
        //Nombre base sin extensiÃ³n
        String baseName = nuevobobFile.getName();
        String ext = nuevobobFile.getExt();
        //Buscar un nombre libre: base - copia, base - copia2, ...
        String newName = baseName + "_copia";
        int n = 2;
        while (parent.getFileObject(newName, ext) != null) {
            newName = baseName + "_copia" + n++;
        }
        try {
            FileObject newFile = parent.createData(newName, ext);
            try (InputStream in = nuevobobFile.getInputStream();
                 OutputStream out = newFile.getOutputStream()) {
                in.transferTo(out);
            }
                LOGGER.log(Level.INFO, "[Duplicar] Creado: {0}", newFile.getNameExt());
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action;

import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import javax.swing.AbstractAction;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileUtil;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.RequestProcessor;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.configphoebus.PhoebusOptionsPanelController;

public class HMICategoryOpenPhoebusAction extends AbstractAction {


    private final FileObject bobFile;

    public HMICategoryOpenPhoebusAction(FileObject bobFile) {
        this.bobFile = bobFile;
        putValue(NAME, "Abrir en Phoebus");
    }

    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
        RequestProcessor.getDefault().post(() -> openNativeBob(this.bobFile));
    }

    private void openNativeBob(FileObject nuevoArchivoBob) {
        File file = FileUtil.toFile(nuevoArchivoBob);
        if (file == null) {
            return;
        }

        java.util.prefs.Preferences prefs = org.openide.util.NbPreferences.forModule(PhoebusOptionsPanelController.class);
        String rutaPhoebus = prefs.get("phoebus.path", "").trim();

        if (rutaPhoebus.isEmpty()) {
            org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                    new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message("Por favor, configure la ruta de Phoebus en Tools -> Options.",
                            org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.INFORMATION_MESSAGE)
            );
            return;
        }

        boolean esWindows = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase().contains("win");
        File ejecutablePhoebus = new File(rutaPhoebus);

        if (esWindows) {
            if (!rutaPhoebus.toLowerCase().endsWith(".bat")) {
                org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                        new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message(
                                "Error de configuraciÃ³n: En Windows, la herramienta externa de Phoebus debe apuntar a un archivo ejecutable '.bat'.\nPor favor, corrÃ­jalo en Tools -> Options.",
                                org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.ERROR_MESSAGE)
                );
                return;
            }
        } else {
            if (!rutaPhoebus.toLowerCase().endsWith(".sh")) {
                org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                        new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message(
                                "Error de configuraciÃ³n: En sistemas Unix/Linux, la herramienta externa de Phoebus debe apuntar a un script '.sh'.\nPor favor, corrÃ­jalo en Tools -> Options.",
                                org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.ERROR_MESSAGE)
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        if (!ejecutablePhoebus.exists()) {
            org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                    new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message(
                            "El archivo configurado para Phoebus no existe en la ruta especificada:\n" + rutaPhoebus,
                            org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.ERROR_MESSAGE)
            );
            return;
        }

        try {
            Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento();
            Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(
                    Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home", ".")));
            String content = PhoebusLauncher.contentFor(file.toPath(),
                    System.getProperty("user.name", "user"));
            PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, content);

            ProcessBuilder pb = PhoebusLauncher.command(rutaPhoebus);
            Process proceso = pb.start();
            PhoebusLauncher.waitAndRestore(proceso, memento, respaldo, content);

        } catch (Exception ex) {
            org.openide.DialogDisplayer.getDefault().notify(
                    new org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.Message("Error al intentar ejecutar Phoebus: " + ex.getMessage(),
                            org.openide.NotifyDescriptor.ERROR_MESSAGE)
            );
            Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
        }
    }

}

FILE: HMIPanelSubprojectCategory/src/main/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/action/PhoebusLauncher.java

/*
 * Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
 * or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
 * distributed with this work for additional information
 * regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
 * to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
 * "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
 * with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
 *
 *   https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
 *
 * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 * software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 * KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 * specific language governing permissions and limitations
 * under the License.
 */
package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

final class PhoebusLauncher {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(PhoebusLauncher.class.getName());

    static final String MEMENTO = "memento";
    static final String RESPALDO = "memento.malbec.bak";

    private static final String PLANTILLA =
            "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"yes\"?>\n"
            + "<memento default_application=\"Display Editor\" last_opened_file=\"\""
            + " show_menu=\"false\" show_statusbar=\"false\" show_tabs=\"false\""
            + " show_toolbar=\"false\">\n"
            + "    <DockStage_MAIN height=\"1000.0\" maximized=\"true\" width=\"1296.0\""
            + " x=\"-8.0\" y=\"-8.0\">\n"
            + "        <pane selected=\"0\">\n"
            + "            <DockItem_%ID% application=\"display_editor\" user_name=\"%USER%\""
            + " input_uri=\"%URI%\"/>\n"
            + "        </pane>\n"
            + "    </DockStage_MAIN>\n"
            + "</memento>\n";

    private PhoebusLauncher() {
    }

    static Path rutaMemento() {
        return rutaMemento(Paths.get(System.getProperty("user.home", ".")));
    }

    static Path rutaMemento(Path home) {
        return home.resolve(".phoebus").resolve(MEMENTO);
    }

    static Path backupPath(Path home) {
        return home.resolve(".phoebus").resolve(RESPALDO);
    }

    static ProcessBuilder command(String rutaPhoebus) {
        ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(rutaPhoebus, "-nosplash", "-edit", "");
        pb.redirectErrorStream(true);
        pb.redirectOutput(ProcessBuilder.Redirect.DISCARD);
        return pb;
    }

    static String contentFor(Path bob, String usuario) {
        return PLANTILLA
                .replace("%ID%", "DockItem_"
                        + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "_"))
                .replace("%USER%", escapar(usuario))
                .replace("%URI%", escapar(bob.toUri().toString()));
    }

    static void writeMemento(Path memento, Path respaldo, String content) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        if (Files.exists(memento)) {
            if (!Files.exists(respaldo)) {
                Files.copy(memento, respaldo);
            }
        } else {
            Files.deleteIfExists(respaldo);
        }
        Files.write(memento, content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    static void restoreIfStillOurs(Path memento, Path respaldo, String escrito) {
        try {
            if (!Files.exists(respaldo)) {
                return;
            }
            String actual = Files.readString(memento, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            if (!actual.equals(escrito)) {
                return;
            }
            Files.copy(respaldo, memento, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            Files.deleteIfExists(respaldo);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo restaurar el memento de Phoebus", ex);
        }
    }

    static void waitAndRestore(Process proceso, Path memento, Path respaldo, String escrito) {
        Thread hilo = new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                proceso.waitFor();
            } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                return;
            }
            restoreIfStillOurs(memento, respaldo, escrito);
        }, "malbec-restaura-memento");
        hilo.setDaemon(true);
        hilo.start();
    }

    private static String escapar(String s) {
        if (s == null) {
            return "";
        }
        return s.replace("&", "&amp;")
                .replace("\"", "&quot;")
                .replace("<", "&lt;")
                .replace(">", "&gt;");
    }
}

 */
package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;

final class CommConfigLoader {

    /**
     * @param config         la configuracion leida, ya con los UUID reparados
     * @param uuidReparados  si hizo falta rellenar algun UUID ausente, para saber
     *                       si el fichero debe reescribirse
     */
    record Result(CommunicationsConfig config, boolean uuidReparados) {
    }

    private final CommConfigRepository repository;

    CommConfigLoader(CommConfigRepository repository) {
        if (repository == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("hace falta un repositorio de configuraciÃ³n");
        }
        this.repository = repository;
    }

    Result load() throws Exception {
        CommunicationsConfig config = repository.load();
        if (config == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "el repositorio devolviÃ³ una configuraciÃ³n nula en lugar de una vacÃ­a");
        }
        boolean reparados = HMICommunicationModel.repararUuidsAusentes(config);
        return new Result(config, reparados);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepositoryProvider;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.openide.util.Lookup;

public final class CommConfigRepositoryLookup {

    private CommConfigRepositoryLookup() {
    }

    public static CommConfigRepository createRepository(CommConfigStorage storage) {
        for (CommConfigRepositoryProvider provider
                : Lookup.getDefault().lookupAll(CommConfigRepositoryProvider.class)) {
            return provider.createRepository(storage);
        }
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "No hay ningun CommConfigRepositoryProvider registrado en el Lookup");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.UUID;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationsConfig;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationStore;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence.BootDbRepository;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.persistence.RebuildResultado;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.openide.util.ChangeSupport;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.SaveResult;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public final class HMICommunicationModel implements CommunicationStore {

    public static final String CONFIG_FILE = ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE;
    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(HMICommunicationModel.class.getName());
    private final ProjectStorage storage;
    private final ChangeSupport cs = new ChangeSupport(this);
    private final ReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
    private CommConfigRepository repository;
    private CommunicationsConfig config;
    private Exception loadError;

    public HMICommunicationModel(Project project) {
        this(new NetBeansProjectStorage(project));
    }

    HMICommunicationModel(ProjectStorage storage) {
        this.storage = storage;
        storage.setOnChanged(this::reload);
        storage.setOnDeleted(this::ensureFile);
        reload();
    }

    public final void reload() {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            reloadInternal();
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private void reloadInternal() {
        boolean commProject = isCommunicationProject();
        if (!commProject) {
            forgetConfiguration();
            loadError = null;
            notifyChange();
            return;
        }

        boolean created = false;
        CommConfigStorage configStorage = storage.config();
        if (configStorage == null) {
            try {
                configStorage = storage.createConfig();
                created = true;
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                configStorage = null;
            }
        }
        if (configStorage == null) {
            loadError = new IOException("no se pudo crear " + CONFIG_FILE
                    + " en el proyecto " + storage.directoryName());
            config = new CommunicationsConfig();
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, loadError.getMessage());
            notifyChange();
            return;
        }

        storage.watchForChanges();
        repository = CommConfigRepositoryLookup.createRepository(configStorage);
        CommConfigLoader.Result carga;
        try {
            carga = new CommConfigLoader(repository).load();
        } catch (Exception ex) {

            loadError = ex;
            if (config == null) {
                config = new CommunicationsConfig();
            }
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo cargar " + CONFIG_FILE
                    + "; se conserva la configuraciÃ³n anterior.", ex);
            notifyChange();
            return;
        }
        loadError = null;
        config = carga.config();
        if (created || carga.uuidReparados()) {
            write(repository, created);
        }
        notifyChange();
    }

    private boolean isCommunicationProject() {
        return HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.matchesFolder(storage.directoryName())
                || storage.has(CONFIG_FILE)
                || storage.has("comm.merlot");
    }

    private void forgetConfiguration() {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            repository = null;
            config = new CommunicationsConfig();
            loadError = null;
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private void ensureFile() {
        forgetConfiguration();
        if (!isCommunicationProject()) {
            return;
        }
        CommConfigStorage destino = null;
        try {
            destino = storage.config();
            if (destino == null) {
                destino = storage.createConfig();
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo recrear " + CONFIG_FILE, ex);
            return;
        }
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            CommConfigRepository repo = CommConfigRepositoryLookup.createRepository(destino);
            write(repo, true);
            storage.watchForChanges();
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo escribir " + CONFIG_FILE + " recien creado", ex);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private void write(CommConfigRepository destino, boolean archivoNuevo) {
        storage.pauseNotifications();
        try {
            destino.save(config);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            if (archivoNuevo) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.FINE, "Se dejara para el primer guardado: " + ex.getMessage());
            } else {
                LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING,
                        "No se pudo guardar el UUID reparado de " + CONFIG_FILE, ex);
            }
        } finally {
            storage.resumeNotifications();
        }
    }

    static boolean repararUuidsAusentes(CommunicationsConfig config) {
        boolean reparado = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < config.getDevices().size(); i++) {
            DeviceConfigData device = config.getDevices().get(i);
            if (device.getUuid() != null && !device.getUuid().isBlank()) {
                continue;
            }
            reparado = true;
            String uuid = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, CONFIG_FILE + ": el dispositivo '{0}' no tenÃ­a UUID "
                    + "y recibiÃ³ {1} al cargar.",
                    new Object[]{device.getDeviceName(), uuid});
            Properties p = new Properties();
            p.put("brand", device.getBrand());
            p.put("model", device.getModel());
            p.put("protocol", device.getProtocol());
            p.put("deviceName", device.getDeviceName());
            p.put("deviceKey", device.getDeviceKey() == null ? "" : device.getDeviceKey());
            p.put("description", device.getDescription());
            p.put("uuid", uuid);
            p.put("enable", device.isEnabled());
            p.put("s88Node", device.getS88Node() == null ? "" : device.getS88Node());
            p.put("s88Uuid", device.getS88Uuid() == null ? "" : device.getS88Uuid());
            p.put("specificParameters",
                    device.getSpecificParameters() == null ? "" : device.getSpecificParameters());
            config.replaceDevice(i, new DeviceConfigData(p));
        }
        return reparado;
    }

    public Optional<Exception> getLoadError() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return Optional.ofNullable(loadError);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public List<DeviceConfigData> getDevices() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return List.copyOf(config.getDevices());
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public DeviceConfigData findByUuid(String uuid) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return config.findByUuid(uuid);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public CommConfigData getComms(String deviceUuid) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return config.getComms(deviceUuid);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void upsertDevice(DeviceConfigData device) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            config.upsertDevice(device);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void upsertComms(String deviceUuid, CommConfigData commConfig) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            config.upsertComms(deviceUuid, commConfig);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public boolean removeDevice(String uuid) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            return config.removeDevice(uuid);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public SaveResult save() {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            return saveInternal();
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    private SaveResult saveInternal() {
        if (loadError != null) {
            String reason = "la carga de " + CONFIG_FILE + " fallo, asi que el modelo en "
                    + "memoria no es de fiar";
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se guarda nada: " + reason, loadError);
            return SaveResult.notSaved(reason);
        }
        CommConfigStorage configStorage = storage.config();
        if (configStorage == null) {
            try {
                configStorage = storage.createConfig();
            } catch (IOException ex) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo crear el almacen de la configuracion", ex);
                return SaveResult.notSaved(
                        "no se pudo preparar el fichero de configuracion: " + ex.getMessage());
            }
        }
        final CommConfigRepository repo = CommConfigRepositoryLookup.createRepository(configStorage);
        try {
            storage.pauseNotifications();
            try {
                repo.save(config);
            } finally {
                storage.resumeNotifications();
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "No se pudo escribir " + CONFIG_FILE, ex);
            return SaveResult.notSaved(
                    "no se pudo escribir " + CONFIG_FILE + ": " + ex.getMessage());
        }
        repository = repo;
        boolean databaseUpdated;
        String rebuildReason = null;
        try {
            RebuildResultado resultado =
                    BootDbRepository.rebuildWithReason(storage.bootDbFolder(), config);
            databaseUpdated = resultado.success();
            rebuildReason = resultado.reason();
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "Error volcando la configuracion a boot.db", ex);
            databaseUpdated = false;
        }
        notifyChange();
        if (databaseUpdated) {
            return SaveResult.success();
        }
        LOGGER.warning("boot.db no pudo actualizarse; revise el registro de la aplicacion.");
        String reason = rebuildReason;
        return SaveResult.partial("se escribio " + CONFIG_FILE + " pero no se pudo actualizar boot.db"
                + (reason == null || reason.isBlank() ? "" : ": " + reason));
    }

    private void notifyChange() {
        if (SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()) {
            cs.fireChange();
            return;
        }
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(cs::fireChange);
    }

    public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        cs.addChangeListener(cl);
    }

    public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        cs.removeChangeListener(cl);
    }
}
