package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileChangeAdapter;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileUtil;

final class NetBeansProjectStorage implements ProjectStorage {

    private final Project project;
    private FileObject watched;
    private FileChangeAdapter listener;
    private Runnable onChanged;
    private Runnable onDeleted;

    NetBeansProjectStorage(Project project) {
        this.project = project;
    }

    @Override
    public String directoryName() {
        return project.getProjectDirectory().getName();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean has(String fileName) {
        return project.getProjectDirectory().getFileObject(fileName) != null;
    }

    @Override
    public CommConfigStorage config() {
        FileObject file = project.getProjectDirectory().getFileObject(HMICommunicationModel.CONFIG_FILE);
        return file == null ? null : new ProjectFileStorage(file);
    }

    @Override
    public CommConfigStorage createConfig() throws IOException {
        return new ProjectFileStorage(
                project.getProjectDirectory().createData(HMICommunicationModel.CONFIG_FILE));
    }

    @Override
    public File bootDbFolder() {
        return FileUtil.toFile(project.getProjectDirectory());
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnChanged(Runnable onChanged) {
        this.onChanged = onChanged;
    }

    @Override
    public void setOnDeleted(Runnable onDeleted) {
        this.onDeleted = onDeleted;
    }

    @Override
    public void watchForChanges() {
        FileObject current = project.getProjectDirectory()
                .getFileObject(HMICommunicationModel.CONFIG_FILE);
        detach();
        if (current == null || onChanged == null) {
            return;
        }
        listener = new FileChangeAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void fileChanged(FileEvent event) {
                if (onChanged != null) {
                    onChanged.run();
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void fileDeleted(FileEvent event) {
                if (onDeleted != null) {
                    onDeleted.run();
                }
            }
        };
        current.addFileChangeListener(listener);
        watched = current;
    }

    @Override
    public void pauseNotifications() {
        if (watched != null && listener != null) {
            watched.removeFileChangeListener(listener);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void resumeNotifications() {
        if (watched != null && listener != null && watched.isValid()) {
            watched.addFileChangeListener(listener);
        }
    }

    private void detach() {
        if (watched != null && listener != null) {
            watched.removeFileChangeListener(listener);
        }
        watched = null;
        listener = null;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommConfigStorage;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileLock;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;

public record ProjectFileStorage(FileObject fileObject) implements CommConfigStorage {

    @Override
    public String open() throws IOException {
        if (!fileObject.isValid()) {
            return "";
        }
        try (InputStream in = fileObject.getInputStream()) {
            return new String(in.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public OutputStream create() throws IOException {
        return fileObject.getOutputStream();
    }

    @Override
    public void write(byte[] content) throws IOException {
        try (FileLock lock = fileObject.lock();
                OutputStream out = fileObject.getOutputStream(lock)) {
            out.write(content);
        }
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Function;
import javax.swing.Action;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMICategoryDefinition;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactory;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactorySupport;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileAttributeEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileChangeListener;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileRenameEvent;
import org.openide.loaders.DataNode;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObject;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObjectNotFoundException;
import org.openide.nodes.Children;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;

public abstract class CategoryFilesNodeFactory implements NodeFactory {

    protected abstract HMICategoryDefinition category();
    protected Action[] ownActions(FileObject file) {
        return new Action[0];
    }

    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        FileObject projectDir = project.getProjectDirectory();

        HMICategoryDefinition definition = category();
        if (!definition.matchesFolder(projectDir.getName())) {
            return NodeFactorySupport.fixedNodeList();
        }

        return new CategoryFilesNodeList(projectDir, definition, this::ownActions);
    }

    private static final class CategoryFilesNodeList
            implements NodeList<FileObject>, FileChangeListener {

        private final FileObject folder;
        private final HMICategoryDefinition definition;
        private final Function<FileObject, Action[]> ownActions;
        private final List<ChangeListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<FileObject> keys = new ArrayList<>();

        CategoryFilesNodeList(FileObject folder, HMICategoryDefinition definition,
                Function<FileObject, Action[]> ownActions) {
            this.folder = folder;
            this.definition = definition;
            this.ownActions = ownActions;
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized List<FileObject> keys() {
                return List.copyOf(keys);
        }

        @Override
        public Node node(FileObject key) {
            try {
                DataObject dataObj = DataObject.find(key);
                return new CategoryFileNode(dataObj, key, definition, ownActions);
            } catch (DataObjectNotFoundException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.add(cl);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.remove(cl);
        }

        private void fireChange() {
            ChangeEvent event = new ChangeEvent(this);
            for (ChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
                listener.stateChanged(event);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addNotify() {
            folder.addFileChangeListener(this);
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void removeNotify() {
            folder.removeFileChangeListener(this);
        }

        private synchronized void refreshKeys() {
            keys.clear();
            for (FileObject child : folder.getChildren()) {
                if (definition.acepta(child.getNameExt(), child.getExt(), child.isFolder())) {
                    keys.add(child);
                }
            }
            fireChange();
        }

        private boolean isOfThisCategory(FileEvent evento) {
            String extension = definition.getFileExtension();
            return extension != null && extension.equalsIgnoreCase(evento.getFile().getExt());
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDataCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            if (isOfThisCategory(fe)) {
                refreshKeys();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDeleted(FileEvent fe) {
            if (isOfThisCategory(fe)) {
                refreshKeys();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void fileRenamed(FileRenameEvent fre) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileFolderCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileChanged(FileEvent fe) {
            // TODO
        }

        @Override
        public void fileAttributeChanged(FileAttributeEvent fae) {
            // TODO
        }
    }

    private static final class CategoryFileNode extends DataNode {

        private final FileObject fileObject;
        private final Function<FileObject, Action[]> ownActions;

        CategoryFileNode(DataObject dataObject, FileObject fileObject,
                HMICategoryDefinition definition, Function<FileObject, Action[]> ownActions) {
            super(dataObject, Children.LEAF);
            this.fileObject = fileObject;
            this.ownActions = ownActions;

            String iconBase = definition.getIconPath();
            if (iconBase != null && !iconBase.isEmpty()) {
                setIconBaseWithExtension(iconBase);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public Action[] getActions(boolean context) {
            Action[] defaultActions = super.getActions(context);

            List<Action> allActions = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Action action : ownActions.apply(fileObject)) {
                allActions.add(action);
            }
            allActions.add(null);
            for (Action action : defaultActions) {
                allActions.add(action);
            }
            return allActions.toArray(new Action[0]);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans.HMICommunicationModel;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;

class CommunicationNodeList implements NodeList<String>, ChangeListener {

    private final Project project;
    private final HMICommunicationModel model;
    private final List<ChangeListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String, DeviceNode> nodesUuid = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    CommunicationNodeList(Project project, HMICommunicationModel model) {
        this.project = project;
        this.model = model;
        refreshKeys();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<String> keys() {
            return List.copyOf(keys);
    }

    @Override
    public Node node(String uuid) {
        if (model == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (device(uuid) == null) {
            return null;
        }
        DeviceNode existente = nodesUuid.get(uuid);
        if (existente != null) {
            return existente;
        }
        DeviceNode creado = new DeviceNode(uuid, project, this);
        nodesUuid.put(uuid, creado);
        return creado;
    }

    /** Dispositivo vigente con ese UUID, o null si no hay modelo o no existe. */
    DeviceConfigData device(String uuid) {
        return model == null || uuid == null ? null : model.findByUuid(uuid);
    }

    @Override
    public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        listeners.add(cl);
    }

    @Override
    public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
        listeners.remove(cl);
    }

    private void fireChange() {
        ChangeEvent event = new ChangeEvent(this);
        for (ChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
            listener.stateChanged(event);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void addNotify() {
        if (model != null) {
            model.addChangeListener(this);
        }
        refreshKeys();
    }

    @Override
    public void removeNotify() {
        if (model != null) {
            model.removeChangeListener(this);
        }
    }

    private synchronized void refreshKeys() {
        keys.clear();
        if (model != null) {
            for (DeviceConfigData device : model.getDevices()) {
                keys.add(device.getUuid());
            }
        }
        fireChange();
    }

    @Override
    public void stateChanged(ChangeEvent e) {
        refreshKeys();
        refreshNodes();
    }

    private void refreshNodes() {
        nodesUuid.values().removeIf(node -> node.device() == null);
        for (DeviceNode node : new ArrayList<>(nodesUuid.values())) {
            node.refresh();
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.awt.Frame;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.SaveResult;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans.HMICommunicationModel;
import org.openide.util.RequestProcessor;
import org.openide.windows.WindowManager;

final class DeleteDeviceDialog {

    private DeleteDeviceDialog() {
    }

    static void delete(String uuid, String name, HMICommunicationModel model, Frame ventana) {
        if (model == null) {
            return;
        }

        Object[] opciones = {"Aceptar", "Cancelar"};
        int elegida = JOptionPane.showOptionDialog(ventana,
                DeviceNodeLabels.deletionMessage(name, model.getComms(uuid)),
                "Eliminar dispositivo", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE,
                JOptionPane.DEFAULT_OPTION, null, opciones, opciones[0]);
        if (elegida != 0) {
            return;
        }

        if (!model.removeDevice(uuid)) {
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                    DeviceNodeLabels.nothingToDeleteMessage(name),
                    "Nada que eliminar", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }

        RequestProcessor.getDefault().post(() -> {
            SaveResult resultado = model.save();
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> show(ventana, name, resultado));
        });
    }

    private static void show(Frame ventana, String name, SaveResult resultado) {
        if (!resultado.xmlSaved()) {
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                    "No se pudo eliminar '" + name + "'.\n\n" + resultado.message(),
                    "Error al eliminar", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }

        if (resultado.isPartial()) {
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                    DeviceNodeLabels.partialSaveMessage(name),
                    "Guardado parcial", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }

        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                DeviceNodeLabels.correctDeletionMessage(name),
                "EliminaciÃ³n exitosa", JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE);
    }


    static Frame mainWindow() {
        return WindowManager.getDefault().getMainWindow();
    }
}

import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.openide.actions.PropertiesAction;
import org.openide.nodes.AbstractNode;
import org.openide.nodes.Children;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.nodes.Node.Property;
import org.openide.nodes.PropertySupport;
import org.openide.nodes.Sheet;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;
import org.openide.util.actions.SystemAction;

class DeviceNode extends AbstractNode {

    private static final List<String> PROPERTIES = List.of(
            "deviceName", "brand", "model", "protocol", "specificParameters",
            "s88Node", "s88Uuid", "deviceKey", "description", "uuid", "enable");

    private final String uuid;
    private final Project project;
    private final CommunicationNodeList list;
    private String displayNameBefore;

    DeviceNode(String uuid, Project project, CommunicationNodeList list) {
        super(Children.LEAF);
        this.uuid = uuid;
        this.project = project;
        this.list = list;
        DeviceConfigData inicial = list.device(uuid);
        if (inicial != null) {
            setLabelsFrom(inicial);
        }
        setIconBaseWithExtension(HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.getIconPath());
    }

    DeviceConfigData device() {
        return list.device(uuid);
    }

    private void setLabelsFrom(DeviceConfigData d) {
        String name = DeviceNodeLabels.nameOf(d);
        displayNameBefore = name;
        setName(name);
        setDisplayName(name);
        setShortDescription(DeviceNodeLabels.tooltipOf(d));
    }

    void refresh() {
        DeviceConfigData d = device();
        if (d == null) {
            return;
        }
        String name = DeviceNodeLabels.nameOf(d);
        if (!Objects.equals(name, displayNameBefore)) {
            setName(name);
            firePropertyChange(Node.PROP_DISPLAY_NAME, displayNameBefore, name);
            displayNameBefore = name;
        }
        setShortDescription(DeviceNodeLabels.tooltipOf(d));
        for (String property : PROPERTIES) {
            firePropertyChange(property, null, null);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public Action[] getActions(boolean context) {
        List<Action> allActions = new ArrayList<>();
        allActions.add(new AbstractAction("Modificar Dispositivo") {
            @Override
            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> openEditForm());
            }
        });
        allActions.add(null);
        allActions.add(new AbstractAction("Propiedades") {
            @Override
            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
                SystemAction.get(PropertiesAction.class).performAction();
            }
        });
        allActions.add(null);
        allActions.add(new AbstractAction("Eliminar Dispositivo") {
            @Override
            public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) {
                deleteDevice();
            }
        });
        return allActions.toArray(new Action[0]);
    }

    private void openEditForm() {
        Frame ventana = DeleteDeviceDialog.mainWindow();
        try {
            DeviceConfigData actual = device();
            if (actual == null) {
                JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                        DeviceNodeLabels.unknownDeviceMessage(currentName()),
                        "No se puede modificar", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
                return;
            }
            CreateDeviceDialog.forEdit(ventana, project, actual).setVisible(true);
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(ventana,
                    "No se pudo abrir la modificaciÃ³n del dispositivo:\n\n" + ex.getMessage(),
                    "Error al modificar", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
        }
    }

    private void deleteDevice() {
        HMICommunicationModel model = project.getLookup().lookup(HMICommunicationModel.class);
        if (model == null) {
            return;
        }
        DeleteDeviceDialog.delete(uuid, currentName(), model,
                DeleteDeviceDialog.mainWindow());
    }

    private String currentName() {
        return DeviceNodeLabels.nameOf(device());
    }

    @Override
    protected Sheet createSheet() {
        Sheet sheet = super.createSheet();
        Sheet.Set props = sheet.get(Sheet.PROPERTIES);
        if (props == null) {
            props = Sheet.createPropertiesSet();
            sheet.put(props);
        }

        props.put(text("deviceName", "Nombre", "Nombre del dispositivo", DeviceConfigData::getDeviceName));
        props.put(text("brand", "Marca", "Marca del dispositivo", DeviceConfigData::getBrand));
        props.put(text("model", "Modelo", "Modelo del dispositivo", DeviceConfigData::getModel));
        props.put(text("protocol", "Protocolo", "Protocolo de comunicaciÃ³n", DeviceConfigData::getProtocol));
        props.put(text("specificParameters", "URL",
                "URL / parÃ¡metros especÃ­ficos de conexiÃ³n", DeviceConfigData::getSpecificParameters));
        props.put(text("s88Node", "S88 Node", "Nodo S88 (Ã¡rea) asociado al dispositivo",
                DeviceConfigData::getS88Node));
        props.put(text("s88Uuid", "S88 UUID", "UUID del Ã¡rea S88 asociada", DeviceConfigData::getS88Uuid));
        props.put(text("deviceKey", "Device Key", "Clave del dispositivo", DeviceConfigData::getDeviceKey));
        props.put(text("description", "DescripciÃ³n", "DescripciÃ³n del dispositivo",
                DeviceConfigData::getDescription));
        props.put(text("uuid", "UUID", "Identificador Ãºnico del dispositivo", DeviceConfigData::getUuid));
        props.put(booleano("enable", "Habilitado", "Indica si el dispositivo estÃ¡ habilitado",
                DeviceConfigData::isEnabled));
        return sheet;
    }

    private Property text(String name, String label, String description,
            Function<DeviceConfigData, String> getter) {
        return new PropertySupport.ReadOnly(name, String.class, label, description) {
            @Override
            public Object getValue() {
                return DeviceNodeLabels.textOf(device(), getter);
            }
        };
    }

    private Property booleano(String name, String label, String description,
            Function<DeviceConfigData, Boolean> getter) {
        return new PropertySupport.ReadOnly(name, Boolean.class, label, description) {
            @Override
            public Object getValue() {
                return DeviceNodeLabels.booleanOf(device(), getter);
            }
        };
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.util.function.Function;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;

final class DeviceNodeLabels {

    static final String SIN_NOMBRE = "(sin nombre)";

    private DeviceNodeLabels() {
    }

    static String nameOf(DeviceConfigData device) {
        if (device == null) {
            return SIN_NOMBRE;
        }
        String name = device.getDeviceName();
        return name == null || name.isBlank() ? SIN_NOMBRE : name;
    }

    static String tooltipOf(DeviceConfigData device) {
        return device.getBrand() + " / " + device.getModel()
                + " / " + device.getProtocol();
    }

    static String textOf(DeviceConfigData device, Function<DeviceConfigData, String> getter) {
        String valor = device == null ? null : getter.apply(device);
        return valor == null ? "" : valor;
    }

    static boolean booleanOf(DeviceConfigData device,
            Function<DeviceConfigData, Boolean> getter) {
        return device != null && Boolean.TRUE.equals(getter.apply(device));
    }

    /**
     * @param nombre    nombre del dispositivo, ya resuelto por {@link #nombreDe}
     * @param comunicacion su comunicacion, o null si no tiene
     */
    static String deletionMessage(String name, CommConfigData communication) {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("Va a eliminar el dispositivo '")
                .append(name).append("'.")
                .append("\n\nAl borrarlo se pierden todas sus configuraciones.");
        if (communication != null) {
            int grupos = communication.getGroups().size();
            int areas = communication.getItems().size();
            int variables = communication.getPvs().size();
            if (grupos > 0 || areas > 0 || variables > 0) {
                text.append("\n\n  \u2022 ").append(grupos)
                        .append(grupos == 1 ? " grupo" : " grupos")
                        .append("\n  \u2022 ").append(areas)
                        .append(areas == 1 ? " \u00e1rea" : " \u00e1reas")
                        .append("\n  \u2022 ").append(variables)
                        .append(variables == 1 ? " variable" : " variables");
            }
        }
        return text.append("\n\nTambi\u00e9n se quitar\u00e1 de comunicacion.xml y de boot.db.")
                .append("\n\n\u00bfDesea continuar?").toString();
    }

    static String unknownDeviceMessage(String name) {
        return "El dispositivo '" + name + "' ya no est\u00e1 en la configuraci\u00f3n.\n"
                + "Puede que se haya borrado desde otra vista.";
    }
    
    static String partialSaveMessage(String name) {
        return "El dispositivo '" + name + "' se quit\u00f3 de comunicacion.xml pero no se pudo\n"
                + "actualizar boot.db. Revis\u00e1 la consola.";
    }

    static String correctDeletionMessage(String name) {
        return "Se elimin\u00f3 el dispositivo '" + name + "' correctamente.";
    }

    static String nothingToDeleteMessage(String name) {
        return "No se encontr\u00f3 el dispositivo '" + name + "'.";
    }
}

@NodeFactory.Registration(projectType = ProjectIds.CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE, position = 70)
public class HMICategoryCommunicationNodeFactory implements NodeFactory {

    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        FileObject projectDir = project.getProjectDirectory();

        if (!HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.matchesFolder(projectDir.getName())) {
            return NodeFactorySupport.fixedNodeList();
        }

        HMICommunicationModel model = project.getLookup().lookup(HMICommunicationModel.class);
        return new CommunicationNodeList(project, model);
    }

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;


import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.Action;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action.HMICategoryDuplicateDisplayAction;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action.HMICategoryOpenPhoebusAction;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.CategoryIcons;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactory;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileAttributeEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileChangeListener;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileRenameEvent;
import org.openide.loaders.DataNode;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObject;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObjectNotFoundException;
import org.openide.nodes.Children;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;

@NodeFactory.Registration(projectType = ProjectIds.CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE, position = 60)
public class HMICategoryDisplayNodeFactory implements NodeFactory {

    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        FileObject projectDir = project.getProjectDirectory();

        return new HMICategoryDisplayNodeList(projectDir);
    }

    private static class HMICategoryDisplayNodeList implements NodeList<FileObject>, FileChangeListener {

        private final FileObject folder;
        private final List<ChangeListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<FileObject> keys = new ArrayList<>();
        private final static String HIDE_FILE_BOB = "template.bob";

        public HMICategoryDisplayNodeList(FileObject folder) {
            this.folder = folder;
            refreshKeys();
        }

        // 1. Devuelve la lista de llaves (archivos .bob) actual
        @Override
        public synchronized List<FileObject> keys() {
            return List.copyOf(keys);
        }

        // 2. Transforma cada llave (FileObject) en su Node correspondiente
        @Override
        public Node node(FileObject key) {
            try {

                DataObject dataObj = DataObject.find(key);
                return new HMIBobNode(dataObj, key);

            } catch (DataObjectNotFoundException ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
                return null;
            }

        }

        // 3. Registro de Listeners requerido por la interfaz NodeList
        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.add(cl);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.remove(cl);
        }

        // Notifica a la interfaz de NetBeans que los datos cambiaron
        private void fireChange() {
            ChangeEvent event = new ChangeEvent(this);
            for (ChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
                listener.stateChanged(event);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addNotify() {
            folder.addFileChangeListener(this);
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void removeNotify() {
            folder.removeFileChangeListener(this);
        }

        private synchronized void refreshKeys() {
            keys.clear();
            for (FileObject child : folder.getChildren()) {
                if (!child.isFolder() && "bob".equalsIgnoreCase(child.getExt())) {

                    if (!HIDE_FILE_BOB.equalsIgnoreCase(child.getNameExt())) {
                        keys.add(child);
                    }

                }
            }
            // Disparar evento para re-renderizar el Ã¡rbol
            fireChange();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDataCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            if ("bob".equalsIgnoreCase(fe.getFile().getExt())) {
                refreshKeys();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDeleted(FileEvent fe) {
            if ("bob".equalsIgnoreCase(fe.getFile().getExt())) {
                refreshKeys();
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void fileRenamed(FileRenameEvent fre) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileFolderCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileChanged(FileEvent fe) {
            //TODO
        }

        @Override
        public void fileAttributeChanged(FileAttributeEvent fae) {
            //TODO
        }

    }

    private static class HMIBobNode extends DataNode {

        private final FileObject fileObject;

        public HMIBobNode(DataObject dataObject, FileObject fileObject) {
            super(dataObject, Children.LEAF);
            this.fileObject = fileObject;

            String iconBase = CategoryIcons.DEFAULT;
            if (iconBase != null && !iconBase.isEmpty()) {
                setIconBaseWithExtension(iconBase);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public Action[] getActions(boolean context) {
            Action[] defaultActions = super.getActions(context);

            List<Action> allActions = new ArrayList<>();    
            allActions.add(new HMICategoryOpenPhoebusAction(fileObject));
            allActions.add(null);
            allActions.add(new HMICategoryDuplicateDisplayAction(fileObject));
            allActions.add(null);
            for (Action action : defaultActions) {
                allActions.add(action);
            }
            return allActions.toArray(new Action[0]);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.Action;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.CategoryIcons;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.api.project.ProjectManager;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.LogicalViewProvider;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactory;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileAttributeEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileChangeListener;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileRenameEvent;
import org.openide.loaders.DataNode;
import org.openide.loaders.DataObject;
import org.openide.nodes.Children;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;

@NodeFactory.Registration(projectType = ProjectIds.CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE, position = 200)
public class HMICategoryNestedSubprojectNodeFactory implements NodeFactory {

    

    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        return new NestedCategoryNodeList(project.getProjectDirectory());
    }

    private static class NestedCategoryNodeList implements NodeList<FileObject>, FileChangeListener {

        private final FileObject folder;
        private final List<ChangeListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<FileObject> keys = new ArrayList<>();

        public NestedCategoryNodeList(FileObject folder) {
            this.folder = folder;
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized List<FileObject> keys() {
                return List.copyOf(keys);
        }

        @Override
        public Node node(FileObject key) {
            try {
                if (key == null || !key.isFolder()) {
                    return null;
                }
                Project subProject = ProjectManager.getDefault().findProject(key);
                if (subProject == null) {
                    return null;
                }
                LogicalViewProvider lvp = subProject.getLookup()
                        .lookup(LogicalViewProvider.class);
                return (lvp != null) ? lvp.createLogicalView() : null;
            } catch (Exception ex) {
                Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
                return null;
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.add(cl);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.remove(cl);
        }

        private void fireChange() {
            ChangeEvent event = new ChangeEvent(this);
            for (ChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
                listener.stateChanged(event);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addNotify() {
            folder.addRecursiveListener(this);
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void removeNotify() {
            folder.removeRecursiveListener(this);
        }

        private synchronized void refreshKeys() {
            keys.clear();
            for (FileObject child : folder.getChildren()) {
                if (child.isFolder() && child.getFileObject(ProjectIds.CATEGORY_MARKER_FILE) != null) {
                    keys.add(child);
                }
            }
            fireChange();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileFolderCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDataCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDeleted(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileRenamed(FileRenameEvent fre) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileChanged(FileEvent fe) {
            //TODO
        }

        @Override
        public void fileAttributeChanged(FileAttributeEvent fae) {
            //TODO
        }

        private static class HMINestedNode extends DataNode {

            private final FileObject fileObject;

            public HMINestedNode(DataObject dataObject, FileObject fileObject) {
                super(dataObject, Children.LEAF);
                this.fileObject = fileObject;

                String iconBase = CategoryIcons.DEFAULT;
                if (iconBase != null && !iconBase.isEmpty()) {
                    setIconBaseWithExtension(iconBase);
                }
            }

            @Override
            public Action[] getActions(boolean context) {
                Action[] defaultActions = super.getActions(context);
                List<Action> allActions = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Action action : defaultActions) {
                    allActions.add(action);
                }
                return allActions.toArray(new Action[0]);
            }
        }
    }
}

/*

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.nodes;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeEvent;
import javax.swing.event.ChangeListener;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.HMIPanelCategorySubprojectImpl;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.ProjectIds;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.netbeans.api.project.ProjectManager;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.LogicalViewProvider;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactory;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeFactorySupport;
import org.netbeans.spi.project.ui.support.NodeList;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileAttributeEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileChangeListener;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileEvent;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileObject;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileRenameEvent;
import org.openide.nodes.Node;
import org.openide.util.Exceptions;

@NodeFactory.Registration(projectType = ProjectIds.PANEL_PROJECT_TYPE, position = 50)
public class HMIPanelCategorySubprojectNodeFactory implements NodeFactory {

    

    @Override
    public NodeList<?> createNodes(Project project) {
        return new CategoryNodeList(project.getProjectDirectory());
    }

    private static class CategoryNodeList implements NodeList<Project>, FileChangeListener {

        private final FileObject dir;
        private final List<ChangeListener> listeners = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<Project> keys = new ArrayList<>();

        public CategoryNodeList(FileObject dir) {
            this.dir = dir;
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public synchronized List<Project> keys() {
                return List.copyOf(keys);
        }

        @Override
        public Node node(Project key) {
            LogicalViewProvider lvp = key.getLookup().lookup(LogicalViewProvider.class);
            return (lvp != null) ? lvp.createLogicalView() : null;
        }

        @Override
        public void addChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.add(cl);
        }

        @Override
        public void removeChangeListener(ChangeListener cl) {
            listeners.remove(cl);
        }

        private void fireChange() {
            ChangeEvent event = new ChangeEvent(this);
            for (ChangeListener listener : new ArrayList<>(listeners)) {
                listener.stateChanged(event);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void addNotify() {
            dir.addRecursiveListener(this);
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void removeNotify() {
            dir.removeRecursiveListener(this);
        }

        private synchronized void refreshKeys() {
            FileObject[] children = dir.getChildren();

            java.util.Arrays.sort(children, java.util.Comparator.comparing(FileObject::getName));

            keys.clear();
            for (FileObject child : children) {
                if (!child.isFolder()) {
                    continue;
                }
                try {
                    Project p = ProjectManager.getDefault().findProject(child);
                    if (p instanceof HMIPanelCategorySubprojectImpl) {
                        keys.add(p);
                    }
                } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
                    Exceptions.printStackTrace(ex);
                }
            }
            fireChange();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileFolderCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDataCreated(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileDeleted(FileEvent fe) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileRenamed(FileRenameEvent fre) {
            refreshKeys();
        }

        @Override
        public void fileChanged(FileEvent fe) {
            //TODO
        }

        @Override
        public void fileAttributeChanged(FileAttributeEvent fae) {
            //TODO
        }
    }
}

FILE: HMIPanelSubprojectCategory/src/main/java/org/apache/plc4x/malbec/projecttype/panelcategory/panel/ConnectionSection.java

/*

 * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 * KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 * specific language governing permissions and limitations

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.FlowLayout;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceModel;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.UrlDisassembler;

final class ConnectionSection {

    private final JLabel lblHost = new JLabel("Host/IP:");
    private final JLabel lblPort = new JLabel("Port:");
    private final JTextField txtHost = new JTextField();
    private final JComboBox<String> cbTransport = new JComboBox<>();
    private final JTextField txtPort = new JTextField();
    private final JComboBox<String> cbParameter = new JComboBox<>();
    private final JTextField txtParamValue = new JTextField();
    private final JTextField txtUrlPreview = new JTextField();

    private DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder activeBuilder;

    ConnectionSection() {
        txtUrlPreview.setEditable(false);
        txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
        cbTransport.setEditable(false);
        lblPort.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(0, 4, 0, 2));
    }

    void reset() {
        setBuilder(null);
        txtHost.setText("");
        lblHost.setText("Host/IP:");
        cbTransport.removeAllItems();
        txtPort.setText("");
        lblPort.setEnabled(true);
        txtPort.setEnabled(true);
        cbParameter.removeAllItems();
        txtParamValue.setText("");
        txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
        txtUrlPreview.setText("");
    }

    String hostLabel() {
        return lblHost.getText().replace(":", "");
    }

    String host() {
        return txtHost.getText().trim();
    }

    String port() {
        return txtPort.getText().trim();
    }

    void conectarListeners() {
        cbParameter.addActionListener(e -> {
            String key = (String) cbParameter.getSelectedItem();
            if (key == null) {
                txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
                txtParamValue.setText("");
                return;
            }
            txtParamValue.setEnabled(true);
            txtParamValue.setText(activeBuilder == null
                    ? "" : activeBuilder.getParameterDefaults().get(key));
        });

        txtHost.getDocument().addDocumentListener(
                new SimpleDocumentListener(this::refreshUrlPreview));

        cbTransport.addActionListener(e -> onTransportChanged());
        JComponent transportEditor = (JComponent) cbTransport.getEditor().getEditorComponent();
        if (transportEditor instanceof JTextField transportField) {
            transportField.getDocument().addDocumentListener(
                    new SimpleDocumentListener(this::refreshUrlPreview));
        }

        txtPort.getDocument().addDocumentListener(
                new SimpleDocumentListener(this::refreshUrlPreview));
    }

    private static final class SimpleDocumentListener
            implements javax.swing.event.DocumentListener {

        private final Runnable action;

        SimpleDocumentListener(Runnable action) {
            this.action = action;
        }

        @Override
        public void insertUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) {
            action.run();
        }

        @Override
        public void removeUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) {
            action.run();
        }

        @Override
        public void changedUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) {
            action.run();
        }
    }

    JLabel lblHost() {
        return lblHost;
    }

    JLabel lblPort() {
        return lblPort;
    }

    JTextField txtHost() {
        return txtHost;
    }

    JComboBox<String> cbTransport() {
        return cbTransport;
    }

    JTextField txtPort() {
        return txtPort;
    }

    JComboBox<String> cbParameter() {
        return cbParameter;
    }

    JTextField txtParamValue() {
        return txtParamValue;
    }

    JTextField txtUrlPreview() {
        return txtUrlPreview;
    }

    JPanel parameterButtons() {
        JButton btnAddParam = new JButton("Add");
        JButton btnRemoveParam = new JButton("Remove");
        JButton btnClear = new JButton("Clean");

        JPanel buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 3, 0));
        buttons.add(btnAddParam);
        buttons.add(btnRemoveParam);
        buttons.add(btnClear);

        btnAddParam.addActionListener(e -> {
            if (activeBuilder == null) {
                return;
            }
            String key = (String) cbParameter.getSelectedItem();
            if (key == null) {
                return;
            }
            activeBuilder.addParameter(key, txtParamValue.getText().trim());
            refreshUrlPreview();
        });
        btnRemoveParam.addActionListener(e -> {
            if (activeBuilder != null) {
                activeBuilder.removeLastParameter();
            }
            refreshUrlPreview();
        });
        btnClear.addActionListener(e -> {
            if (activeBuilder != null) {
                activeBuilder.clearParameters();
            }
            refreshUrlPreview();
        });
        return buttons;
    }

    void loadBuilderParams(DeviceModel modelo) {
        cbParameter.removeAllItems();
        txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
        txtParamValue.setText("");
        if (activeBuilder == null) {
            refreshUrlPreview();
            return;
        }
        activeBuilder.initForModel(modelo);

        cbTransport.removeAllItems();
        cbTransport.setEditable(false);
        for (String option : activeBuilder.getTransportOptions()) {
            cbTransport.addItem(option);
        }
        selectTransport(activeBuilder.getDefaultTransport());
        if (cbTransport.getSelectedItem() == null && cbTransport.getItemCount() > 0) {
            cbTransport.setSelectedIndex(0);
        }
        onTransportChanged();
    }

    private void selectTransport(String transporte) {
        if (transporte == null || transporte.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < cbTransport.getItemCount(); i++) {
            if (transporte.equals(cbTransport.getItemAt(i))) {
                cbTransport.setSelectedIndex(i);
                return;
            }
        }
        cbTransport.addItem(transporte);
        cbTransport.setSelectedItem(transporte);
    }

    void setBuilder(DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder activeBuilder) {
        this.activeBuilder = activeBuilder;
    }

    DeviceDynamicPanelBuilder builder() {
        return activeBuilder;
    }

    boolean transporteEditable() {
        return cbTransport.isEditable();
    }

    String transporteActual() {
        if (cbTransport.isEditable()) {
            Component editor = cbTransport.getEditor().getEditorComponent();
            if (editor instanceof JTextField campo) {
                String tipeado = campo.getText().trim();
                if (!tipeado.isEmpty()) {
                    return tipeado;
                }
            }
        }
        Object selected = cbTransport.getSelectedItem();
        return selected == null ? "" : selected.toString().trim();
    }

    void onTransportChanged() {
        if (activeBuilder == null) {
            return;
        }
        String transportValue = transporteActual();
        activeBuilder.setTransport(transportValue);

        lblHost.setText(activeBuilder.getHostLabel());
        boolean portApplicable = activeBuilder.isPortApplicable();
        lblPort.setEnabled(portApplicable);
        txtPort.setEnabled(portApplicable);
        if (!portApplicable) {
            txtPort.setText("");
        }

        refreshParameterCatalog(transportValue);
        refreshUrlPreview();
    }

    private void refreshParameterCatalog(String transport) {
        if (activeBuilder == null) {
            cbParameter.removeAllItems();
            txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
            txtParamValue.setText("");
            return;
        }
        LinkedHashMap<String, String> catalog = activeBuilder.getParameterDefaults(transport);
        activeBuilder.retainParameters(catalog.keySet());

        String selectedKey = (String) cbParameter.getSelectedItem();
        cbParameter.removeAllItems();
        for (String key : catalog.keySet()) {
            cbParameter.addItem(key);
        }
        if (selectedKey != null && catalog.containsKey(selectedKey)) {
            cbParameter.setSelectedItem(selectedKey);
        }
        Object current = cbParameter.getSelectedItem();
        if (current == null) {
            txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
            txtParamValue.setText("");
        } else {
            txtParamValue.setEnabled(true);
            txtParamValue.setText(activeBuilder.getParameters()
                    .getOrDefault(current.toString(), catalog.getOrDefault(current.toString(), "")));
        }
    }

    void refreshUrlPreview() {
        if (activeBuilder == null) {
            txtUrlPreview.setText("");
            return;
        }
        activeBuilder.setHost(txtHost.getText().trim());
        activeBuilder.setTransport(transporteActual());
        activeBuilder.setPort(txtPort.getText().trim());
        txtUrlPreview.setText(activeBuilder.getSpecificParametersAsString());
    }

    void loadConnection(String url, java.awt.Component padre) {
        if (activeBuilder == null || url == null || url.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        UrlDisassembler.Partes partes = UrlDisassembler.disassemble(url);
        if (partes == null) {
            txtUrlPreview.setText(url.trim());
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(padre,
                    "No se pudo interpretar la URL de conexiÃ³n guardada:\n\n" + url.trim()
                    + "\n\nRevisÃ¡ host, puerto y parÃ¡metros antes de guardar.",
                    "ConexiÃ³n a revisar", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }

        selectTransport(partes.transport());
        onTransportChanged();
        txtHost.setText(partes.host());
        txtPort.setText(partes.port());
        activeBuilder.clearParameters();
        partes.params().forEach(activeBuilder::addParameter);
        refreshUrlPreview();
    }

    void clearConnection() {
        txtHost.setText("");
        txtPort.setText("");
        if (activeBuilder != null) {
            activeBuilder.clearParameters();
        }
        cbTransport.removeAllItems();
        cbParameter.removeAllItems();
        txtParamValue.setEnabled(false);
        txtParamValue.setText("");
        txtUrlPreview.setText("");
    }

    String urlActual() {
        refreshUrlPreview();
        return txtUrlPreview.getText();
    }

}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Cursor;
import java.awt.Dimension;
import java.awt.FlowLayout;
import java.awt.Rectangle;
import java.awt.Window;
import java.awt.event.KeyEvent;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JButton;
import javax.swing.JComponent;
import javax.swing.JDialog;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JScrollPane;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.KeyStroke;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.CommunicationStore;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.api.SaveResult;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans.HMICommunicationModel;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.netbeans.api.project.Project;
import org.openide.filesystems.FileUtil;
import org.openide.util.RequestProcessor;

public final class CreateDeviceDialog extends JDialog {

    private final transient Path projectDir;
    private final transient CommunicationStore store;
    private final transient CreateDevicePanel panel;
    private final boolean editando;
    private final JButton btnOk = new JButton("Guardar");
    private final JButton btnCancel = new JButton("Cancelar");

    public static CreateDeviceDialog forCreate(Window owner, Project project) {
        return new CreateDeviceDialog(owner, project, null);
    }

    public static CreateDeviceDialog forEdit(Window owner, Project project, DeviceConfigData device) {
        return new CreateDeviceDialog(owner, project, device);
    }

    private static Path directoryOf(Project project) {
        return project != null ? FileUtil.toFile(project.getProjectDirectory()).toPath() : null;
    }

    private static CommunicationStore storeOf(Project project) {
        return project != null ? project.getLookup().lookup(HMICommunicationModel.class) : null;
    }

    private CreateDeviceDialog(Window owner, Project project, DeviceConfigData device) {
        super(owner, device == null
                ? "Nuevo dispositivo de comunicaciÃ³n"
                : "Modificar dispositivo", ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
        this.projectDir = directoryOf(project);
        this.store = storeOf(project);
        this.panel = new CreateDevicePanel(projectDir, store, device);
        this.editando = device != null;

        JPanel botones = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 6, 0));
        botones.add(btnCancel);
        botones.add(btnOk);
        JPanel content = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 8));
        content.add(panel, BorderLayout.CENTER); 
        content.add(botones, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(content);
        content.add(botones, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(content);

        getRootPane().registerKeyboardAction(e -> dispose(),
                KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE, 0),
                JComponent.WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW);
        getRootPane().setDefaultButton(btnOk);

        setDefaultCloseOperation(DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE);

        btnOk.addActionListener(e -> save());
        btnCancel.addActionListener(e -> dispose());

        setResizable(false);
        setSize(550, 620);
//        pack();
//        Rectangle pantalla = getGraphicsConfiguration() != null
//                ? getGraphicsConfiguration().getBounds()
//                : new Rectangle(0, 0, 400, 700);
//        Dimension pref = getPreferredSize();
//        setSize(Math.min(pref.width, pantalla.width - 80),
//                Math.min(pref.height, pantalla.height - 80));
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
    }

    private void save() {
        DeviceConfigData data = panel.getDeviceConfigData();
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (store == null) {
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
                    "No se encontrÃ³ el modelo de comunicaciÃ³n del proyecto.",
                    "Error", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }

        btnOk.setEnabled(false);
        btnCancel.setEnabled(false);
        setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.WAIT_CURSOR));

        RequestProcessor.getDefault().post(() -> {
            store.upsertDevice(data);
            SaveResult resultado = store.save();
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> show(data, resultado));
        });
    }

    private void show(DeviceConfigData data, SaveResult resultado) {
        setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
        btnOk.setEnabled(true);
        btnCancel.setEnabled(true);

        if (!resultado.xmlSaved()) {
            // Antes este mismo aviso decia "se guardÃ³ en comunicacion.xml" incluso
            // cuando no se habia escrito nada, porque el booleano no lo distinguia.
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
                    "No se pudo guardar el dispositivo:\n\n" + resultado.message(),
                    "Error al guardar", JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }
        if (resultado.isPartial()) {
            JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
                    "El dispositivo se guardÃ³ en comunicacion.xml pero no se pudo\n"
                    + "actualizar la base de datos. RevisÃ¡ la consola.",
                    "Guardado parcial", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            return;
        }
        saveWarning(data);
        dispose();
    }

    private void saveWarning(DeviceConfigData data) {
        String name = data.getDeviceName();
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            name = "(sin nombre)";
        }
        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this,
                "El dispositivo '" + name + "' fue "
                + (editando ? "modificado" : "creado") + " correctamente.",
                editando ? "ModificaciÃ³n exitosa" : "Dispositivo creado",
                JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceModel;

final class DeviceCatalog {

    private DeviceCatalog() {
    }

    private static final Map<String, List<DeviceModel>> MODELS = Map.of(
            "Siemens", List.of(
                    new DeviceModel("Siemens", "s7-300", "s7"),
                    new DeviceModel("Siemens", "s7-400", "s7"),
                    new DeviceModel("Siemens", "s7-1200", "s7"),
                    new DeviceModel("Siemens", "s7-1500", "s7")),
            "Allen Bradley", List.of(
                    new DeviceModel("Allen Bradley", "ControlLogix", "EtherNet/IP"),
                    new DeviceModel("Allen Bradley", "CompactLogix", "EtherNet/IP")),
            "Modbus", List.of(
                    new DeviceModel("Modbus", "Modbus TCP", "modbus-tcp"),
                    new DeviceModel("Modbus", "Modbus RTU", "modbus-rtu"),
                    new DeviceModel("Modbus", "Modbus ASCII", "modbus-ascii")));

    static List<String> brands() {
        return List.of("Siemens", "Allen Bradley", "Modbus");
    }

    static List<DeviceModel> from(String brand) {
        return MODELS.getOrDefault(brand, List.of());
    }

    static boolean hasBrand(String brand) {
        return MODELS.containsKey(brand);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.xml.XmlSafe;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;

final class PlantNodeLoader {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(PlantNodeLoader.class.getName());

    private PlantNodeLoader() {
    }

    static Map<String, String> areasOf(Path projectDir) {
        Path plantModel = findFile(projectDir);
        if (plantModel == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Map<String, String> areas = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try {
            DocumentBuilder builder = XmlSafe.newFactory().newDocumentBuilder();
            NodeList nodes = builder.parse(plantModel.toFile()).getDocumentElement().getChildNodes();
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++) {
                Node node = nodes.item(i);
                if (node.getNodeType() != Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                    continue;
                }
                Element element = (Element) node;
                if (!"area".equals(element.getTagName())) {
                    continue;
                }
                String id = element.getAttribute("id");
                if (id.isEmpty()) {
                    continue;
                }
                areas.put(id, element.getAttribute("uuid"));
            }
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudo leer " + plantModel, ex);
            return null;
        }
        return areas;
    }

    private static Path findFile(Path projectDir) {
        Path dir = projectDir;
        while (dir != null) {
            Path xml = dir.resolve("plant-model.xml");
            if (Files.isRegularFile(xml)) {
                return xml;
            }
            dir = dir.getParent();
        }
        return null;
    }
}

 * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 * KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 * specific language governing permissions and limitations
 * under the License.

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.xml.XMLConstants;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilder;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.xml.XmlSafe;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.Element;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.w3c.dom.NodeList;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.PlantVariable;

public class PlantModelReader {

    private static final String PLANT_MODEL_FILE = "plant-model.xml";
    private final Path projectDir;

    public PlantModelReader(Path projectDir) {
        this.projectDir = projectDir;
    }

    public List<PlantVariable> loadAreaVariables(String areaId) throws Exception {
        List<PlantVariable> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (areaId == null || areaId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return result;
        }

        Path plantModel = findPlantModelFile(projectDir);
        if (plantModel == null) {
            return result;
        }

        DocumentBuilderFactory factory = XmlSafe.newFactory();

        DocumentBuilder builder = factory.newDocumentBuilder();

        try (InputStream is = Files.newInputStream(plantModel)) {
            Document doc = builder.parse(is);
            Element root = doc.getDocumentElement();
            if (root == null) {
                return result;
            }

            Element area = findAreaRecursive(root, areaId);
            if (area != null) {
                collectPlantVariables(area, areaId, result);
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    private Element findAreaRecursive(Element element, String areaId) {
        if ("area".equals(element.getTagName()) && areaId.equals(element.getAttribute("id"))) {
            return element;
        }
        
        NodeList nodes = element.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++) {
            Node node = nodes.item(i);
            if (node.getNodeType() == Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                Element found = findAreaRecursive((Element) node, areaId);
                if (found != null) {
                    return found;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void collectPlantVariables(Element element, String currentPath, List<PlantVariable> result) {
        NodeList nodes = element.getChildNodes();
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes.getLength(); i++) {
            Node node = nodes.item(i);
            if (node.getNodeType() != Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                continue;
            }

            Element child = (Element) node;
            if ("variable".equals(child.getTagName())) {
                String name = child.getAttribute("name");
                if (!name.isEmpty()) {
                    result.add(new PlantVariable(currentPath, name, child.getAttribute("Type")));
                }
                continue;
            }

            String id = child.getAttribute("id");
            String childPath = id.isEmpty() ? currentPath : currentPath + "/" + id;
            collectPlantVariables(child, childPath, result);
        }
    }

    private Path findPlantModelFile(Path projectDir) {
        Path dir = projectDir;
        while (dir != null) {
            Path xml = dir.resolve(PLANT_MODEL_FILE);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(xml)) {
                return xml;
            }
            dir = dir.getParent();
        }
        return null;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.JTextField;

final class PvCamposObligatorios {

    private PvCamposObligatorios() {
    }

    /**
     * @param descriptor        descriptor del PV
     * @param scanTimeElegido   valor del desplegable, null si no hay ninguno
     * @param descripcionDisplay texto de la descripcion en pantalla
     * @param formatoDisplay    texto del formato
     * @param unidadesDisplay   texto de las unidades
     */
    static List<String> missingFields(String descriptorText, Object scanTimeElegido,
            String displayDescriptionText, String displayFormatText, String displayUnitsText) {
        List<String> vacios = new ArrayList<>();
        if (isBlank(descriptorText)) {
            vacios.add("Descriptor");
        }
        if (scanTimeElegido == null) {
            vacios.add("ScanTime");
        }
        if (isBlank(displayDescriptionText)) {
            vacios.add("Display descripciÃ³n");
        }
        if (isBlank(displayFormatText)) {
            vacios.add("Display formato");
        }
        if (isBlank(displayUnitsText)) {
            vacios.add("Display unidades");
        }
        return vacios;
    }

    static List<String> missingFields(JTextField descriptorText, Object scanTimeElegido,
            JTextField displayDescriptionText, JTextField displayFormatText, JTextField displayUnitsText) {
        return missingFields(descriptorText.getText(), scanTimeElegido,
                displayDescriptionText.getText(), displayFormatText.getText(), displayUnitsText.getText());
    }

    private static boolean isBlank(String text) {
        return text == null || text.trim().isEmpty();
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

final class PvLimites {

    static final int MIN = 1;
    static final int MAX = 65535;
    static final int INICIAL = MIN;
    
    private final List<String> adjustments = new ArrayList<>();

    int clampToLimit(String valor, String etiqueta) {
        String text = valor == null ? "" : valor.trim();
        double number;
        try {
            number = Double.parseDouble(text.isEmpty() ? "x" : text.replace(',', '.'));
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            adjustments.add(etiqueta + ": '" + text + "' no es un nÃºmero,"
                    + " se guardarÃ¡ " + INICIAL);
            return INICIAL;
        }
        int entero = (int) number;
        if (entero < MIN) {
            adjustments.add(etiqueta + ": '" + text + "' estÃ¡ por debajo de "
                    + MIN + ", se guardarÃ¡ " + MIN);
            return MIN;
        }
        if (entero > MAX) {
            adjustments.add(etiqueta + ": '" + text + "' estÃ¡ por encima de "
                    + MAX + ", se guardarÃ¡ " + MAX);
            return MAX;
        }
        return entero;
    }

    List<String> adjustments() {
        return List.copyOf(adjustments);
    }

    boolean hasAdjustments() {
        return !adjustments.isEmpty();
    }

    void annotate(String aviso) {
        adjustments.add(aviso);
    }

    void clear() {
        adjustments.clear();
    }
}

/*
