package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.awt.Component;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import javax.swing.JOptionPane;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommunicationWizardController;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DataType;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.PlantVariable;


final class PvPresenter {

    private static final Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(PvPresenter.class.getName());

    private final CommunicationWizardController controller;
    private final PlantModelReader plantModelReader;
    private final PvFormPanel form;
    private final PvTablePanel table;
    private final PvLimites limites = new PvLimites();
    private PvEditor editor;
    private final Component dialog;

    private String editingPvUuid;
    private Supplier<Boolean> beforeSave;
    private Consumer<String> afterSaved;

    PvPresenter(CommunicationWizardController controller, PlantModelReader plantModelReader,
            PvFormPanel form, PvTablePanel table, Component dialog) {
        this.controller = controller;
        this.plantModelReader = plantModelReader;
        this.form = form;
        this.table = table;
        this.dialog = dialog;

        form.installAreaAndVariableRenderers();
        form.installRenderer(this::selectedAreaUuid, controller::typeAllowed);
        form.setOnAreaChanged(this::refreshVariables);
        form.setOnVariableSelected(this::onVariableSelected);
        table.setOnSelectionChanged(this::onRowSelected);
        editor = new PvEditor(controller, form, dialog, this);
        form.btnAddPv().addActionListener(e -> editor.addPv());
        form.btnUpdatePv().addActionListener(e -> editor.updatePv());
        form.btnDeletePv().addActionListener(e -> editor.deletePv());
        form.btnCancelPv().addActionListener(e -> exitEdit());
    }

    private String selectedAreaUuid() {
        return form.selectedAreaUuid();
    }

    // ---- refresco ----------------------------------------------------------

    void refresh() {
        refreshAreas();
        refreshVariables();
        refreshTable();
        refreshState();
    }

    private List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> areasWithGroup() {
        List<CommConfigData.ItemConfig> areas = new ArrayList<>();
        for (CommConfigData.ItemConfig i : controller.getState().getItems()) {
            if (!controller.getState().groupNameOf(i.getUuid()).isEmpty()) {
                areas.add(i);
            }
        }
        return areas;
    }

    private void refreshAreas() {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig sel = form.selectedArea();
        form.fillAreas(areasWithGroup(), sel);
    }

    private void refreshVariables() {
        form.clearVariables();
        List<DataType> permitidos = controller.typesAllowed(selectedAreaUuid());
        form.fillTypes(controller.typesForCombo(selectedAreaUuid()),
                permitidos.size() == 1 ? permitidos.get(0) : null);
        refreshTypeLock();

        if (controller.getState().getSelectedDevice() == null) {
            return;
        }
        String areaId = controller.getState().getSelectedDevice().getS88Node();
        if (areaId == null || areaId.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        List<PlantVariable> variables;
        try {
            variables = plantModelReader.loadAreaVariables(areaId);
        } catch (Exception ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.WARNING, "No se pudieron cargar las variables de planta", ex);
            return;
        }
        DataType lockedType = controller.lockedType(selectedAreaUuid());
        Set<String> usedKeys = controller.getUsedPvKeys();
        CommConfigData.PvConfig enEdicion = controller.getState().pvByUuid(editingPvUuid);
        if (enEdicion != null) {
            usedKeys.remove(CommunicationWizardController.pvKey(
                    enEdicion.getS88Path(), enEdicion.getName()));
        }
        for (PlantVariable v : variables) {
            if (!controller.areaAcceptsType(selectedAreaUuid(), v.getType(), lockedType)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (usedKeys.contains(v.getKey())) {
                v.setUsed(true);
            }
            form.addVariable(v);
        }
    }

    private void refreshTypeLock() {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig area = form.selectedArea();
        if (area == null) {
            form.lockText(" ");
            return;
        }
        DataType elegido = form.selectedType();
        form.lockText(PvTexts.typeLock(
                area, elegido,
                controller.freeAreaSlots(area.getUuid(), elegido),
                controller.freeAreaBytes(area.getUuid()),
                controller.areaCapacityInBytes(area.getUuid())));
    }

    private void refreshTable() {
        table.refresh(controller.getState().getPvs(), uuid -> {
            CommConfigData.ItemConfig area = controller.getState().itemByUuid(uuid);
            return area == null ? "â€”" : area.getName();
        });
    }

    private void refreshState() {
        form.refreshState(form.selectedArea() != null, editingPvUuid != null);
    }

    // ---- seleccion ---------------------------------------------------------

    private void onRowSelected() {
        CommConfigData.PvConfig pv = pvFromSelectedRow();
        if (pv == null || pv.getUuid().equals(editingPvUuid)) {
            exitEdit();
            return;
        }
        editingPvUuid = pv.getUuid();
        loadIntoForm(pv);
        refreshState();
    }

    private CommConfigData.PvConfig pvFromSelectedRow() {
        List<CommConfigData.PvConfig> pvs = controller.getState().getPvs();
        int fila = table.selectedRow();
        return fila >= 0 && fila < pvs.size() ? pvs.get(fila) : null;
    }

    private void onVariableSelected() {
        PlantVariable v = form.selectedVariable();
        if (v == null) {
            form.clearType();
            refreshTypeLock();
            return;
        }
        if (v.isUsed()) {
            warn("La variable '" + v.getKey() + "' ya estÃ¡ en uso.",
                    "Variable ocupada", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            form.selectDefaultVariable();
            return;
        }
        List<DataType> permitidos = controller.typesAllowed(selectedAreaUuid());
        form.selectPlantType(v, permitidos, controller.areaTag(selectedAreaUuid()));
        refreshTypeLock();
    }

    void loadIntoForm(CommConfigData.PvConfig pv) {
        CommConfigData.ItemConfig area = controller.getState().itemByUuid(pv.getAreaUuid());
        form.setAreas(areasWithGroup(), area == null ? null : area.getUuid());
        limites.clear();
        form.withoutCountingAsSelection(() -> {
            form.load(pv);
            form.selectVariableByKey(
                    CommunicationWizardController.pvKey(pv.getS88Path(), pv.getName()));
            form.selectType(DataType.find(pv.getType()));
        });
        String avisoScanTime = form.setScanTime(pv.getScanTime());
        if (avisoScanTime != null) {
            limites.annotate(avisoScanTime);
        }
        form.spDisplayLimitLow().setValue(
                limites.clampToLimit(pv.getDisplayLimitLow(), "Display lÃ­mite bajo"));
        form.spDisplayLimitHigh().setValue(
                limites.clampToLimit(pv.getDisplayLimitHigh(), "Display lÃ­mite alto"));
        form.txtDisplayDescription().setText(pv.getDisplayDescription());
        form.txtDisplayFormat().setText(pv.getDisplayFormat());
        form.txtDisplayUnits().setText(pv.getDisplayUnits());
        form.spControlLimitLow().setValue(
                limites.clampToLimit(pv.getControlLimitLow(), "Control lÃ­mite bajo"));
        form.spControlLimitHigh().setValue(
                limites.clampToLimit(pv.getControlLimitHigh(), "Control lÃ­mite alto"));
        form.spControlMinStep().setValue(
                limites.clampToLimit(pv.getControlMinStep(), "Control MinStep"));
        refreshVariables();
        refreshTypeLock();
    }

    void exitEdit() {
        editingPvUuid = null;
        table.clearSelection();
        limites.clear();
        form.clear();
        refreshState();
    }

    void refreshAndSave(String what) {
        refreshVariables();
        refreshTable();
        refreshState();
        if (afterSaved != null) {
            afterSaved.accept(what);
        }
    }

    // ---- avisos y validacion ----------------------------------------------

    boolean validateRequiredFields() {
        List<String> vacios = PvCamposObligatorios.missingFields(
                form.txtDescriptor(), form.comboScanTime().getSelectedItem(),
                form.txtDisplayDescription(), form.txtDisplayFormat(), form.txtDisplayUnits());
        if (vacios.isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }
        warn(PvTexts.incompleteFields(vacios),
                "Campos incompletos", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
        return false;
    }

    void warnAdjustments() {
        if (!limites.hasAdjustments()) {
            return;
        }
        warn(PvTexts.adjustmentsOnLoad(limites.adjustments()),
                "Valores corregidos", JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
    }

    boolean validateBeforeSave() {
        return beforeSave == null || Boolean.TRUE.equals(beforeSave.get());
    }

    void warn(String text, String title, int type) {
        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(dialog, text, title, type);
    }

    void setSaveHooks(Supplier<Boolean> beforeSave, Consumer<String> afterSaved) {
        this.beforeSave = beforeSave;
        this.afterSaved = afterSaved;
    }

    String editingPvUuid() {
        return editingPvUuid;
    }

    List<String> adjustmentsOnLoad() {
        return limites.adjustments();
    }

    String reasonForUnknownOffset(CommConfigData.ItemConfig area) {
        return PvTexts.reasonForUnknownOffset(area);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.awt.Component;
import javax.swing.DefaultListCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JList;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DataType;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.PlantVariable;

final class PvRenderers {

    private PvRenderers() {
    }

    /** Como se ve un tipo de dato, segun lo que ocupa en el area. */
    static String weightOf(DataType type) {
        return type.bitAddressed() ? "1 bit" : type.byteSize() + " bytes";
    }

    static DefaultListCellRenderer typeRenderer(
            java.util.function.Supplier<String> areaUuid,
            java.util.function.BiPredicate<String, DataType> admite) {
        return new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override
            public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value,
                    int index, boolean isSelected, boolean cellHasFocus) {
                JLabel label = (JLabel) super.getListCellRendererComponent(
                        list, value, index, isSelected, cellHasFocus);
                if (value instanceof DataType t) {
                    boolean elegible = admite.test(areaUuid.get(), t);
                    label.setEnabled(elegible);
                    label.setText(t.label() + "  ("
                            + (elegible ? weightOf(t) : "no disponible") + ")");
                } else {
                    label.setText("â€”");
                }
                return label;
            }
        };
    }

    static DefaultListCellRenderer areaRenderer() {
        return new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override
            public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value,
                    int index, boolean isSelected, boolean cellHasFocus) {
                JLabel label = (JLabel) super.getListCellRendererComponent(
                        list, value, index, isSelected, cellHasFocus);
                label.setText(value instanceof CommConfigData.ItemConfig i
                        ? i.getName() + "  (" + i.getTag() + ")"
                        : " ");
                return label;
            }
        };
    }

    static DefaultListCellRenderer variableRenderer() {
        return new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override
            public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value,
                    int index, boolean isSelected, boolean cellHasFocus) {
                JLabel label = (JLabel) super.getListCellRendererComponent(
                        list, value, index, isSelected, cellHasFocus);
                if (value instanceof PlantVariable v) {
                    String text = v.getPath() == null || v.getPath().isEmpty()
                            ? v.getName() + "  (" + v.getType() + ")"
                            : v.getPath() + "/" + v.getName();
                    if (v.isUsed()) {
                        label.setEnabled(false);
                        label.setToolTipText("Variable ya asignada a otra configuraciÃ³n");
                        text += "  â€” en uso";
                    }
                    label.setText(text);
                } else {
                    label.setText("-- Seleccione --");
                }
                return label;
            }
        };
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.awt.Dimension;

final class PvScanTime {

    static final int MIN = 100;
    static final int MAX = 1000;
    static final int PASO = 100;

    private PvScanTime() {
    }

    static Dimension options() {
        return new Dimension((MAX - MIN) / PASO + 1, 1);
    }

    static boolean isInOptions(String scanTime) {
        if (scanTime == null) {
            return false;
        }
        String text = scanTime.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            int valor = Integer.parseInt(text);
            return valor >= MIN && valor <= MAX && (valor - MIN) % PASO == 0;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    static String warningOutsideOptions(String scanTime) {
        return "ScanTime: '" + (scanTime == null ? "" : scanTime.trim()) + "' no es una de las"
                + " ofertas (" + MIN + " a " + MAX
                + " de " + PASO + " en " + PASO + "),"
                + " asÃ­ que hay que elegir uno";
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.MemoryTag;

final class PvTexts {

    private PvTexts() {
    }

    static String reasonForUnknownOffset(CommConfigData.ItemConfig area) {
        MemoryTag tag = MemoryTag.parse(area.getTag());
        if (tag == null || !tag.hasAddress()) {
            return "El tag del Ã¡rea '" + area.getName() + "' es '" + area.getTag()
                    + "', y eso no es una direcciÃ³n vÃ¡lida.\n\n"
                    + "Sin direcciÃ³n no se sabe quÃ© bytes ocupa el Ã¡rea, asÃ­ que no se"
                    + " puede calcular dÃ³nde va cada variable.\n\n"
                    + "Corrija el tag en el paso anterior, del tipo"
                    + " %DB22.DBB4[0..9]:REAL.";
        }
        return "No se sabe el tamaÃ±o del Ã¡rea '" + area.getName() + "': su tag es '"
                + area.getTag() + "' y no dice cuÃ¡ntos bytes ocupa.\n\n"
                + "AÃ±ada un rango, del tipo %DB21.DBB0[0..9], o un tipo tras los dos"
                + " puntos, del tipo :INT.";
    }

    static String doesNotFitInArea(CommConfigData.ItemConfig area, DataType type,
            int bytesArea, int bytesLibres) {
        return "No cabe una variable mÃ¡s de tipo '" + type.label() + "' en el Ã¡rea '"
                + area.getName() + "'.\n\n"
                + "El Ã¡rea abarca " + bytesArea
                + " bytes y cada " + type.label() + " ocupa "
                + PvRenderers.weightOf(type) + ".\n"
                + (bytesLibres > 0
                        ? "Quedan " + bytesLibres + " bytes sueltos, pero no llegan"
                        + " para uno entero, asÃ­ que se considera llena.\n"
                        : "")
                + "AmplÃ­e el rango del tag del Ã¡rea si necesita mÃ¡s sitio.";
    }

    static String areaIsFull(CommConfigData.ItemConfig area, DataType type, int bytesArea) {
        return "El Ã¡rea '" + area.getName() + "' ya estÃ¡ llena.\n\n"
                + "Abarca " + bytesArea
                + " bytes y admite " + type.label() + " de " + PvRenderers.weightOf(type)
                + ", asÃ­ que no cabe una variable mÃ¡s.\n"
                + "AmplÃ­e el rango del tag del Ã¡rea si necesita mÃ¡s sitio.";
    }

    static String typeLock(CommConfigData.ItemConfig area, DataType elegido,
            int slotsLibres, int bytesLibres, int bytesArea) {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder("<html>El Ã¡rea <b>")
                .append(area.getName()).append("</b> ");
        if (elegido == null) {
            text.append("aÃºn no tiene tipo: elÃ­gelo arriba. Todas sus variables")
                    .append(" usarÃ¡n ese mismo tipo.");
        } else {
            text.append("usa <b>").append(elegido.label()).append("</b> (")
                    .append(PvRenderers.weightOf(elegido)).append(" por variable). Todas sus")
                    .append(" variables serÃ¡n de ese tipo.");
        }
        if (bytesLibres < 0) {
            text.append("<br>Del tag no se sabe el tamaÃ±o, asÃ­ que no se lleva la cuenta.");
        } else if (slotsLibres <= 0) {
            text.append("<br><b>No cabe una variable mÃ¡s: se ha llegado al lÃ­mite.</b>")
                    .append(" El Ã¡rea abarca ")
                    .append(bytesArea)
                    .append(" bytes y estÃ¡n todos ocupados.");
        } else {
            text.append("<br>Quedan <b>").append(bytesLibres).append(" bytes</b> libres, ")
                    .append("que es lo mismo que <b>").append(slotsLibres)
                    .append(" ").append(elegido == null ? "variables" : elegido.label())
                    .append("</b> de ").append(PvRenderers.weightOf(elegido)).append(".");
        }
        return text.append("</html>").toString();
    }

    static String adjustmentsOnLoad(java.util.List<String> adjustments) {
        return "Estos valores se han corregido al abrir la variable, porque no"
                + " encajaban en el formulario:\n\n"
                + String.join("\n", adjustments)
                + "\n\nSi se guarda, se escriben los valores corregidos.";
    }

    static String incompleteFields(java.util.List<String> vacios) {
        return "Complete estos campos antes de guardar la variable:\n\n"
                + String.join("\n", vacios);
    }

    static String unsupportedType() {
        return "Seleccione un tipo de dato que el Ã¡rea admita. Los que salen en "
                + "gris no tienen tamaÃ±o definido y no se pueden usar.";
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.Component;
import java.awt.GridBagConstraints;
import javax.swing.DefaultListCellRenderer;
import javax.swing.JComboBox;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JList;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.DeviceConfigData;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.CommunicationWizardController;

public class StepDevicePanel extends JPanel {

    private final CommunicationWizardController controller;
    private final JComboBox<DeviceConfigData> cbDevice = new JComboBox<>();
    private final JLabel lblDeviceInfo = new JLabel(" ");
    private boolean populating;
    private Runnable onDeviceChanged;

    public StepDevicePanel(CommunicationWizardController controller) {
        this.controller = controller;
        buildUi();
        refreshDevices();
    }

    private void buildUi() {
        cbDevice.setRenderer(new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override
            public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value,
                    int index, boolean isSelected, boolean cellHasFocus) {
                JLabel label = (JLabel) super.getListCellRendererComponent(
                        list, value, index, isSelected, cellHasFocus);
                label.setText(value instanceof DeviceConfigData d
                        ? d.getDeviceName() + "  [" + d.getProtocol() + "]"
                        : " ");
                return label;
            }
        });
        cbDevice.addActionListener(e -> onDeviceSelected());
        WizardUi.fixComboWidth(cbDevice, 340);

        JPanel inner = WizardUi.formGrid();
        GridBagConstraints g = WizardUi.formConstraints();

        g.gridx = 0; g.gridy = 0; g.gridwidth = 2;
        inner.add(WizardUi.stepTitle("Paso 1 de 3 â€” Dispositivo"), g);

        g.gridy = 1;
        inner.add(new JLabel("Seleccione el dispositivo para la comunicaciÃ³n:"), g);

        g.gridy = 2; g.gridwidth = 2; g.weightx = 1.0;
        inner.add(cbDevice, g);
        g.gridwidth = 1;

        g.gridy = 3; g.gridx = 0; g.gridwidth = 2; g.weightx = 1.0;
        inner.add(lblDeviceInfo, g);

        g.gridy = 4;
        inner.add(new JLabel("<html><i>Si no aparece su dispositivo, crÃ©elo con "
                + "Â«Crear DispositivoÂ», primero cierre este asistente y vuelva a "
                + "abrirlo.</i></html>"), g);

        setLayout(new BorderLayout(8, 8));
        add(inner, BorderLayout.CENTER);
    }

    public void refresh() {
        refreshDevices();
    }

    private void refreshDevices() {
        DeviceConfigData prev = controller.getState().getSelectedDevice();
        populating = true;
        try {
            cbDevice.removeAllItems();
            for (DeviceConfigData device : controller.getAvailableDevices()) {
                cbDevice.addItem(device);
            }
            if (prev != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < cbDevice.getItemCount(); i++) {
                    if (cbDevice.getItemAt(i).getUuid().equals(prev.getUuid())) {
                        cbDevice.setSelectedIndex(i);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            populating = false;
        }
        onDeviceSelected();
    }

    private void onDeviceSelected() {
        if (populating) {
            return;
        }
        DeviceConfigData device = (DeviceConfigData) cbDevice.getSelectedItem();
        if (device == null) {
            lblDeviceInfo.setText(" ");
        } else {
            lblDeviceInfo.setText(device.getBrand() + " / " + device.getModel()
                    + " / " + device.getProtocol());
        }
        controller.selectDevice(device);
        if (onDeviceChanged != null) {
            onDeviceChanged.run();
        }
    }

    public void selectDeviceByUuid(String uuid) {
        if (uuid == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < cbDevice.getItemCount(); i++) {
            if (cbDevice.getItemAt(i).getUuid().equals(uuid)) {
                populating = true;
                try {
                    cbDevice.setSelectedIndex(i);
                } finally {
                    populating = false;
                }
                onDeviceSelected();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public void setOnDeviceChanged(Runnable onDeviceChanged) {
        this.onDeviceChanged = onDeviceChanged;
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.panel.wizard;

import java.awt.BorderLayout;
import java.awt.IllegalComponentStateException;
import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment;
import java.awt.Point;
import java.awt.Rectangle;
import java.awt.event.MouseAdapter;
import java.awt.event.MouseEvent;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.BorderFactory;
import javax.swing.JLabel;
import javax.swing.JPanel;
import javax.swing.JTextField;
import javax.swing.Popup;
import javax.swing.PopupFactory;
import javax.swing.border.Border;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.text.AbstractDocument;
import javax.swing.text.DocumentFilter;
import javax.swing.text.PlainDocument;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.TagDiagnostico;
import org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.model.TagIssue;

final class TagField extends JTextField {

    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    private static final PopupFactory FACTORIA_AVISOS = new PopupFactory();

    private final Border bordeOriginal;
    private boolean mouseOverTag;
    private Popup popupTag;

    TagField(int columnas) {
        super(columnas);
        bordeOriginal = getBorder();
        ((AbstractDocument) getDocument()).setDocumentFilter(new UppercaseFilter());
        setDocument(new LimitedDocument(40));
        addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void mouseEntered(MouseEvent e) {
                mouseOverTag = true;
                warnTag();
            }

            @Override
            public void mouseExited(MouseEvent e) {
                mouseOverTag = false;
                hideTagWarning();
            }
        });
        getDocument().addDocumentListener(new DocumentListener() {
            @Override
            public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
                warnTag();
            }

            @Override
            public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
                warnTag();
            }

            @Override
            public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
                warnTag();
            }
        });
    }

    private void warnTag() {
        hideTagWarning();
        List<TagIssue> errors = TagDiagnostico.errors(getText());
        List<TagIssue> warnings = TagDiagnostico.warnings(getText());
        List<TagIssue> todo = new ArrayList<>(errors);
        todo.addAll(warnings);
        setBorder(errors.isEmpty()
                ? bordeOriginal
                : BorderFactory.createLineBorder(new Color(180, 0, 0), 2));

        if (!todo.isEmpty() && mouseOverTag && isShowing()) {
            showTagWarning(todo);
        }
    }

    private static String messageFor(TagIssue issue) {
        List<String> a = issue.args();
        return switch (issue.codigo()) {
            case TagIssue.CORCHETE_SIN_CERRAR -> "Falta cerrar el corchete: hay un '[' sin su ']'.";
            case TagIssue.CORCHETE_SOBRANTE -> "Hay un ']' sin el '[' que lo abre.";
            case TagIssue.RANGO_INVALIDO -> "El rango Â«[" + a.get(0) + "]Â» no es vÃ¡lido."
                    + " Un rango se escribe con dos puntos, del tipo [0..9], y un solo"
                    + " nÃºmero es un Ã­ndice, del tipo [10].";
            case TagIssue.CARACTERES_RAROS -> "El tag tiene caracteres que no pueden ser parte"
                    + " de una direcciÃ³n: Â«" + a.get(0) + "Â». Se guardarÃ¡ tal cual, pero el PLC"
                    + " puede que no lo entienda.";
            case TagIssue.NO_ES_DIRECCION -> "Â«" + a.get(0) + "Â» no es una direcciÃ³n vÃ¡lida."
                    + " El Ã¡rea se puede guardar, pero se tratarÃ¡ como un nombre: no se le"
                    + " calcularÃ¡ el tamaÃ±o y no se podrÃ¡n comprobar solapes con las"
                    + " demÃ¡s Ã¡reas. Si es una direcciÃ³n, revise la notaciÃ³n:"
                    + " Ej: %DB22.DBB4[0..9]:BYTE.";
            case TagIssue.SIN_TIPOS -> "Con el tipo '" + a.get(0) + "' el Ã¡rea no va a ofrecer"
                    + " ningÃºn tipo de dato, asÃ­ que no se le podrÃ¡n aÃ±adir variables."
                    + " Los tipos del programa son: " + a.get(1) + ".";
            case TagIssue.SIN_TAMANO -> "No se sabe el tamaÃ±o del Ã¡rea, asÃ­ que no se le podrÃ¡"
                    + " aÃ±adir ninguna variable. AÃ±ada un rango al tag, del tipo [0..9],"
                    + " o un tipo tras los dos puntos, del tipo :INT.";
            case TagIssue.NUMERO_DEMASIADO_GRANDE -> "El nÃºmero Â«" + a.get(0) + "Â» es"
                    + " demasiado grande: no cabe en un entero. Seguramente sobre un dÃ­gito.";
            default -> issue.codigo();
        };
    }

    private void showTagWarning(List<TagIssue> issues) {
        if (GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless()) {
            return;
        }
        Point enPantalla = getLocationOnScreen();
        int anchoCampo = getWidth();
        int altoCampo = getHeight();
        int width = Math.max(240, Math.min(320, anchoCampo - 20));

        List<String> parrafos = new ArrayList<>(issues.size());
        for (TagIssue issue : issues) {
            parrafos.add(messageFor(issue));
        }
        JLabel etiqueta = new JLabel("<html><body style='width:" + (width - 16) + "px'>"
                + String.join("<br><br>", parrafos) + "</body></html>");
        etiqueta.setFont(getFont());

        JPanel caja = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        caja.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
                BorderFactory.createLineBorder(new Color(180, 0, 0)),
                BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(6, 8, 6, 8)));
        caja.setBackground(new Color(255, 250, 235));
        caja.add(etiqueta, BorderLayout.CENTER);

        Rectangle pantalla = GraphicsEnvironment
                .getLocalGraphicsEnvironment().getMaximumWindowBounds();
        int alto = caja.getPreferredSize().height;
        int y = enPantalla.y + altoCampo + 2;
        if (y + alto + 8 > pantalla.y + pantalla.height) {
            y = enPantalla.y - alto;
        }
        popupTag = FACTORIA_AVISOS.getPopup(this, caja, enPantalla.x, y);
        popupTag.show();
    }

    private void hideTagWarning() {
        if (popupTag != null) {
            popupTag.hide();
            popupTag = null;
        }
    }

    private static class UppercaseFilter extends DocumentFilter {
        @Override
        public void insertString(FilterBypass fb, int offset, String string, javax.swing.text.AttributeSet attr) {
            try {
                super.insertString(fb, offset, string.toUpperCase(), attr);
            } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void replace(FilterBypass fb, int offset, int length, String text, javax.swing.text.AttributeSet attrs) {
            try {
                super.replace(fb, offset, length, text.toUpperCase(), attrs);
            } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }
    }

    private static class LimitedDocument extends PlainDocument {
        private final int maxLength;

        LimitedDocument(int maxLength) {
            this.maxLength = maxLength;
        }

        @Override
        public void insertString(int offset, String str, javax.swing.text.AttributeSet attr)
                throws javax.swing.text.BadLocationException {
            if (str == null) return;
            if (getLength() + str.length() <= maxLength) {
                super.insertString(offset, str, attr);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void replace(int offset, int length, String str, javax.swing.text.AttributeSet attrs)
                throws javax.swing.text.BadLocationException {
            if (str == null) return;
            int currentLength = getLength();
            if (currentLength - length + str.length() <= maxLength) {
                super.replace(offset, length, str, attrs);
            }
        }
    }
}

        return campo;
    }

    private static final class DocumentoLimitado extends PlainDocument {

        private final int max;

        DocumentoLimitado(int max) {
            this.max = max;
        }

        @Override
        public void insertString(int offs, String str, AttributeSet a)
                throws BadLocationException {
            if (str == null) {
                return;
            }
            int caben = max - getLength();
            if (caben <= 0) {
                return;
            }
            super.insertString(offs, str.length() > caben ? str.substring(0, caben) : str, a);
        }
    }

    public static void limitTableSpace(JScrollPane scroll, int width, int height) {
        scroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(width, height));
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(ScrollPaneConstants.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
        scroll.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(ScrollPaneConstants.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED);
    }

    public static void configColumns(JTable table) {
        table.setAutoResizeMode(JTable.AUTO_RESIZE_OFF);
        table.getTableHeader().setReorderingAllowed(false);
    }

    public static void distributeVisibleWidth(JTable table) {
        applyVisibleWidth(table);
        Container padre = table.getParent();
        if (!(padre instanceof JViewport viewport)) {
            return;
        }
        if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(table.getClientProperty(CLIENTE_REPARTIDO))) {
            return;
        }
        table.putClientProperty(CLIENTE_REPARTIDO, Boolean.TRUE);
        viewport.addComponentListener(new ComponentAdapter() {
            @Override
            public void componentResized(ComponentEvent e) {
                distributeVisibleWidth(table);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void applyVisibleWidth(JTable table) {
        Container padre = table.getParent();
        if (!(padre instanceof JViewport viewport)) {
            return;
        }
        int disponible = viewport.getExtentSize().width;
        if (disponible <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        TableColumnModel columnas = table.getColumnModel();
        int n = columnas.getColumnCount();
        if (n == 0) {
            return;
        }
        int[] anchos = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            anchos[i] = columnas.getColumn(i).getWidth();
        }
        int[] repartidos = distributeProportionally(anchos, disponible);
        if (repartidos == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            columnas.getColumn(i).setPreferredWidth(repartidos[i]);
            columnas.getColumn(i).setWidth(repartidos[i]);
        }
    }

    static int[] distributeProportionally(int[] anchos, int disponible) {
        if (anchos == null || anchos.length == 0 || disponible <= 0) {
            return null;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int width : anchos) {
            total += width;
        }
        if (total <= 0 || total >= disponible) {
            return null;
        }
        int sobra = disponible - total;
        int[] resultado = new int[anchos.length];
        int repartido = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < anchos.length; i++) {
            int extra = sobra * anchos[i] / total;
            repartido += extra;
            resultado[i] = anchos[i] + extra;
        }
        int masAncha = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < resultado.length; i++) {
            if (resultado[i] > resultado[masAncha]) {
                masAncha = i;
            }
        }
        resultado[masAncha] += sobra - repartido;
        return resultado;
    }

    public static void sizeColumnsToContent(JTable table, int minWidth, int maxWidth) {
        FontMetrics fm = table.getFontMetrics(table.getTableHeader().getFont());
        TableColumnModel cm = table.getColumnModel();
        TableCellRenderer cellRenderer = table.getDefaultRenderer(Object.class);
        for (int i = 0; i < cm.getColumnCount(); i++) {
            int width = fm.stringWidth(table.getModel().getColumnName(i)) + 28;
            for (int r = 0; r < table.getRowCount() && width < maxWidth; r++) {
                Object value = table.getModel().getValueAt(r, i);
                if (value == null) {
                    continue;
                }
                Component comp = cellRenderer.getTableCellRendererComponent(
                        table, value, false, false, r, i);
                width = Math.max(width, comp.getPreferredSize().width + 24);
            }
            TableColumn col = cm.getColumn(i);
            col.setPreferredWidth(Math.max(minWidth, Math.min(maxWidth, width)));
            col.setMinWidth(minWidth);
        }
    }

    public static void fixComboWidth(JComboBox<?> combo, int width) {
        Dimension pref = combo.getPreferredSize();
        combo.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(width, pref.height));
        combo.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(Math.min(120, width), pref.height));
    }

    public static JPanel nav(JButton... buttons) {
        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 6, 0));
        for (JButton b : buttons) {
            panel.add(b);
        }
        return panel;
    }

    public static JPanel buttonRow(JButton... buttons) {
        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 6, 0));
        for (JButton b : buttons) {
            panel.add(b);
        }
        return panel;
    }

    public static void addLabel(JPanel target, GridBagConstraints g, int y, String text) {
        g.gridx = 0;
        g.gridy = y;
        g.gridwidth = 1;
        g.weightx = 0.0;
        target.add(new JLabel(text), g);
    }

    public static JLabel stepTitle(String text) {
        JLabel title = new JLabel(text);
        title.setFont(title.getFont().deriveFont(java.awt.Font.BOLD, 14f));
        return title;
    }

    public static JLabel formTitle(String text) {
        JLabel title = new JLabel(text);
        title.setFont(title.getFont().deriveFont(java.awt.Font.BOLD, 12f));
        return title;
    }

    public static GridBagConstraints formConstraints() {
        GridBagConstraints g = new GridBagConstraints();
        g.insets = new Insets(4, 8, 2, 8);
        g.anchor = GridBagConstraints.WEST;
        g.weightx = 1.0;
        g.fill = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
        return g;
    }

    public static GridBagConstraints formConstraintsTight() {
        GridBagConstraints g = formConstraints();
        g.insets = new Insets(2, 8, 2, 8);
        return g;
    }

    public static JPanel formGrid() {
        return new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.xml;

import javax.xml.XMLConstants;
import javax.xml.parsers.DocumentBuilderFactory;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;

public final class XmlSafe {

    private static final String DISALLOW_DOCTYPE =
            "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl";
    private static final String EXTERNAL_GENERAL =
            "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities";
    private static final String EXTERNAL_PARAMETER =
            "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities";
    private static final String LOAD_EXTERNAL_DTD =
            "http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd";

    private XmlSafe() {
    }

    public static DocumentBuilderFactory newFactory() throws ParserConfigurationException {
        DocumentBuilderFactory factory = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();

        factory.setFeature(DISALLOW_DOCTYPE, true);
        factory.setFeature(XMLConstants.FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, true);

        bestEffort(factory, EXTERNAL_GENERAL, false);
        bestEffort(factory, EXTERNAL_PARAMETER, false);
        bestEffort(factory, LOAD_EXTERNAL_DTD, false);

        factory.setXIncludeAware(false);
        factory.setExpandEntityReferences(false);
        return factory;
    }

    private static void bestEffort(DocumentBuilderFactory factory, String feature, boolean value) {
        try {
            factory.setFeature(feature, value);
        } catch (ParserConfigurationException ex) {
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CategoryIconsTest {

    private static final byte[] FIRMA_PNG = {(byte) 0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47};

    @Test
    void declaredPathsResolveToARealPng() {
        for (String ruta : List.of(CategoryIcons.DEFAULT, CategoryIcons.COMMUNICATION)) {
            URL recurso = recurso(ruta);
            assertNotNull(recurso, "no existe el icono: " + ruta);
            assertArrayEquals(FIRMA_PNG, primerosBytes(recurso, 4),
                    "el fichero de " + ruta + " no es un PNG valido");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void iconOfEachCategoryExists() {
        for (HMICategoryDefinition definition : HMICategoryDefinition.values()) {
            URL recurso = recurso(definition.getIconPath());
            assertNotNull(recurso,
                    "el icono de " + definition.name() + " no existe: " + definition.getIconPath());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void ningunaRutaDeIconoDelModuloEstaRota() throws IOException {
        Map<String, String> rutas = declaredIconPaths();
        assertTrue(!rutas.isEmpty(),
                "el recorrido deberia encontrar al menos una ruta .png; si no encuentra "
                        + "ninguna, el test esta pasando sin comprobar nada");

        List<String> rotas = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entrada : rutas.entrySet()) {
            String ruta = entrada.getKey();
            URL recurso = recurso(ruta);
            if (recurso == null) {
                rotas.add(entrada.getValue() + " -> " + ruta + " (no existe en el classpath)");
            } else if (ruta.startsWith("/")) {
                rotas.add(entrada.getValue() + " -> " + ruta + " (no debe empezar por barra)");
            }
        }
        assertTrue(rotas.isEmpty(), "Rutas de icono rotas:\n  " + String.join("\n  ", rotas));
    }

    /** Recorre el codigo y devuelve ruta -> "fichero:linea". */
    private static Map<String, String> declaredIconPaths() throws IOException {
        Pattern literal = Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]*\\.png)\"");
        Map<String, String> encontradas = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Path raiz = Path.of(System.getProperty("basedir", "."), "src", "main", "java");
        try (Stream<Path> archivos = Files.walk(raiz)) {
            for (Path p : archivos.filter(x -> x.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                List<String> lineas = Files.readAllLines(p);
                for (int i = 0; i < lineas.size(); i++) {
                    String limpia = lineas.get(i).trim();
                    if (limpia.startsWith("//") || limpia.startsWith("*")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    Matcher m = literal.matcher(limpia);
                    while (m.find()) {
                        encontradas.putIfAbsent(m.group(1), p.getFileName() + ":" + (i + 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return encontradas;
    }

    private static URL recurso(String ruta) {

        return CategoryIconsTest.class.getResource(
                ruta.startsWith("/") ? ruta : "/" + ruta);
    }

    private static byte[] primerosBytes(URL recurso, int cuantos) {
        try (InputStream in = recurso.openStream()) {
            return in.readNBytes(cuantos);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No se pudo leer " + recurso, e);
        }
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ConvencionNombresTest {

    /** Modificadores, tipo simple y nombre. El tipo no admite punto ni parentesis. */
    private static final Pattern DECLARACION = Pattern.compile(
            "^(?:public|protected|private|static|final|abstract|synchronized|native|default|\\s)+"
                    + "[A-Za-z_]\\w*\\s+([A-Za-z_]\\w*)\\s*\\(");

    /** Metodos cuya nombre impone la plataforma o una interfaz ya normalizada. */
    private static final List<String> EXENTOS = List.of(
            // Swing / AWT
            "actionPerformed", "mouseEntered", "mouseExited", "mousePressed", "mouseReleased",
            "mouseDragged", "mouseMoved", "mouseWheelMoved", "focusGained", "focusLost",
            "insertUpdate", "removeUpdate", "changedUpdate", "insertString", "remove",
            "componentOpened", "componentClosed", "componentShowing", "componentHidden",
            "componentActivated", "componentDeactivated", "componentResized", "getPreferredSize",
            "setToolTipText", "getToolTipText", "getText", "setText", "isEditable",
            "addActionListener", "removeActionListener", "setEnabled", "isEnabled",
            "getSelectedIndex", "setSelectedIndex", "getSelectedItem", "setSelectedItem",
            "getItemCount", "addItem", "removeAllItems", "setEditable", "getItemAt",
            "doClick", "getClientProperty", "putClientProperty", "getTextFields",
            // NetBeans: Node, NodeList, FileChangeListener, Project, DataObject, Lookup
            "getActions", "createNodes", "keys", "node", "addChangeListener",
            "removeChangeListener", "addNotify", "removeNotify", "fileDataCreated",
            "fileDeleted", "fileRenamed", "fileFolderCreated", "fileChanged",
            "fileAttributeChanged", "stateChanged", "getName", "getDisplayName", "getIcon",
            "getOpenedIcon", "getProjectDirectory", "getProject", "getLookup", "getChildren",
            "getCookie", "getType", "createEditor", "createContextAwareInstance",
            "createLogicalView", "findPath", "isProject", "getVisualRepresentation",
            "getToolbarRepresentation", "getValue", "setValue", "getHelpCtx",
            "getComponent", "getSubprojects", "saveProject", "addPropertyChangeListener",
            "removePropertyChangeListener", "canCloseElement", "getUndoRedo", "getWidth",
            "setMultiViewCallback", "associateLookup", "getIconBase", "getActions",
            // Project / ProjectFactory / ProjectState
            "getProjectDirectory", "getLookup", "saveProject", "isProject",
            // ProjectStorage, CommConfigStorage, CommConfigRepository
            "getDevices", "findByUuid", "getComms", "upsertDevice", "upsertComms",
            "removeDevice", "save", "load", "open", "create", "close", "directoryName",
            "has", "config", "bootDbFolder", "setOnChanged", "setOnDeleted",
            "watchForChanges", "pauseNotifications", "resumeNotifications",
            "createRepository", "has", "directoryName",
            // Object
            "toString", "equals", "hashCode");

    @Test
    void ningunMetodoEmpiezaPorMayuscula() throws IOException {
        Recorrido recorrido = recorrer();

        assertTrue(recorrido.ficheros() > 50,
                "el recorrido solo ha visto " + recorrido.ficheros() + " ficheros; si el "
                        + "directorio base no es el del agregador, el test pasa sin comprobar nada");
        assertTrue(recorrido.metodos() > 150,
                "solo se han visto " + recorrido.metodos() + " metodos; el recorrido no esta "
                        + "llegando al codigo");

        assertTrue(recorrido.infracciones().isEmpty(),
                "T4.8: estos metodos deberian empezar en minuscula:\n  "
                        + String.join("\n  ", recorrido.infracciones()));
    }

    private record Recorrido(List<String> infracciones, int ficheros, int metodos) {
    }

    private static Recorrido recorrer() throws IOException {
        List<String> infracciones = new ArrayList<>();
        int ficheros = 0;
        int metodos = 0;
        for (Path modulo : gateModules()) {
            Path raiz = modulo.resolve("src").resolve("main").resolve("java");
            if (!Files.isDirectory(raiz)) {
                continue;
            }
            try (Stream<Path> archivos = Files.walk(raiz)) {
                for (Path p : archivos.filter(x -> x.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                    ficheros++;
                    List<String> lineas = Files.readAllLines(p);
                    String clase = p.getFileName().toString().replace(".java", "");
                    for (int i = 0; i < lineas.size(); i++) {
                        String limpia = lineas.get(i).trim();
                        if (limpia.startsWith("//") || limpia.startsWith("*")
                                || limpia.startsWith("/*")) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        Matcher m = DECLARACION.matcher(limpia);

                        if (!m.lookingAt()) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        String name = m.group(1);
                        String cabeza = limpia.substring(0, limpia.indexOf('(')).trim();

                        if (!cabeza.endsWith(name)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        if (cabeza.contains("record ") || cabeza.contains("enum ")
                                || cabeza.contains("interface ")) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        
                        if (name.equals(clase) || EXENTOS.contains(name)) {
                            continue;
                        }
                        metodos++;
                        if (Character.isUpperCase(name.charAt(0))) {
                            infracciones.add(p.getFileName() + ":" + (i + 1) + "  " + name);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return new Recorrido(infracciones, ficheros, metodos);
    }

    private static List<Path> gateModules() {
        Path base = Path.of(System.getProperty("basedir", ".")).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path agregador = Files.isDirectory(base.resolve("commsHmi")) ? base : base.getParent();
        return List.of(agregador.resolve("commsHmi"), agregador.resolve("ConfigPhoebus"),
                agregador.resolve("HMIPanelSubprojectCategory"),
                agregador.resolve("HMIPanelSubproject"));
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class DeteccionCategoriaTest {

    @Test
    void projectWithoutMarkerDetectsNothing() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora",
                file("README.txt"),
                folder("documentacion", file("notas.md")));

        Optional<String> detectado = DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz);

        assertTrue(detectado.isEmpty(),
                "H-05: un proyecto sin marcador no debe devolver nada; antes devolvia null"
                        + " y el switch de getActions lanzaba NullPointerException");
    }

    @Test
    void emptyProjectNeitherThrowsNorDetects() {
        Optional<String> detectado = DeteccionCategoria.detect(folder("vacio"));

        assertTrue(detectado.isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void nullRootDoesNotThrow() {
        assertTrue(DeteccionCategoria.detect(null).isEmpty(),
                "una raiz nula se resuelve como ausencia de categoria, no como excepcion");
    }

    @Test
    void detectaElMarcadorEnLaRaiz() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora", file("comunicacion.xml"));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("comunicacion.xml"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz));
    }

    @Test
    void detectaElMarcadorEnUnSubdirectorio() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora",
                folder("config", folder("anidado", file("comunicacion.xml"))));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("comunicacion.xml"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                "el marcador puede estar anidado, como permitia el codigo anterior");
    }

    @Test
    void markerWinsByPriorityOrder() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora",
                file("base.rcp"),
                file("template.bob"),
                file("comunicacion.xml"));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("template.bob"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                "template.bob va primero en la lista y debe ganar");
    }

    @Test
    void lookupIsCaseInsensitive() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora", file("Comunicacion.XML"));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("comunicacion.xml"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                "el codigo anterior comparaba con equalsIgnoreCase");
    }

    @Test
    void folderDoesNotCountAsMarker() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora", folder("comunicacion.xml"));

        assertTrue(DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz).isEmpty(),
                "una carpeta con el nombre del marcador no es el fichero marcador");
    }

    @Test
    void deepTreeDoesNotExhaustTheStack() {

        ProjectTree actual = folder("nivel-19999");
        for (int i = 19_998; i >= 0; i--) {
            actual = new node("nivel-" + i, true, List.of(actual));
        }

        assertTrue(DeteccionCategoria.detect(actual).isEmpty(),
                "un arbol muy profundo se recorre sin desbordar la pila");
    }

    @Test
    void recorreElArbolUnaSolaVez() {
        CountingTree raiz = new CountingTree("llenadora", List.of(
                new CountingTree("config", List.of(new CountingTree("comunicacion.xml", List.of()))),
                new CountingTree("datos", List.of(new CountingTree("datos.bin", List.of())))));

        DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz);

        assertEquals(1, raiz.visitas,
                "H-05: antes se recorria el arbol entero una vez por cada fichero marcador");
    }

    @Test
    void allTenMarkersAreStillCovered() {
        for (String marcador : DeteccionCategoria.FICHEROS_MARCADOR) {
            ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora",
                    folder("sub", file(marcador)));

            assertEquals(Optional.of(marcador), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                    "el marcador " + marcador + " debe seguir detectandose");
        }
    }

    private static ProjectTree folder(String name, ProjectTree... children) {
        return new node(name, true, List.of(children));
    }

    private static ProjectTree file(String name) {
        return new node(name, false, List.of());
    }

    private record node(String name, boolean folder, List<ProjectTree> children) implements ProjectTree {

        @Override
        public String name() {
            return name;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isFolder() {
            return folder;
        }

        @Override
        public List<ProjectTree> children() {
            return children;
        }
    }

    private static final class CountingTree implements ProjectTree {

        private final String name;
        private final List<ProjectTree> children;
        private int visitas;

        CountingTree(String name, List<ProjectTree> children) {
            this.name = name;
            this.children = new ArrayList<>(children);
        }

        @Override
        public String name() {
            return name;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean isFolder() {
            return !children.isEmpty();
        }

        @Override
        public List<ProjectTree> children() {
            visitas++;
            return children;
        }
    }

    @Test
    void categoryIsRecognisedByNameEvenWithoutMarker() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("Comunicacion", file("README.txt"));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("comunicacion.xml"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                "borrar comunicacion.xml no puede dejar la categoria sin acciones");
    }

    @Test
    void withoutNameNorMarkerThereIsNoCategory() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("llenadora", file("README.txt"));

        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz),
                "una carpeta cualquiera no es una categoria");
    }

    @Test
    void markerStillWinsOverTheName() {
        ProjectTree raiz = folder("Gestion de Avisos", file("comunicacion.xml"));

        assertEquals(Optional.of("comunicacion.xml"), DeteccionCategoria.detect(raiz));
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class HMICategoryFileRulesTest {

    private static final Map<HMICategoryDefinition, String[]> EN_LA_FACTORY = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    static {
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE,
                new String[]{"Recetas", "rcp", "base.rcp"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.SCRIPTS,
                new String[]{"Scripts", "scp", "base.scp"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.HISTORIAL,
                new String[]{"Historial", "record", "record.record"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.REPORT,
                new String[]{"Informes", "rpt", "base.rpt"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.TEXT_GRAPHIC,
                new String[]{"Texto y Lista de graficos", "tlc", "base.tlc"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.NOTICE_MANAGEMENT,
                new String[]{"Gestion de Avisos", "wmg", "base.wmg"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.ADMIN_USER,
                new String[]{"Administracion de Usuarios runtime", "rtum", "base.rtum"});
        EN_LA_FACTORY.put(HMICategoryDefinition.CONFIG_PANEL,
                new String[]{"Configuracion de panel de operador", "oppc", "base.oppc"});
    }

    @Test
    void eachCategoryKeepsFolderExtensionAndHiddenFile() {
        for (Map.Entry<HMICategoryDefinition, String[]> entrada : EN_LA_FACTORY.entrySet()) {
            HMICategoryDefinition definition = entrada.getKey();
            String[] esperado = entrada.getValue();
            assertEquals(esperado[0], definition.getDisplayName(),
                    "la carpeta de " + definition.name() + " no puede cambiar: el NodeFactory "
                            + "la busca por este nombre");
            assertEquals(esperado[1], definition.getFileExtension(),
                    "la extension de " + definition.name() + " no puede cambiar");
            assertEquals(esperado[2], definition.getHiddenFile(),
                    "el fichero oculto de " + definition.name() + " no puede cambiar");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void categoriesWithoutOwnFilesDeclareNoExtension() {
        assertNull(HMICategoryDefinition.IMAGE.getFileExtension());
        assertNull(HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.getFileExtension());
        assertNull(HMICategoryDefinition.IMAGE.getHiddenFile());
        assertNull(HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.getHiddenFile());
    }

    @Test
    void categoryWithoutExtensionAcceptsNoFile() {
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.IMAGE.acepta("captura.bob", "bob", false));
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.COMUNICATION.acepta("comunicacion.xml", "xml", false));
    }

    @Test
    void eachCategoryAcceptsItsOwnFile() {
        for (Map.Entry<HMICategoryDefinition, String[]> entrada : EN_LA_FACTORY.entrySet()) {
            HMICategoryDefinition definition = entrada.getKey();
            String[] esperado = entrada.getValue();
            String name = "mi-recurso." + esperado[1];
            assertTrue(definition.acepta(name, esperado[1], false),
                    definition.name() + " deberia aceptar " + name);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void hiddenFileIsNotListed() {
        for (Map.Entry<HMICategoryDefinition, String[]> entrada : EN_LA_FACTORY.entrySet()) {
            HMICategoryDefinition definition = entrada.getKey();
            String[] esperado = entrada.getValue();
            assertFalse(definition.acepta(esperado[2], esperado[1], false),
                    definition.name() + " no debe mostrar su fichero base: " + esperado[2]);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void folderIsNeverListedAsFile() {
        for (HMICategoryDefinition definition : EN_LA_FACTORY.keySet()) {
            String extension = definition.getFileExtension();
            assertFalse(definition.acepta("subcarpeta." + extension, extension, true),
                    definition.name() + " no debe intentar mostrar un directorio");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void otraExtensionNoSeMuestra() {
        for (HMICategoryDefinition definition : EN_LA_FACTORY.keySet()) {
            assertFalse(definition.acepta("documento.pdf", "pdf", false),
                    definition.name() + " solo muestra " + definition.getFileExtension());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void folderIsComparedIgnoringCaseAndSpaces() {
        assertTrue(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder("Recetas"));
        assertTrue(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder("recetas"));
        assertTrue(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder("RECETAS"));
        assertTrue(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder("  Recetas  "));
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder("Scripts"));
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder(null));
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.matchesFolder(""));
    }

    @Test
    void extensionAndHiddenAreComparedIgnoringCase() {
        HMICategoryDefinition receta = HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE;

        assertTrue(receta.acepta("Receta.RCP", "RCP", false));
        assertFalse(receta.acepta("BASE.RCP", "rcp", false),
                "el fichero oculto tambien se compara sin distinguir mayusculas");
    }

    @Test
    void nullExtensionIsNotAccepted() {
        assertFalse(HMICategoryDefinition.RECIPE.acepta("recurso.rcp", null, false));
    }

    @Test
    void identifiersAreUniqueAndDoNotRepeatTheVisibleName() {
        List<String> ids = Arrays.stream(HMICategoryDefinition.values())
                .map(HMICategoryDefinition::getId).collect(Collectors.toList());

        assertEquals(ids.size(), ids.stream().distinct().count(),
                "dos categorias con el mismo id no se podrian distinguir: " + ids);
        ids.forEach(id -> assertFalse(id.isBlank(), "ninguna categoria puede tener el id vacio"));
    }

    @Test
    void noFolderIsRepeatedAcrossCategories() {
        List<String> carpetas = Arrays.stream(HMICategoryDefinition.values())
                .map(HMICategoryDefinition::getDisplayName).collect(Collectors.toList());

        assertEquals(carpetas.size(), carpetas.stream().distinct().count(),
                "dos categorias en la misma carpeta harÃ­an que sus NodeFactory colisionasen");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ProjectIdsTest {

    @Test
    void valuesDoNotChange() {
        assertEquals("org-apache-plc4x-category", ProjectIds.CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE);
        assertEquals("org-apache-plc4x-panel", ProjectIds.PANEL_PROJECT_TYPE);
        assertEquals("category.cfg", ProjectIds.CATEGORY_MARKER_FILE);
        assertEquals("comunicacion.xml", ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE);
    }

    @Test
    void constantsServeTheAnnotations() {
        assertTrue(isCompileTimeConstant("CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE"));
        assertTrue(isCompileTimeConstant("PANEL_PROJECT_TYPE"));
    }

    private static boolean isCompileTimeConstant(String name) {
        try {
            java.lang.reflect.Field campo = ProjectIds.class.getField(name);
            return java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(campo.getModifiers())
                    && java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isFinal(campo.getModifiers())
                    && campo.getType() == String.class;
        } catch (NoSuchFieldException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    @Test
    void losIdentificadoresNoVuelvenAFueraDeProjectIds() throws IOException {
        List<String> infracciones = new ArrayList<>();
        Path raiz = Path.of(System.getProperty("basedir", "."), "src", "main", "java");
        java.util.regex.Pattern literal = java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("\"([^\"]*)\"");

        try (Stream<Path> archivos = Files.walk(raiz)) {
            for (Path p : archivos.filter(x -> x.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                if (p.getFileName().toString().equals("ProjectIds.java")) {
                    continue;
                }
                List<String> lineas = Files.readAllLines(p);
                for (int i = 0; i < lineas.size(); i++) {
                    String limpia = lineas.get(i).trim();
                    if (limpia.startsWith("//") || limpia.startsWith("*")
                            || limpia.startsWith("/*")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    java.util.regex.Matcher m = literal.matcher(limpia);
                    while (m.find()) {
                        String valor = m.group(1);
                        if (identifiers().contains(valor)) {
                            infracciones.add(p.getFileName() + ":" + (i + 1)
                                    + "  usa \"" + valor + "\" a mano  " + limpia);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(infracciones.isEmpty(),
                "T4.4: los identificadores compartidos deben salir de ProjectIds.\n  "
                        + String.join("\n  ", infracciones));
    }

    private static List<String> identifiers() {
        return List.of(ProjectIds.CATEGORY_PROJECT_TYPE, ProjectIds.PANEL_PROJECT_TYPE,
                ProjectIds.CATEGORY_MARKER_FILE, ProjectIds.COMMUNICATION_CONFIG_FILE);
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.action;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.Action;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NotImplementedCategoryActionsTest {

    private static List<AbstractNotImplementedAction> actions() {
        return List.of(
                new HMICategoryOPCAction(null),
                new HMICategoryTextAndListChartsAction(null),
                new HMICategoryWarningManagementAction(null),
                new HMICategoryRuntimeUserManagementAction(null));
    }

    @Test
    void allWarnThatTheyAreNotImplemented() {
        for (AbstractNotImplementedAction accion : actions()) {
            String mensaje = accion.notImplementedMessage();
            assertNotNull(mensaje, accion.getClass().getSimpleName() + " debe tener un aviso");
            assertTrue(mensaje.contains("todavÃ­a no estÃ¡ implementada"), mensaje);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void warningNamesTheActionSoTheUserKnowsWhichIsMissing() {
        for (AbstractNotImplementedAction accion : actions()) {
            String etiqueta = String.valueOf(accion.getValue(Action.NAME));
            assertTrue(accion.notImplementedMessage().contains(etiqueta),
                    "el aviso tiene que decir quÃ© acciÃ³n falta, no algo genÃ©rico: "
                            + accion.notImplementedMessage());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void eachActionKeepsItsMenuLabel() {
        List<String> etiquetas = actions().stream()
                .map(a -> String.valueOf(a.getValue(Action.NAME))).toList();

        assertTrue(etiquetas.contains("Editar panel de operador"));
        assertTrue(etiquetas.contains("Editar textos y grÃ¡ficos"));
        assertTrue(etiquetas.contains("Editar gestiÃ³n de avisos"));
        assertTrue(etiquetas.contains("Editar usuarios runtime"));
        assertFalse(etiquetas.contains("null"),
                "una acciÃ³n sin etiqueta en el menÃº no se puede leer: " + etiquetas);
    }

    @Test
    void labelsAreNotRepeated() {
        List<String> etiquetas = actions().stream()
                .map(a -> String.valueOf(a.getValue(Action.NAME))).toList();

        assertTrue(etiquetas.stream().allMatch(e -> !e.isBlank()),
                "ninguna acciÃ³n puede quedarse sin etiqueta: " + etiquetas);
    }

    @Test
    void ningunaAccioneImprimeEnLaConsola() throws Exception {
        java.nio.file.Path raiz = java.nio.file.Path.of(System.getProperty("basedir", "."),
                "src", "main", "java");
        List<String> infracciones = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try (java.util.stream.Stream<java.nio.file.Path> archivos = java.nio.file.Files.walk(raiz)) {
            for (java.nio.file.Path p : archivos.filter(x -> x.toString().endsWith(".java"))
                    .toList()) {
                if (!p.toString().contains("action")) {
                    continue;
                }
                List<String> lineas = java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(p);
                for (int i = 0; i < lineas.size(); i++) {
                    String linea = lineas.get(i);
                    if (linea.contains("System.out") || linea.contains("System.err")) {
                        if (!linea.trim().startsWith("//") && !linea.trim().startsWith("*")) {
                            infracciones.add(p.getFileName() + ":" + (i + 1) + "  " + linea.trim());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        assertTrue(infracciones.isEmpty(),
                "K-07: las acciones no deben imprimir en la consola; usa LOGGER o avisa al "
                        + "usuario con NotifyDescriptor. Encontrado:\n  "
                        + String.join("\n  ", infracciones));
    }
}

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class PhoebusLauncherTest {

    @Test
    void processOutputIsDiscarded(@TempDir Path home) {
        ProcessBuilder pb = PhoebusLauncher.command("phoebus.sh");

        assertEquals(ProcessBuilder.Redirect.DISCARD, pb.redirectOutput(),
                "si nadie lee la salida, el proceso se queda bloqueado al llenarse el pipe");
        assertTrue(pb.redirectErrorStream());
    }

    @Test
    void commandKeepsTheArgumentsThatAlreadyWorked(@TempDir Path home) {
        List<String> command = PhoebusLauncher.command("phoebus.sh").command();

        assertEquals("phoebus.sh", command.get(0));
        assertTrue(command.contains("-nosplash"));
        assertTrue(command.contains("-edit"));
    }

    @Test
    void elMementoDelUsuarioSeGuardaAntesDeTocarlo(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        Files.writeString(memento, "contenido del usuario");

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "contenido de malbec");

        assertEquals("contenido de malbec", Files.readString(memento));
        assertEquals("contenido del usuario", Files.readString(respaldo),
                "el memento del usuario tiene que quedar a salvo antes de sobrescribirlo");
    }

    @Test
    void alTerminarPhoebusSeRestauraElMementoDelUsuario(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        Files.writeString(memento, "contenido del usuario");

        String escrito = PhoebusLauncher.contentFor(home.resolve("CELDA1.bob"), "user");
        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, escrito);
        PhoebusLauncher.restoreIfStillOurs(memento, respaldo, escrito);

        assertEquals("contenido del usuario", Files.readString(memento));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(respaldo), "ya restaurado, el respaldo sobra");
    }

    @Test
    void siPhoebusHaCambiadoElMementoNoSeToca(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        Files.writeString(memento, "contenido del usuario");

        String escrito = PhoebusLauncher.contentFor(home.resolve("CELDA1.bob"), "user");
        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, escrito);
        Files.writeString(memento, "lo que haya escrito Phoebus al cerrar su sesion");

        PhoebusLauncher.restoreIfStillOurs(memento, respaldo, escrito);

        assertEquals("lo que haya escrito Phoebus al cerrar su sesion",
                Files.readString(memento),
                "no hay que pisar lo que Phoebus haya guardado al salir");
    }

    @Test
    void sinMementoPrevioNoSeDejaRespaldo(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(respaldo.getParent());
        Files.writeString(respaldo, "respaldo viejo de una sesion anterior");

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "contenido de malbec");

        assertFalse(Files.exists(respaldo),
                "sin memento previo no hay nada que restaurar, y un respaldo viejo confundiria");
        assertEquals("contenido de malbec", Files.readString(memento));
    }

    @Test
    void elMementoApuntaAlBobConElUriEscapado(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path bob = home.resolve("CELDA & 1.bob");

        String content = PhoebusLauncher.contentFor(bob, "user");

        assertTrue(content.contains("CELDA%20&amp;%201.bob"),
                "el ampersand del nombre debe ir escapado en el XML: " + content);
        assertFalse(content.contains("%ID%"));
        assertFalse(content.contains("%URI%"));
    }

    @Test
    void elMementoVaUtf8(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "descripciÃ³n con Ã±");

        assertEquals("descripciÃ³n con Ã±",
                new String(Files.readAllBytes(memento), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    @Test
    void laAccionNoEscribeElMementoPorSuCuenta() throws Exception {
        java.nio.file.Path fuente = java.nio.file.Path.of("src", "main", "java",
                "org", "apache", "plc4x", "malbec", "projecttype", "panelcategory",
                "action", "HMICategoryOpenPhoebusAction.java");
        String codigo = Files.readString(fuente, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

        assertFalse(codigo.contains("Files.write"),
                "escribir el memento es cosa de PhoebusLauncher, con copia de seguridad");
        assertFalse(codigo.contains("new ProcessBuilder("),
                "el comando lo arma PhoebusLauncher, que descarta la salida");
        assertTrue(codigo.contains("PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento"));
        assertTrue(codigo.contains("PhoebusLauncher.waitAndRestore"),
                "sin restaurar despues, el memento del usuario se queda pisado");
    }

    @Test
    void abrirUnSegundoBobNoDestruyeElMementoOriginal(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        Files.writeString(memento, "memento original del usuario");

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "contenido del primer bob");
        assertEquals("memento original del usuario", Files.readString(respaldo));

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "contenido del segundo bob");

        assertEquals("memento original del usuario", Files.readString(respaldo),
                "el segundo lanzamiento no puede pisar el respaldo con nuestro propio memento");

        PhoebusLauncher.restoreIfStillOurs(memento, respaldo, "contenido del segundo bob");
        assertEquals("memento original del usuario", Files.readString(memento),
                "al cerrar, vuelve el memento que tenia el usuario");
    }

    @Test
    void trasRestaurarSePuedeVolverABackupar(@TempDir Path home) throws Exception {
        Path memento = PhoebusLauncher.rutaMemento(home);
        Path respaldo = PhoebusLauncher.backupPath(home);
        Files.createDirectories(memento.getParent());
        Files.writeString(memento, "original");

        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "nuestro");
        PhoebusLauncher.restoreIfStillOurs(memento, respaldo, "nuestro");
        assertFalse(Files.exists(respaldo));

        Files.writeString(memento, "otro original");
        PhoebusLauncher.writeMemento(memento, respaldo, "nuestro otra vez");

        assertEquals("otro original", Files.readString(respaldo),
                "el respaldo tiene que volver a estar disponible para la siguiente sesion");
    }
}

package org.apache.plc4x.malbec.projecttype.panelcategory.comms.netbeans;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Properties;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
